verses.textZh: 神在古时候，曾经多次用种种方法，借着先知向我们的祖先说话；
verses.textZhCnvs: 神在古时候，曾经多次用种种方法，借着先知向我们的祖先说话；
verses.textZhCuv: 神既在古时藉着众先知多次多方地晓谕列祖，
verses.textEnNiv: In the past God spoke to our ancestors through the prophets at many times and in various ways,
verses.textEnEsv: Long ago, at many times and in many ways, God spoke to our fathers by the prophets,
verses.textEnNkjv: God, who at various times and in various ways spoke in time past to the fathers by the prophets,
verses.textEnNlt: Long ago God spoke many times and in many ways to our ancestors through the prophets.
verses.textEnNasb: God, after He spoke long ago to the fathers in the prophets in many portions and in many ways,
verses.textEn: In the past God spoke to our ancestors through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

verses.textZh: 在这末后的日子，却借着他的儿子向我们说话。神已经立他作万有的承受者，并且借着他创造了宇宙 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这末后的日子，却借着他的儿子向我们说话。神已经立他作万有的承受者，并且借着他创造了宇宙 。
verses.textZhCuv: 就在这末世藉着他儿子晓谕我们；又早已立他为承受万有的，也曾藉着他创造诸世界。
verses.textEnNiv: but in these last days he has spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, and through whom also he made the universe.
verses.textEnEsv: but in these last days he has spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed the heir of all things, through whom also he created the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: has in these last days spoken to us by His Son, whom He has appointed heir of all things, through whom also He made the worlds;
verses.textEnNlt: And now in these final days, he has spoken to us through his Son. God promised everything to the Son as an inheritance, and through the Son he created the universe.
verses.textEnNasb: in these last days has spoken to us in His Son, whom He appointed heir of all things, through whom He also made the world.
verses.textEn: but in these last days he has spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, and through whom also he made the universe.

verses.textZh: 他是神荣耀的光辉，是神本质的真象，用自己带有能力的话掌管万有；他作成了洁净罪恶的事，就坐在高天至尊者的右边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是神荣耀的光辉，是神本质的真象，用自己带有能力的话掌管万有；他作成了洁净罪恶的事，就坐在高天至尊者的右边。
verses.textZhCuv: 他是神荣耀所发的光辉，是神本体的真像，常用他权能的命令托住万有。他洗净了人的罪，就坐在高天至大者的右边。
verses.textEnNiv: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of his being, sustaining all things by his powerful word. After he had provided purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty in heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: He is the radiance of the glory of God and the exact imprint of his nature, and he upholds the universe by the word of his power. After making purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high,
verses.textEnNkjv: who being the brightness of His glory and the express image of His person, and upholding all things by the word of His power, when He had by Himself purged our sins, sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high,
verses.textEnNlt: The Son radiates God’s own glory and expresses the very character of God, and he sustains everything by the mighty power of his command. When he had cleansed us from our sins, he sat down in the place of honor at the right hand of the majestic God in heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: And He is the radiance of His glory and the exact representation of His nature, and upholds all things by the word of His power. When He had made purification of sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high,
verses.textEn: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of his being, sustaining all things by his powerful word. After he had provided purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty in heaven.

verses.textZh: 他所承受的名比天使的名更尊贵，所以他远比天使崇高。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他所承受的名比天使的名更尊贵，所以他远比天使崇高。
verses.textZhCuv: 他所承受的名，既比天使的名更尊贵，就远超过天使。
verses.textEnNiv: So he became as much superior to the angels as the name he has inherited is superior to theirs.
verses.textEnEsv: having become as much superior to angels as the name he has inherited is more excellent than theirs.
verses.textEnNkjv: having become so much better than the angels, as He has by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
verses.textEnNlt: This shows that the Son is far greater than the angels, just as the name God gave him is greater than their names.
verses.textEnNasb: having become so much better than the angels, to the extent that He has inherited a more excellent name than they.
verses.textEn: So he became as much superior to the angels as the name he has inherited is superior to theirs.

verses.textZh: 神曾对哪一个天使说过： "你是我的儿子， 我今日生了你"呢？ 或者说： "我要作他的父亲， 他要作我的儿子"呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神曾对哪一个天使说过： "你是我的儿子， 我今日生了你"呢？ 或者说： "我要作他的父亲， 他要作我的儿子"呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 所有的天使，神从来对哪一个说： 你是我的儿子， 我今日生你？ 又指着哪一个说： 我要作他的父， 他要作我的子？
verses.textEnNiv: For to which of the angels did God ever say, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father" ? Or again, "I will be his Father, and he will be my Son" ?
verses.textEnEsv: For to which of the angels did God ever say, "You are my Son, today I have begotten you"? Or again, "I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son"?
verses.textEnNkjv: For to which of the angels did He ever say: "You are My Son, Today I have begotten You"? And again: "I will be to Him a Father, And He shall be to Me a Son"?
verses.textEnNlt: For God never said to any angel what he said to Jesus: "You are my Son. Today I have become your Father. " God also said, "I will be his Father, and he will be my Son."
verses.textEnNasb: For to which of the angels did He ever say, "You are My Son, Today I have fathered You"? And again, "I will be a Father to Him And He will be a Son to Me"?
verses.textEn: For to which of the angels did God ever say, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father" ? Or again, "I will be his Father, and he will be my Son" ?

verses.textZh: 神差遣长子到世上来的时候，又说： "神所有的天使都要拜他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神差遣长子到世上来的时候，又说： "神所有的天使都要拜他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 再者，神使长子到世上来的时候 ，就说：神的使者都要拜他。
verses.textEnNiv: And again, when God brings his firstborn into the world, he says, "Let all God’s angels worship him."
verses.textEnEsv: And again, when he brings the firstborn into the world, he says, "Let all God’s angels worship him."
verses.textEnNkjv: But when He again brings the firstborn into the world, He says: "Let all the angels of God worship Him."
verses.textEnNlt: And when he brought his supreme Son into the world, God said, "Let all of God’s angels worship him."
verses.textEnNasb: And when He again brings the firstborn into the world, He says, "And let all the angels of God worship Him."
verses.textEn: And again, when God brings his firstborn into the world, he says, "Let all God’s angels worship him."

verses.textZh: 论到天使，说： "神以他的天使为风， 以他的仆役为火焰。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到天使，说： "神以他的天使为风， 以他的仆役为火焰。"
verses.textZhCuv: 论到使者，又说：神以风为使者， 以火焰为仆役；
verses.textEnNiv: In speaking of the angels he says, "He makes his angels spirits, and his servants flames of fire."
verses.textEnEsv: Of the angels he says, "He makes his angels winds, and his ministers a flame of fire."
verses.textEnNkjv: And of the angels He says: "Who makes His angels spirits And His ministers a flame of fire."
verses.textEnNlt: Regarding the angels, he says, "He sends his angels like the winds, his servants like flames of fire."
verses.textEnNasb: And regarding the angels He says, "He makes His angels winds, And His ministers a flame of fire."
verses.textEn: In speaking of the angels he says, "He makes his angels spirits, and his servants flames of fire."

verses.textZh: 但是论到儿子，却说： "神啊！你的宝座是永永远远的， 你国的权杖，是公平的权杖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是论到儿子，却说： "神啊！你的宝座是永永远远的， 你国的权杖，是公平的权杖。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到子却说：神啊，你的宝座是永永远远的； 你的国权是正直的。
verses.textEnNiv: But about the Son he says, "Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever; a scepter of justice will be the scepter of your kingdom.
verses.textEnEsv: But of the Son he says, "Your throne, O God, is forever and ever, the scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your kingdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: But to the Son Hesays: "Your throne, O God, is forever and ever; A scepter of righteousness is the scepter of Your kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: But to the Son he says, "Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever. You rule with a scepter of justice.
verses.textEnNasb: But regarding the Son He says, "Your throne, God, is forever and ever, And the scepter of righteousness is the scepter of His kingdom.
verses.textEn: But about the Son he says, "Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever; a scepter of justice will be the scepter of your kingdom.

verses.textZh: 你喜爱公义，恨恶不法， 所以，神，就是你的神， 用喜乐的油膏抹你，胜过膏抹你的同伴。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你喜爱公义，恨恶不法， 所以，神，就是你的神， 用喜乐的油膏抹你，胜过膏抹你的同伴。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你喜爱公义，恨恶罪恶； 所以神，就是你的神，用喜乐油膏你， 胜过膏你的同伴；
verses.textEnNiv: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy."
verses.textEnEsv: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness beyond your companions."
verses.textEnNkjv: You have loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; Therefore God, Your God, has anointed You With the oil of gladness more than Your companions."
verses.textEnNlt: You love justice and hate evil. Therefore, O God, your God has anointed you, pouring out the oil of joy on you more than on anyone else."
verses.textEnNasb: "You have loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; Therefore God, Your God, has anointed You With the oil of joy above Your companions."
verses.textEn: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy."

verses.textZh: 又说： "主啊！你起初立了地的根基， 天也是你手的工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说： "主啊！你起初立了地的根基， 天也是你手的工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：主啊，你起初立了地的根基； 天也是你手所造的。
verses.textEnNiv: He also says, "In the beginning, Lord, you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
verses.textEnEsv: And, "You, Lord, laid the foundation of the earth in the beginning, and the heavens are the work of your hands;
verses.textEnNkjv: And: "You, Lord, in the beginning laid the foundation of the earth, And the heavens are the work of Your hands.
verses.textEnNlt: He also says to the Son, "In the beginning, Lord, you laid the foundation of the earth and made the heavens with your hands.
verses.textEnNasb: And, "You, Lord, in the beginning laid the foundation of the earth, And the heavens are the works of Your hands;
verses.textEn: He also says, "In the beginning, Lord, you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

verses.textZh: 天地都要毁灭，你却长存； 天地都要像衣服一样渐渐残旧，
verses.textZhCnvs: 天地都要毁灭，你却长存； 天地都要像衣服一样渐渐残旧，
verses.textZhCuv: 天地都要灭没，你却要长存。 天地都要像衣服渐渐旧了；
verses.textEnNiv: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment.
verses.textEnEsv: they will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment,
verses.textEnNkjv: They will perish, but You remain; And they will all grow old like a garment;
verses.textEnNlt: They will perish, but you remain forever. They will wear out like old clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: They will perish, but You remain; And they all will wear out like a garment,
verses.textEn: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment.

verses.textZh: 你要把天地像外套一样卷起来， 天地就像衣服一样被更换； 只有你永不改变， 你的年数也没有穷尽。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把天地像外套一样卷起来， 天地就像衣服一样被更换； 只有你永不改变， 你的年数也没有穷尽。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你要将天地卷起来，像一件外衣， 天地就都改变了。 惟有你永不改变； 你的年数没有穷尽。
verses.textEnNiv: You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed. But you remain the same, and your years will never end."
verses.textEnEsv: like a robe you will roll them up, like a garment they will be changed. But you are the same, and your years will have no end."
verses.textEnNkjv: Like a cloak You will fold them up, And they will be changed. But You are the same, And Your years will not fail."
verses.textEnNlt: You will fold them up like a cloak and discard them like old clothing. But you are always the same; you will live forever."
verses.textEnNasb: And like a robe You will roll them up; Like a garment they will also be changed. But You are the same, And Your years will not come to an end."
verses.textEn: You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed. But you remain the same, and your years will never end."

verses.textZh: 神可曾向哪一个天使说： "你坐在我的右边， 等我使你的仇敌作你的脚凳"呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神可曾向哪一个天使说： "你坐在我的右边， 等我使你的仇敌作你的脚凳"呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 所有的天使，神从来对哪一个说： 你坐在我的右边， 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳？
verses.textEnNiv: To which of the angels did God ever say, "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet" ?
verses.textEnEsv: And to which of the angels has he ever said, "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet"?
verses.textEnNkjv: But to which of the angels has He ever said: "Sit at My right hand, Till I make Your enemies Your footstool"?
verses.textEnNlt: And God never said to any of the angels, "Sit in the place of honor at my right hand until I humble your enemies, making them a footstool under your feet."
verses.textEnNasb: But to which of the angels has He ever said, "Sit at My right hand, Until I make Your enemies A footstool for Your feet"?
verses.textEn: To which of the angels did God ever say, "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet" ?

verses.textZh: 天使不都是服役的灵，奉差遣为那些要承受救恩的人效劳吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使不都是服役的灵，奉差遣为那些要承受救恩的人效劳吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 天使岂不都是服役的灵、奉差遣为那将要承受救恩的人效力吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Are not all angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?
verses.textEnEsv: Are they not all ministering spirits sent out to serve for the sake of those who are to inherit salvation?
verses.textEnNkjv: Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for those who will inherit salvation?
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, angels are only servants—spirits sent to care for people who will inherit salvation.
verses.textEnNasb: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent out to provide service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?
verses.textEn: Are not all angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?

verses.textZh: 因此，我们必须更加密切注意所听过的道理，免得我们随流失去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我们必须更加密切注意所听过的道理，免得我们随流失去。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我们当越发郑重所听见的道理，恐怕我们随流失去。
verses.textEnNiv: We must pay the most careful attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore we must pay much closer attention to what we have heard, lest we drift away from it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore we must give the more earnest heed to the things we have heard, lest we drift away.
verses.textEnNlt: So we must listen very carefully to the truth we have heard, or we may drift away from it.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason we must pay much closer attention to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away from it.
verses.textEn: We must pay the most careful attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.

verses.textZh: 那透过天使所传讲的信息既然是确定的，所有干犯和不听从的，都受了应得的报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那透过天使所传讲的信息既然是确定的，所有干犯和不听从的，都受了应得的报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 那藉着天使所传的话既是确定的；凡干犯悖逆的都受了该受的报应。
verses.textEnNiv: For since the message spoken through angels was binding, and every violation and disobedience received its just punishment,
verses.textEnEsv: For since the message declared by angels proved to be reliable, and every transgression or disobedience received a just retribution,
verses.textEnNkjv: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just reward,
verses.textEnNlt: For the message God delivered through angels has always stood firm, and every violation of the law and every act of disobedience was punished.
verses.textEnNasb: For if the word spoken through angels proved unalterable, and every violation and act of disobedience received a just punishment,
verses.textEn: For since the message spoken through angels was binding, and every violation and disobedience received its just punishment,

verses.textZh: 如果我们忽略了这么大的救恩，怎么能逃罪呢？这救恩起初是由主亲自宣讲的，后来听见的人给我们证实了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们忽略了这么大的救恩，怎么能逃罪呢？这救恩起初是由主亲自宣讲的，后来听见的人给我们证实了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若忽略这么大的救恩，怎能逃罪呢？这救恩起先是主亲自讲的，后来是听见的人给我们证实了。
verses.textEnNiv: how shall we escape if we ignore so great a salvation? This salvation, which was first announced by the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard him.
verses.textEnEsv: how shall we escape if we neglect such a great salvation? It was declared at first by the Lord, and it was attested to us by those who heard,
verses.textEnNkjv: how shall we escape if we neglect so great a salvation, which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed to us by those who heard Him,
verses.textEnNlt: So what makes us think we can escape if we ignore this great salvation that was first announced by the Lord Jesus himself and then delivered to us by those who heard him speak?
verses.textEnNasb: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation? After it was at first spoken through the Lord, it was confirmed to us by those who heard,
verses.textEn: how shall we escape if we ignore so great a salvation? This salvation, which was first announced by the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard him.

verses.textZh: 神又照着自己的旨意，用神迹、奇事和各样异能，以及圣灵的恩赐，与他们一同作见证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神又照着自己的旨意，用神迹、奇事和各样异能，以及圣灵的恩赐，与他们一同作见证。
verses.textZhCuv: 神又按自己的旨意，用神迹、奇事和百般的异能，并圣灵的恩赐，同他们作见证。
verses.textEnNiv: God also testified to it by signs, wonders and various miracles, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to his will.
verses.textEnEsv: while God also bore witness by signs and wonders and various miracles and by gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to his will.
verses.textEnNkjv: God also bearing witness both with signs and wonders, with various miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to His own will?
verses.textEnNlt: And God confirmed the message by giving signs and wonders and various miracles and gifts of the Holy Spirit whenever he chose.
verses.textEnNasb: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, and by various miracles and by gifts of the Holy Spirit according to His own will.
verses.textEn: God also testified to it by signs, wonders and various miracles, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to his will.

verses.textZh: 神并没有把我们所说的"将来的世界"，交给天使管辖；
verses.textZhCnvs: 神并没有把我们所说的"将来的世界"，交给天使管辖；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们所说将来的世界，神原没有交给天使管辖。
verses.textEnNiv: It is not to angels that he has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.
verses.textEnEsv: For it was not to angels that God subjected the world to come, of which we are speaking.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He has not put the world to come, of which we speak, in subjection to angels.
verses.textEnNlt: And furthermore, it is not angels who will control the future world we are talking about.
verses.textEnNasb: For He did not subject to angels the world to come, about which we are speaking.
verses.textEn: It is not to angels that he has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.

verses.textZh: 但是有人在圣经上某一处证实说： "人算甚么，你竟记念他？ 世人算甚么，你竟眷顾他？
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是有人在圣经上某一处证实说： "人算甚么，你竟记念他？ 世人算甚么，你竟眷顾他？
verses.textZhCuv: 但有人在经上某处证明说： 人算什么，你竟顾念他？ 世人算什么，你竟眷顾他？
verses.textEnNiv: But there is a place where someone has testified: "What is mankind that you are mindful of them, a son of man that you care for him?
verses.textEnEsv: It has been testified somewhere, "What is man, that you are mindful of him, or the son of man, that you care for him?
verses.textEnNkjv: But one testified in a certain place, saying: "What is man that You are mindful of him, Or the son of man that You take care of him?
verses.textEnNlt: For in one place the Scriptures say, "What are mere mortals that you should think about them, or a son of man that you should care for him?
verses.textEnNasb: But someone has testified somewhere, saying, "What is man, that You think of him? Or a son of man, that You are concerned about him?
verses.textEn: But there is a place where someone has testified: "What is mankind that you are mindful of them, a son of man that you care for him?

verses.textZh: 你使他暂时成了比天使卑微 ， 却赐给他荣耀尊贵作冠冕，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使他暂时成了比天使卑微 ， 却赐给他荣耀尊贵作冠冕，
verses.textZhCuv: 你叫他比天使微小一点 ， 赐他荣耀尊贵为冠冕， 并将你手所造的都派他管理，
verses.textEnNiv: You made them a little lower than the angels; you crowned them with glory and honor
verses.textEnEsv: You made him for a little while lower than the angels; you have crowned him with glory and honor,
verses.textEnNkjv: You have made him a little lower than the angels; You have crowned him with glory and honor, And set him over the works of Your hands.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet for a little while you made them a little lower than the angels and crowned them with glory and honor.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have made him for a little while lower than angels; You have crowned him with glory and honor ;
verses.textEn: You made them a little lower than the angels; you crowned them with glory and honor

verses.textZh: 使万物都服在他的脚下。" 既然万有都服了他，就没有剩下一样不服他的了。但是现在我们还没有看见万有都服他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使万物都服在他的脚下。" 既然万有都服了他，就没有剩下一样不服他的了。但是现在我们还没有看见万有都服他。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫万物都服在他的脚下。 既叫万物都服他，就没有剩下一样不服他的。只是如今我们还不见万物都服他。
verses.textEnNiv: and put everything under their feet." In putting everything under them, God left nothing that is not subject to them. Yet at present we do not see everything subject to them.
verses.textEnEsv: putting everything in subjection under his feet." Now in putting everything in subjection to him, he left nothing outside his control. At present, we do not yet see everything in subjection to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have put all things in subjection under his feet." For in that He put all in subjection under him, He left nothing thatis not put under him. But now we do not yet see all things put under him.
verses.textEnNlt: You gave them authority over all things." Now when it says "all things," it means nothing is left out. But we have not yet seen all things put under their authority.
verses.textEnNasb: You have put everything in subjection under his feet." For in subjecting all things to him, He left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we do not yet see all things subjected to him.
verses.textEn: and put everything under their feet." In putting everything under them, God left nothing that is not subject to them. Yet at present we do not see everything subject to them.

verses.textZh: 不过，我们看见那位暂时成了比天使卑微 的耶稣，因为受了死的痛苦，就得了荣耀尊贵作冠冕，好叫他因着神的恩典，为万人尝了死味。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过，我们看见那位暂时成了比天使卑微 的耶稣，因为受了死的痛苦，就得了荣耀尊贵作冠冕，好叫他因着神的恩典，为万人尝了死味。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独见那成为比天使小一点的耶稣 ；因为受死的苦，就得了尊贵荣耀为冠冕，叫他因着神的恩，为人人尝了死味。
verses.textEnNiv: But we do see Jesus, who was made lower than the angels for a little while, now crowned with glory and honor because he suffered death, so that by the grace of God he might taste death for everyone.
verses.textEnEsv: But we see him who for a little while was made lower than the angels, namely Jesus, crowned with glory and honor because of the suffering of death, so that by the grace of God he might taste death for everyone.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, for the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that He, by the grace of God, might taste death for everyone.
verses.textEnNlt: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was given a position "a little lower than the angels"; and because he suffered death for us, he is now "crowned with glory and honor." Yes, by God’s grace, Jesus tasted death for everyone.
verses.textEnNasb: But we do see Him who was made for a little while lower than the angels, namely, Jesus, because of His suffering death crowned with glory and honor, so that by the grace of God He might taste death for everyone.
verses.textEn: But we do see Jesus, who was made lower than the angels for a little while, now crowned with glory and honor because he suffered death, so that by the grace of God he might taste death for everyone.

verses.textZh: 万有因他而有、藉他而造的那位，为了要带领许多儿子进入荣耀里去，使救他们的元首借着受苦而得到成全，本是合适的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万有因他而有、藉他而造的那位，为了要带领许多儿子进入荣耀里去，使救他们的元首借着受苦而得到成全，本是合适的。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来那为万物所属、为万物所本的，要领许多的儿子进荣耀里去，使救他们的元帅，因受苦难得以完全，本是合宜的。
verses.textEnNiv: In bringing many sons and daughters to glory, it was fitting that God, for whom and through whom everything exists, should make the pioneer of their salvation perfect through what he suffered.
verses.textEnEsv: For it was fitting that he, for whom and by whom all things exist, in bringing many sons to glory, should make the founder of their salvation perfect through suffering.
verses.textEnNkjv: For it was fitting for Him, for whom are all things and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons to glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.textEnNlt: God, for whom and through whom everything was made, chose to bring many children into glory. And it was only right that he should make Jesus, through his suffering, a perfect leader, fit to bring them into their salvation.
verses.textEnNasb: For it was fitting for Him, for whom are all things, and through whom are all things, in bringing many sons to glory, to perfect the originator of their salvation through sufferings.
verses.textEn: In bringing many sons and daughters to glory, it was fitting that God, for whom and through whom everything exists, should make the pioneer of their salvation perfect through what he suffered.

verses.textZh: 因为那位使人成圣的，和那些得到成圣的，同是出于一个源头；所以他称他们为弟兄也不以为耻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那位使人成圣的，和那些得到成圣的，同是出于一个源头；所以他称他们为弟兄也不以为耻。
verses.textZhCuv: 因那使人成圣的和那些得以成圣的，都是出于一。所以，他称他们为弟兄也不以为耻，
verses.textEnNiv: Both the one who makes people holy and those who are made holy are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnEsv: For he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified all have one source. That is why he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
verses.textEnNkjv: For both He who sanctifies and those who are being sanctified are all of one, for which reason He is not ashamed to call them brethren,
verses.textEnNlt: So now Jesus and the ones he makes holy have the same Father. That is why Jesus is not ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnNasb: For both He who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one Father; for this reason He is not ashamed to call them brothers and sisters,
verses.textEn: Both the one who makes people holy and those who are made holy are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers and sisters.

verses.textZh: 他说： "我要向我的弟兄宣扬你的名， 我要在聚会中歌颂你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说： "我要向我的弟兄宣扬你的名， 我要在聚会中歌颂你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说： 我要将你的名传与我的弟兄， 在会中我要颂扬你；
verses.textEnNiv: He says, "I will declare your name to my brothers and sisters; in the assembly I will sing your praises."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "I will tell of your name to my brothers; in the midst of the congregation I will sing your praise."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying: "I will declare Your name to My brethren; In the midst of the assembly I will sing praise to You."
verses.textEnNlt: For he said to God, "I will proclaim your name to my brothers and sisters. I will praise you among your assembled people."
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "I will proclaim Your name to My brothers, In the midst of the assembly I will sing Your praise."
verses.textEn: He says, "I will declare your name to my brothers and sisters; in the assembly I will sing your praises."

verses.textZh: 又说： "我要信靠他。" 又说： "看哪，我和神所赐给我的孩子们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说： "我要信靠他。" 又说： "看哪，我和神所赐给我的孩子们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说： 我要倚赖他； 又说： 看哪，我与神所给我的儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: And again, "I will put my trust in him." And again he says, "Here am I, and the children God has given me."
verses.textEnEsv: And again, "I will put my trust in him." And again, "Behold, I and the children God has given me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And again: "I will put My trust in Him." And again: "Here am I and the children whom God has given Me."
verses.textEnNlt: He also said, "I will put my trust in him," that is, "I and the children God has given me."
verses.textEnNasb: And again, "I will put My trust in Him." And again, "Behold, I and the children whom God has given Me."
verses.textEn: And again, "I will put my trust in him." And again he says, "Here am I, and the children God has given me."

verses.textZh: 孩子们既然同有血肉之体，他自己也照样成为血肉之体，为要借着死，消灭那掌握死权的魔鬼，
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们既然同有血肉之体，他自己也照样成为血肉之体，为要借着死，消灭那掌握死权的魔鬼，
verses.textZhCuv: 儿女既同有血肉之体，他也照样亲自成了血肉之体，特要藉着死败坏那掌死权的，就是魔鬼，
verses.textEnNiv: Since the children have flesh and blood, he too shared in their humanity so that by his death he might break the power of him who holds the power of death—that is, the devil—
verses.textEnEsv: Since therefore the children share in flesh and blood, he himself likewise partook of the same things, that through death he might destroy the one who has the power of death, that is, the devil,
verses.textEnNkjv: Inasmuch then as the children have partaken of flesh and blood, He Himself likewise shared in the same, that through death He might destroy him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,
verses.textEnNlt: Because God’s children are human beings—made of flesh and blood—the Son also became flesh and blood. For only as a human being could he die, and only by dying could he break the power of the devil, who had the power of death.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, since the children share in flesh and blood, He Himself likewise also partook of the same, so that through death He might destroy the one who has the power of death, that is, the devil,
verses.textEn: Since the children have flesh and blood, he too shared in their humanity so that by his death he might break the power of him who holds the power of death—that is, the devil—

verses.textZh: 并且要释放那些因为怕死而终身作奴仆的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且要释放那些因为怕死而终身作奴仆的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 并要释放那些一生因怕死而为奴仆的人。
verses.textEnNiv: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.
verses.textEnEsv: and deliver all those who through fear of death were subject to lifelong slavery.
verses.textEnNkjv: and release those who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.textEnNlt: Only in this way could he set free all who have lived their lives as slaves to the fear of dying.
verses.textEnNasb: and free those who through fear of death were subject to slavery all their lives.
verses.textEn: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.

verses.textZh: 其实，他并没有救援天使，只救援亚伯拉罕的后裔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实，他并没有救援天使，只救援亚伯拉罕的后裔。
verses.textZhCuv: 他并不救拔天使，乃是救拔亚伯拉罕的后裔。
verses.textEnNiv: For surely it is not angels he helps, but Abraham’s descendants.
verses.textEnEsv: For surely it is not angels that he helps, but he helps the offspring of Abraham.
verses.textEnNkjv: For indeed He does not give aid to angels, but He does give aid to the seed of Abraham.
verses.textEnNlt: We also know that the Son did not come to help angels; he came to help the descendants of Abraham.
verses.textEnNasb: For clearly He does not give help to angels, but He gives help to the descendants of Abraham.
verses.textEn: For surely it is not angels he helps, but Abraham’s descendants.

verses.textZh: 所以，他必须在各方面和他的弟兄们相同，为了要在神的事上，成为仁慈忠信的大祭司，好为人民赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，他必须在各方面和他的弟兄们相同，为了要在神的事上，成为仁慈忠信的大祭司，好为人民赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，他凡事该与他的弟兄相同，为要在神的事上成为慈悲忠信的大祭司，为百姓的罪献上挽回祭。
verses.textEnNiv: For this reason he had to be made like them, fully human in every way, in order that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, and that he might make atonement for the sins of the people.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore he had to be made like his brothers in every respect, so that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in the service of God, to make propitiation for the sins of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, in all things He had to be made like His brethren, that He might be a merciful and faithful High Priest in things pertaining to God, to make propitiation for the sins of the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, it was necessary for him to be made in every respect like us, his brothers and sisters, so that he could be our merciful and faithful High Priest before God. Then he could offer a sacrifice that would take away the sins of the people.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, in all things He had to be made like His brothers so that He might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make propitiation for the sins of the people.
verses.textEn: For this reason he had to be made like them, fully human in every way, in order that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, and that he might make atonement for the sins of the people.

verses.textZh: 因为他自己既然经过试探，受了苦，就能够帮助那些被试探的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他自己既然经过试探，受了苦，就能够帮助那些被试探的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他自己既然被试探而受苦，就能搭救被试探的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Because he himself suffered when he was tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.
verses.textEnEsv: For because he himself has suffered when tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in that He Himself has suffered, being tempted, He is able to aid those who are tempted.
verses.textEnNlt: Since he himself has gone through suffering and testing, he is able to help us when we are being tested.
verses.textEnNasb: For since He Himself was tempted in that which He has suffered, He is able to come to the aid of those who are tempted.
verses.textEn: Because he himself suffered when he was tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.

verses.textZh: 因此，同蒙天召的圣洁的弟兄啊！你们应该想想耶稣，就是作使徒、作我们所宣认的大祭司的那一位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，同蒙天召的圣洁的弟兄啊！你们应该想想耶稣，就是作使徒、作我们所宣认的大祭司的那一位。
verses.textZhCuv: 同蒙天召的圣洁弟兄啊，你们应当思想我们所认为使者、为大祭司的耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, holy brothers and sisters, who share in the heavenly calling, fix your thoughts on Jesus, whom we acknowledge as our apostle and high priest.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, holy brothers, you who share in a heavenly calling, consider Jesus, the apostle and high priest of our confession,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNlt: And so, dear brothers and sisters who belong to God and are partners with those called to heaven, think carefully about this Jesus whom we declare to be God’s messenger and High Priest.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, holy brothers and sisters, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus;
verses.textEn: Therefore, holy brothers and sisters, who share in the heavenly calling, fix your thoughts on Jesus, whom we acknowledge as our apostle and high priest.

verses.textZh: 他忠于那位委派他的，好象摩西在神的全家尽忠一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他忠于那位委派他的，好象摩西在神的全家尽忠一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他为那设立他的尽忠，如同摩西在神的全家尽忠一样。
verses.textEnNiv: He was faithful to the one who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house.
verses.textEnEsv: who was faithful to him who appointed him, just as Moses also was faithful in all God’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: who was faithful to Him who appointed Him, as Moses also wasfaithful in all His house.
verses.textEnNlt: For he was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses served faithfully when he was entrusted with God’s entire house.
verses.textEnNasb: He was faithful to Him who appointed Him, as Moses also was in all His house.
verses.textEn: He was faithful to the one who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house.

verses.textZh: 他比摩西配得更大的荣耀，好象建造房屋的人比房屋配得更大的尊贵一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他比摩西配得更大的荣耀，好象建造房屋的人比房屋配得更大的尊贵一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他比摩西算是更配多得荣耀，好像建造房屋的比房屋更尊荣；
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus has been found worthy of greater honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.
verses.textEnEsv: For Jesus has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses—as much more glory as the builder of a house has more honor than the house itself.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this One has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as He who built the house has more honor than the house.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus deserves far more glory than Moses, just as a person who builds a house deserves more praise than the house itself.
verses.textEnNasb: For He has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, by just so much as the builder of the house has more honor than the house.
verses.textEn: Jesus has been found worthy of greater honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.

verses.textZh: 因为每一间房屋都是人建造的，只有万物是神建造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为每一间房屋都是人建造的，只有万物是神建造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为房屋都必有人建造，但建造万物的就是神。
verses.textEnNiv: For every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.
verses.textEnEsv: (For every house is built by someone, but the builder of all things is God.)
verses.textEnNkjv: For every house is built by someone, but He who built all things is God.
verses.textEnNlt: For every house has a builder, but the one who built everything is God.
verses.textEnNasb: For every house is built by someone, but the builder of all things is God.
verses.textEn: For every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.

verses.textZh: 摩西不过是个仆人，在神的全家尽忠，为以后要传讲的事作证；
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西不过是个仆人，在神的全家尽忠，为以后要传讲的事作证；
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西为仆人，在神的全家诚然尽忠，为要证明将来必传说的事。
verses.textEnNiv: "Moses was faithful as a servant in all God’s house," bearing witness to what would be spoken by God in the future.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Moses was faithful in all God’s house as a servant, to testify to the things that were to be spoken later,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses indeed was faithful in all His house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which would be spoken afterward,
verses.textEnNlt: Moses was certainly faithful in God’s house as a servant. His work was an illustration of the truths God would reveal later.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Moses was faithful in all God’s house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken later;
verses.textEn: "Moses was faithful as a servant in all God’s house," bearing witness to what would be spoken by God in the future.

verses.textZh: 但是基督却是儿子，管理自己的家。如果我们把坦然无惧的心和可夸的盼望持守到底，我们就是他的家了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是基督却是儿子，管理自己的家。如果我们把坦然无惧的心和可夸的盼望持守到底，我们就是他的家了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但基督为儿子，治理神的家；我们若将可夸的盼望和胆量坚持到底，便是他的家了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house. And we are his house, if indeed we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope in which we glory.
verses.textEnEsv: but Christ is faithful over God’s house as a son. And we are his house, if indeed we hold fast our confidence and our boasting in our hope.
verses.textEnNkjv: but Christ as a Son over His own house, whose house we are if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm to the end.
verses.textEnNlt: But Christ, as the Son, is in charge of God’s entire house. And we are God’s house, if we keep our courage and remain confident in our hope in Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: but Christ was faithful as a Son over His house—whose house we are, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the boast of our hope.
verses.textEn: But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house. And we are his house, if indeed we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope in which we glory.

verses.textZh: 所以，就像圣灵所说的： "如果你们今天听从他的声音，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，就像圣灵所说的： "如果你们今天听从他的声音，
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵有话说： 你们今日若听他的话，
verses.textEnNiv: So, as the Holy Spirit says: "Today, if you hear his voice,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says, "Today, if you hear his voice,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says: "Today, if you will hear His voice,
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the Holy Spirit says, "Today when you hear his voice,
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, just as the Holy Spirit says, "Today if you hear His voice,
verses.textEn: So, as the Holy Spirit says: "Today, if you hear his voice,

verses.textZh: 就不要硬着心， 好象在旷野惹他发怒、 试探他的日子一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就不要硬着心， 好象在旷野惹他发怒、 试探他的日子一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 就不可硬着心， 像在旷野惹他发怒、 试探他的时候一样。
verses.textEnNiv: do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion, during the time of testing in the wilderness,
verses.textEnEsv: do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion, on the day of testing in the wilderness,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion, In the day of trial in the wilderness,
verses.textEnNlt: don’t harden your hearts as Israel did when they rebelled, when they tested me in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not harden your hearts as when they provoked Me, As on the day of trial in the wilderness,
verses.textEn: do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion, during the time of testing in the wilderness,

verses.textZh: 在那里，你们的祖先以试验来试探我， 观看我的作为有四十年之久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里，你们的祖先以试验来试探我， 观看我的作为有四十年之久。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里，你们的祖宗试我探我， 并且观看我的作为有四十年之久。
verses.textEnNiv: where your ancestors tested and tried me, though for forty years they saw what I did.
verses.textEnEsv: where your fathers put me to the test and saw my works for forty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Where your fathers tested Me, tried Me, And saw My works forty years.
verses.textEnNlt: There your ancestors tested and tried my patience, even though they saw my miracles for forty years.
verses.textEnNasb: Where your fathers putMe to the test, And saw My works for forty years.
verses.textEn: where your ancestors tested and tried me, though for forty years they saw what I did.

verses.textZh: 所以，我向那个世代的人发怒，说：‘他们心里常常迷误， 不认识我的道路。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我向那个世代的人发怒，说：‘他们心里常常迷误， 不认识我的道路。’
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我厌烦那世代的人，说： 他们心里常常迷糊， 竟不晓得我的作为！
verses.textEnNiv: That is why I was angry with that generation; I said, ‘Their hearts are always going astray, and they have not known my ways.’
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I was provoked with that generation, and said, ‘They always go astray in their heart; they have not known my ways.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I was angry with that generation, And said, ‘They always go astray in their heart, And they have not known My ways.’
verses.textEnNlt: So I was angry with them, and I said, ‘Their hearts always turn away from me. They refuse to do what I tell them.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore I was angry with this generation, And said, ‘They always go astray in their heart, And they did not know My ways’;
verses.textEn: That is why I was angry with that generation; I said, ‘Their hearts are always going astray, and they have not known my ways.’

verses.textZh: 我就在烈怒中起誓，说： ‘他们绝不可进入我的安息。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就在烈怒中起誓，说： ‘他们绝不可进入我的安息。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就在怒中起誓说： 他们断不可进入我的安息。
verses.textEnNiv: So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They shall not enter my rest.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: So I swore in My wrath, ‘They shall not enter My rest.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: So in my anger I took an oath: ‘They will never enter my place of rest.’"
verses.textEnNasb: As I swore in My anger, ‘They certainly shall not enter My rest.’ "
verses.textEn: So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ "

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，你们要小心，免得你们中间有人存着邪恶、不信的心，以致离弃了永活的神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，你们要小心，免得你们中间有人存着邪恶、不信的心，以致离弃了永活的神；
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，你们要谨慎，免得你们中间或有人存着不信的恶心，把永生神离弃了。
verses.textEnNiv: See to it, brothers and sisters, that none of you has a sinful, unbelieving heart that turns away from the living God.
verses.textEnEsv: Take care, brothers, lest there be in any of you an evil, unbelieving heart, leading you to fall away from the living God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beware, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief in departing from the living God;
verses.textEnNlt: Be careful then, dear brothers and sisters. Make sure that your own hearts are not evil and unbelieving, turning you away from the living God.
verses.textEnNasb: Take care, brothers and sisters, that there will not be in any one of you an evil, unbelieving heart that falls away from the living God.
verses.textEn: See to it, brothers and sisters, that none of you has a sinful, unbelieving heart that turns away from the living God.

verses.textZh: 趁着还有叫作"今天"的时候，总要天天互相劝勉，免得你们中间有人受了罪恶的诱惑，心里就刚硬了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 趁着还有叫作"今天"的时候，总要天天互相劝勉，免得你们中间有人受了罪恶的诱惑，心里就刚硬了。
verses.textZhCuv: 总要趁着还有今日，天天彼此相劝，免得你们中间有人被罪迷惑，心里就刚硬了。
verses.textEnNiv: But encourage one another daily, as long as it is called "Today," so that none of you may be hardened by sin’s deceitfulness.
verses.textEnEsv: But exhort one another every day, as long as it is called "today," that none of you may be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: but exhort one another daily, while it is called "Today," lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.textEnNlt: You must warn each other every day, while it is still "today," so that none of you will be deceived by sin and hardened against God.
verses.textEnNasb: But encourage one another every day, as long as it is still called "today," so that none of you will be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.textEn: But encourage one another daily, as long as it is called "Today," so that none of you may be hardened by sin’s deceitfulness.

verses.textZh: 如果我们把起初的信念坚持到底，就是有分于基督的人了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们把起初的信念坚持到底，就是有分于基督的人了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若将起初确实的信心坚持到底，就在基督里有分了。
verses.textEnNiv: We have come to share in Christ, if indeed we hold our original conviction firmly to the very end.
verses.textEnEsv: For we have come to share in Christ, if indeed we hold our original confidence firm to the end.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we have become partakers of Christ if we hold the beginning of our confidence steadfast to the end,
verses.textEnNlt: For if we are faithful to the end, trusting God just as firmly as when we first believed, we will share in all that belongs to Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For we have become partakers of Christ if we keep the beginning of our commitment firm until the end,
verses.textEn: We have come to share in Christ, if indeed we hold our original conviction firmly to the very end.

verses.textZh: 经上说： "如果你们今天听从他的声音， 就不要硬着心， 像惹他发怒的时候一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 经上说： "如果你们今天听从他的声音， 就不要硬着心， 像惹他发怒的时候一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 经上说：「你们今日若听他的话，就不可硬着心，像惹他发怒的日子一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: As has just been said: "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion."
verses.textEnEsv: As it is said, "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion."
verses.textEnNkjv: while it is said: "Today, if you will hear His voice, Do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion."
verses.textEnNlt: Remember what it says: "Today when you hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts as Israel did when they rebelled."
verses.textEnNasb: while it is said, "Today if you hear His voice, Do not harden your hearts, as when they provoked Me."
verses.textEn: As has just been said: "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion."

verses.textZh: 那时，听了他的话而惹他发怒的是谁呢？不就是摩西从埃及领出来的那些人吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，听了他的话而惹他发怒的是谁呢？不就是摩西从埃及领出来的那些人吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，听见他话惹他发怒的是谁呢？岂不是跟着摩西从埃及出来的众人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Who were they who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?
verses.textEnEsv: For who were those who heard and yet rebelled? Was it not all those who left Egypt led by Moses?
verses.textEnNkjv: For who, having heard, rebelled? Indeed, wasit not all who came out of Egypt, led by Moses?
verses.textEnNlt: And who was it who rebelled against God, even though they heard his voice? Wasn’t it the people Moses led out of Egypt?
verses.textEnNasb: For who provoked Him when they had heard? Indeed, did not all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?
verses.textEn: Who were they who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?

verses.textZh: 四十年之久，神向谁发怒呢？不就是向那些犯了罪陈尸旷野的人吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 四十年之久，神向谁发怒呢？不就是向那些犯了罪陈尸旷野的人吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 神四十年之久，又厌烦谁呢？岂不是那些犯罪、尸首倒在旷野的人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: And with whom was he angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies perished in the wilderness?
verses.textEnEsv: And with whom was he provoked for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now with whom was He angry forty years? Wasit not with those who sinned, whose corpses fell in the wilderness?
verses.textEnNlt: And who made God angry for forty years? Wasn’t it the people who sinned, whose corpses lay in the wilderness?
verses.textEnNasb: And with whom was He angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose dead bodies fell in the wilderness?
verses.textEn: And with whom was he angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies perished in the wilderness?

verses.textZh: 他又向谁起誓说，他们绝对不可以进入他的安息呢？不就是向那些不顺从的人吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又向谁起誓说，他们绝对不可以进入他的安息呢？不就是向那些不顺从的人吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 又向谁起誓，不容他们进入他的安息呢？岂不是向那些不信从的人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: And to whom did God swear that they would never enter his rest if not to those who disobeyed?
verses.textEnEsv: And to whom did he swear that they would not enter his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
verses.textEnNkjv: And to whom did He swear that they would not enter His rest, but to those who did not obey?
verses.textEnNlt: And to whom was God speaking when he took an oath that they would never enter his rest? Wasn’t it the people who disobeyed him?
verses.textEnNasb: And to whom did He swear that they would not enter His rest, but to those who were disobedient?
verses.textEn: And to whom did God swear that they would never enter his rest if not to those who disobeyed?

verses.textZh: 这样看来，他们不能进入安息，是因为不信的缘故。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样看来，他们不能进入安息，是因为不信的缘故。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样看来，他们不能进入安息是因为不信的缘故了。
verses.textEnNiv: So we see that they were not able to enter, because of their unbelief.
verses.textEnEsv: So we see that they were unable to enter because of unbelief.
verses.textEnNkjv: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
verses.textEnNlt: So we see that because of their unbelief they were not able to enter his rest.
verses.textEnNasb: And so we see that they were not able to enter because of unbelief.
verses.textEn: So we see that they were not able to enter, because of their unbelief.

verses.textZh: 所以，那进入安息的应许，既然还给我们留着，我们就应该战战兢兢，恐怕我们中间有人像是被淘汰了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，那进入安息的应许，既然还给我们留着，我们就应该战战兢兢，恐怕我们中间有人像是被淘汰了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既蒙留下，有进入他安息的应许，就当畏惧，免得我们 中间或有人似乎是赶不上了。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, since the promise of entering his rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be found to have fallen short of it.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, while the promise of entering his rest still stands, let us fear lest any of you should seem to have failed to reach it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, since a promise remains of entering His rest, let us fear lest any of you seem to have come short of it.
verses.textEnNlt: God’s promise of entering his rest still stands, so we ought to tremble with fear that some of you might fail to experience it.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, we must fear if, while a promise remains of entering His rest, any one of you may seem to have come short of it.
verses.textEn: Therefore, since the promise of entering his rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be found to have fallen short of it.

verses.textZh: 因为有福音传给我们，像传给他们一样，只是他们所听见的道，对他们没有益处，因为他们没有用信心与所听见的打成一片 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有福音传给我们，像传给他们一样，只是他们所听见的道，对他们没有益处，因为他们没有用信心与所听见的打成一片 。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有福音传给我们，像传给他们一样；只是所听见的道与他们无益，因为他们没有信心与所听见的道调和。
verses.textEnNiv: For we also have had the good news proclaimed to us, just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, because they did not share the faith of those who obeyed.
verses.textEnEsv: For good news came to us just as to them, but the message they heard did not benefit them, because they were not united by faith with those who listened.
verses.textEnNkjv: For indeed the gospel was preached to us as well as to them; but the word which they heard did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in those who heard it.
verses.textEnNlt: For this good news—that God has prepared this rest—has been announced to us just as it was to them. But it did them no good because they didn’t share the faith of those who listened to God.
verses.textEnNasb: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, just as they also did; but the word they heard did not benefit them, because they were not united with those who listened with faith.
verses.textEn: For we also have had the good news proclaimed to us, just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, because they did not share the faith of those who obeyed.

verses.textZh: 然而我们信了的人，就可以进入那安息。正如神所说： "我在烈怒中起誓说， 他们绝不可进入我的安息！" 其实神的工作，从创立世界以来已经完成了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而我们信了的人，就可以进入那安息。正如神所说： "我在烈怒中起誓说， 他们绝不可进入我的安息！" 其实神的工作，从创立世界以来已经完成了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我们已经相信的人得以进入那安息，正如神所说：「我在怒中起誓说：『他们断不可进入我的安息！』」其实造物之工，从创世以来已经成全了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now we who have believed enter that rest, just as God has said, "So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ " And yet his works have been finished since the creation of the world.
verses.textEnEsv: For we who have believed enter that rest, as he has said, "As I swore in my wrath, ‘They shall not enter my rest,’" although his works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we who have believed do enter that rest, as He has said: "So I swore in My wrath, ‘They shall not enter My rest,’ " although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.textEnNlt: For only we who believe can enter his rest. As for the others, God said, "In my anger I took an oath: ‘They will never enter my place of rest,’" even though this rest has been ready since he made the world.
verses.textEnNasb: For we who have believed enter that rest, just as He has said, "As I swore in My anger, They certainly shall not enter My rest," although His works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.textEn: Now we who have believed enter that rest, just as God has said, "So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ " And yet his works have been finished since the creation of the world.

verses.textZh: 因为论到第七日，他在圣经某一处说："在第七日神歇了他的一切工作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为论到第七日，他在圣经某一处说："在第七日神歇了他的一切工作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 论到第七日，有一处说：「到第七日，神就歇了他一切的工。」
verses.textEnNiv: For somewhere he has spoken about the seventh day in these words: "On the seventh day God rested from all his works."
verses.textEnEsv: For he has somewhere spoken of the seventh day in this way: "And God rested on the seventh day from all his works."
verses.textEnNkjv: For He has spoken in a certain place of the seventh day in this way: "And God rested on the seventh day from all His works";
verses.textEnNlt: We know it is ready because of the place in the Scriptures where it mentions the seventh day: "On the seventh day God rested from all his work."
verses.textEnNasb: For He has said somewhere concerning the seventh day: "And God rested on the seventh day from all His works";
verses.textEn: For somewhere he has spoken about the seventh day in these words: "On the seventh day God rested from all his works."

verses.textZh: 但在这里又说："他们绝不可进入我的安息。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但在这里又说："他们绝不可进入我的安息。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一处说：「他们断不可进入我的安息！」
verses.textEnNiv: And again in the passage above he says, "They shall never enter my rest."
verses.textEnEsv: And again in this passage he said, "They shall not enter my rest."
verses.textEnNkjv: and again in this place: "They shall not enter My rest."
verses.textEnNlt: But in the other passage God said, "They will never enter my place of rest."
verses.textEnNasb: and again in this passage, "They certainly shall not enter My rest."
verses.textEn: And again in the passage above he says, "They shall never enter my rest."

verses.textZh: 既然这安息还留着要让一些人进去，但那些以前听过福音的人，因为不顺从不得进去；
verses.textZhCnvs: 既然这安息还留着要让一些人进去，但那些以前听过福音的人，因为不顺从不得进去；
verses.textZhCuv: 既有必进安息的人，那先前听见福音的，因为不信从，不得进去。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore since it still remains for some to enter that rest, and since those who formerly had the good news proclaimed to them did not go in because of their disobedience,
verses.textEnEsv: Since therefore it remains for some to enter it, and those who formerly received the good news failed to enter because of disobedience,
verses.textEnNkjv: Since therefore it remains that some must enter it, and those to whom it was first preached did not enter because of disobedience,
verses.textEnNlt: So God’s rest is there for people to enter, but those who first heard this good news failed to enter because they disobeyed God.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, since it remains for some to enter it, and those who previously had good news preached to them failed to enter because of disobedience,
verses.textEn: Therefore since it still remains for some to enter that rest, and since those who formerly had the good news proclaimed to them did not go in because of their disobedience,

verses.textZh: 所以神就再定一个日子，就是过了很久以后，借着大卫所说的"今天"，就像前面引用过的： "如果你们今天听从他的声音， 就不要硬着心。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以神就再定一个日子，就是过了很久以后，借着大卫所说的"今天"，就像前面引用过的： "如果你们今天听从他的声音， 就不要硬着心。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以过了多年，就在大卫的书上，又限定一日，如以上所引的说：「你们今日若听他的话，就不可硬着心。」
verses.textEnNiv: God again set a certain day, calling it "Today." This he did when a long time later he spoke through David, as in the passage already quoted: "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts."
verses.textEnEsv: again he appoints a certain day, "Today," saying through David so long afterward, in the words already quoted, "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts."
verses.textEnNkjv: again He designates a certain day, saying in David, "Today," after such a long time, as it has been said: "Today, if you will hear His voice, Do not harden your hearts."
verses.textEnNlt: So God set another time for entering his rest, and that time is today. God announced this through David much later in the words already quoted: "Today when you hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts."
verses.textEnNasb: He again sets a certain day, "Today," saying through David after so long a time just as has been said before, "Today if you hear His voice, Do not harden your hearts."
verses.textEn: God again set a certain day, calling it "Today." This he did when a long time later he spoke through David, as in the passage already quoted: "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts."

verses.textZh: 如果约书亚已经使他们享受了安息，神后来就不会再提到别的日子了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果约书亚已经使他们享受了安息，神后来就不会再提到别的日子了。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是约书亚已叫他们享了安息，后来神就不再提别的日子了。
verses.textEnNiv: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.
verses.textEnEsv: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken of another day later on.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if Joshua had given them rest, then He would not afterward have spoken of another day.
verses.textEnNlt: Now if Joshua had succeeded in giving them this rest, God would not have spoken about another day of rest still to come.
verses.textEnNasb: For if Joshua had given them rest, He would not have spoken of another day after that.
verses.textEn: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.

verses.textZh: 这样看来，为了神的子民，必定另外有一个"安息日"的安息保留下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样看来，为了神的子民，必定另外有一个"安息日"的安息保留下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样看来，必另有一安息日的安息为神的子民存留。
verses.textEnNiv: There remains, then, a Sabbath-rest for the people of God;
verses.textEnEsv: So then, there remains a Sabbath rest for the people of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: There remains therefore a rest for the people of God.
verses.textEnNlt: So there is a special rest still waiting for the people of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Consequently, there remains a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
verses.textEn: There remains, then, a Sabbath-rest for the people of God;

verses.textZh: 因为那进入神安息的人，就歇了自己的工作，好象神歇了自己的工作一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那进入神安息的人，就歇了自己的工作，好象神歇了自己的工作一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为那进入安息的，乃是歇了自己的工，正如神歇了他的工一样。
verses.textEnNiv: for anyone who enters God’s rest also rests from their works, just as God did from his.
verses.textEnEsv: for whoever has entered God’s rest has also rested from his works as God did from his.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he who has entered His rest has himself also ceased from his works as God did from His.
verses.textEnNlt: For all who have entered into God’s rest have rested from their labors, just as God did after creating the world.
verses.textEnNasb: For the one who has entered His rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from His.
verses.textEn: for anyone who enters God’s rest also rests from their works, just as God did from his.

verses.textZh: 所以，我们要竭力进入那安息，免得有人随着那不顺从的样子就跌倒了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们要竭力进入那安息，免得有人随着那不顺从的样子就跌倒了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我们务必竭力进入那安息，免得有人学那不信从的样子跌倒了。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will perish by following their example of disobedience.
verses.textEnEsv: Let us therefore strive to enter that rest, so that no one may fall by the same sort of disobedience.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let us therefore be diligent to enter that rest, lest anyone fall according to the same example of disobedience.
verses.textEnNlt: So let us do our best to enter that rest. But if we disobey God, as the people of Israel did, we will fall.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore let’s make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will fall by following the same example of disobedience.
verses.textEn: Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will perish by following their example of disobedience.

verses.textZh: 因为神的道是活的，是有效的，比一切两刃的剑更锋利，甚至可以刺入剖开魂与灵，关节与骨髓，并且能够辨明心中的思想和意念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神的道是活的，是有效的，比一切两刃的剑更锋利，甚至可以刺入剖开魂与灵，关节与骨髓，并且能够辨明心中的思想和意念。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的道是活泼的，是有功效的，比一切两刃的剑更快，甚至魂与灵，骨节与骨髓，都能刺入、剖开，连心中的思念和主意都能辨明。
verses.textEnNiv: For the word of God is alive and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it penetrates even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow; it judges the thoughts and attitudes of the heart.
verses.textEnEsv: For the word of God is living and active, sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing to the division of soul and of spirit, of joints and of marrow, and discerning the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the word of God is living and powerful, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the division of soul and spirit, and of joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.textEnNlt: For the word of God is alive and powerful. It is sharper than the sharpest two-edged sword, cutting between soul and spirit, between joint and marrow. It exposes our innermost thoughts and desires.
verses.textEnNasb: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, even penetrating as far as the division of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and able to judge the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
verses.textEn: For the word of God is alive and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it penetrates even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow; it judges the thoughts and attitudes of the heart.

verses.textZh: 被造的在神面前没有一样不是显明的，万有在他的眼前都是赤露敞开的；我们必须向他交帐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被造的在神面前没有一样不是显明的，万有在他的眼前都是赤露敞开的；我们必须向他交帐。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且被造的没有一样在他面前不显然的；原来万物在那与我们有关系的主眼前，都是赤露敞开的。
verses.textEnNiv: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight. Everything is uncovered and laid bare before the eyes of him to whom we must give account.
verses.textEnEsv: And no creature is hidden from his sight, but all are naked and exposed to the eyes of him to whom we must give account.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there is no creature hidden from His sight, but all things are naked and open to the eyes of Him to whom we mustgive account.
verses.textEnNlt: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God. Everything is naked and exposed before his eyes, and he is the one to whom we are accountable.
verses.textEnNasb: And there is no creature hidden from His sight, but all things are open and laid bare to the eyes of Him to whom we must answer.
verses.textEn: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight. Everything is uncovered and laid bare before the eyes of him to whom we must give account.

verses.textZh: 我们既然有一位伟大的、经过了众天的大祭司，就是神的儿子耶稣，就应该坚持所宣认的信仰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们既然有一位伟大的、经过了众天的大祭司，就是神的儿子耶稣，就应该坚持所宣认的信仰。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既然有一位已经升入高天尊荣的大祭司，就是神的儿子耶稣，便当持定所承认的道。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has ascended into heaven, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to the faith we profess.
verses.textEnEsv: Since then we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let us hold fast our confession.
verses.textEnNkjv: Seeing then that we have a great High Priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our confession.
verses.textEnNlt: So then, since we have a great High Priest who has entered heaven, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we believe.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let’s hold firmly to our confession.
verses.textEn: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has ascended into heaven, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to the faith we profess.

verses.textZh: 因为我们的大祭司并不是不能同情我们的软弱，他像我们一样，也曾在各方面受过试探，只是他没有犯罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们的大祭司并不是不能同情我们的软弱，他像我们一样，也曾在各方面受过试探，只是他没有犯罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我们的大祭司并非不能体恤我们的软弱。他也曾凡事受过试探，与我们一样，只是他没有犯罪。
verses.textEnNiv: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to empathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who has been tempted in every way, just as we are—yet he did not sin.
verses.textEnEsv: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but one who in every respect has been tempted as we are, yet without sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we do not have a High Priest who cannot sympathize with our weaknesses, but was in all points tempted as weare, yet without sin.
verses.textEnNlt: This High Priest of ours understands our weaknesses, for he faced all of the same testings we do, yet he did not sin.
verses.textEnNasb: For we do not have a high priest who cannot sympathize with our weaknesses, but One who has been tempted in all things just as we are, yet without sin.
verses.textEn: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to empathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who has been tempted in every way, just as we are—yet he did not sin.

verses.textZh: 所以，我们只管坦然无惧地来到施恩的宝座前，为的是要领受怜悯，得到恩惠，作为及时的帮助。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们只管坦然无惧地来到施恩的宝座前，为的是要领受怜悯，得到恩惠，作为及时的帮助。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我们只管坦然无惧地来到施恩的宝座前，为要得怜恤，蒙恩惠，作随时的帮助。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us then approach God’s throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
verses.textEnEsv: Let us then with confidence draw near to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let us therefore come boldly to the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.textEnNlt: So let us come boldly to the throne of our gracious God. There we will receive his mercy, and we will find grace to help us when we need it most.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore let’s approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace for help at the time of our need.
verses.textEn: Let us then approach God’s throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

verses.textZh: 每一个大祭司都是从人间选出来，奉派替人办理与神有关的事，为的是要献上礼物和赎罪的祭物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每一个大祭司都是从人间选出来，奉派替人办理与神有关的事，为的是要献上礼物和赎罪的祭物。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡从人间挑选的大祭司，是奉派替人办理属神的事，为要献上礼物和赎罪祭 。
verses.textEnNiv: Every high priest is selected from among the people and is appointed to represent the people in matters related to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.
verses.textEnEsv: For every high priest chosen from among men is appointed to act on behalf of men in relation to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: For every high priest taken from among men is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
verses.textEnNlt: Every high priest is a man chosen to represent other people in their dealings with God. He presents their gifts to God and offers sacrifices for their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: For every high priest taken from among men is appointed on behalf of people in things pertaining to God, in order to offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins;
verses.textEn: Every high priest is selected from among the people and is appointed to represent the people in matters related to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.

verses.textZh: 他能够温和地对待那些无知和迷误的人，因为他自己也被软弱所困。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他能够温和地对待那些无知和迷误的人，因为他自己也被软弱所困。
verses.textZhCuv: 他能体谅那愚蒙的和失迷的人，因为他自己也是被软弱所困。
verses.textEnNiv: He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and are going astray, since he himself is subject to weakness.
verses.textEnEsv: He can deal gently with the ignorant and wayward, since he himself is beset with weakness.
verses.textEnNkjv: He can have compassion on those who are ignorant and going astray, since he himself is also subject to weakness.
verses.textEnNlt: And he is able to deal gently with ignorant and wayward people because he himself is subject to the same weaknesses.
verses.textEnNasb: he can deal gently with the ignorant and misguided, since he himself also is clothed in weakness;
verses.textEn: He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and are going astray, since he himself is subject to weakness.

verses.textZh: 因此，他怎样为人民的罪献祭，也应该怎样为自己的罪献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，他怎样为人民的罪献祭，也应该怎样为自己的罪献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，他理当为百姓和自己献祭赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: This is why he has to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.
verses.textEnEsv: Because of this he is obligated to offer sacrifice for his own sins just as he does for those of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of this he is required as for the people, so also for himself, to offer sacrifices for sins.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins as well as theirs.
verses.textEnNasb: and because of it he is obligated to offer sacrifices for sins for himself, as well as for the people.
verses.textEn: This is why he has to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.

verses.textZh: 没有人可以自己取得这大祭司的尊荣，只有像亚伦一样，蒙神选召的才可以。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有人可以自己取得这大祭司的尊荣，只有像亚伦一样，蒙神选召的才可以。
verses.textZhCuv: 这大祭司的尊荣，没有人自取。惟要蒙神所召，像亚伦一样。
verses.textEnNiv: And no one takes this honor on himself, but he receives it when called by God, just as Aaron was.
verses.textEnEsv: And no one takes this honor for himself, but only when called by God, just as Aaron was.
verses.textEnNkjv: And no man takes this honor to himself, but he who is called by God, just as Aaron was.
verses.textEnNlt: And no one can become a high priest simply because he wants such an honor. He must be called by God for this work, just as Aaron was.
verses.textEnNasb: And no one takes the honor for himself, but receives it when he is called by God, just as Aaron also was.
verses.textEn: And no one takes this honor on himself, but he receives it when called by God, just as Aaron was.

verses.textZh: 照样，基督也没有自己争取作大祭司的尊荣，而是曾经对他说： "你是我的儿子， 我今日生了你" 的神荣耀了他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，基督也没有自己争取作大祭司的尊荣，而是曾经对他说： "你是我的儿子， 我今日生了你" 的神荣耀了他；
verses.textZhCuv: 如此，基督也不是自取荣耀作大祭司，乃是在乎向他说「你是我的儿子，我今日生你」的那一位；
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, Christ did not take on himself the glory of becoming a high priest. But God said to him, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father."
verses.textEnEsv: So also Christ did not exalt himself to be made a high priest, but was appointed by him who said to him, "You are my Son, today I have begotten you";
verses.textEnNkjv: So also Christ did not glorify Himself to become High Priest, but itwas He who said to Him: "You are My Son, Today I have begotten You."
verses.textEnNlt: That is why Christ did not honor himself by assuming he could become High Priest. No, he was chosen by God, who said to him, "You are my Son. Today I have become your Father. "
verses.textEnNasb: So too Christ did not glorify Himself in becoming a high priest, but it was He who said to Him, "You are My Son, Today I have fathered You";
verses.textEn: In the same way, Christ did not take on himself the glory of becoming a high priest. But God said to him, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father."

verses.textZh: 就像他在另一处说： "你是照着麦基洗德的体系， 永远作祭司的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就像他在另一处说： "你是照着麦基洗德的体系， 永远作祭司的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就如经上又有一处说：「你是照着麦基洗德的等次永远为祭司。」
verses.textEnNiv: And he says in another place, "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEnEsv: as he says also in another place, "You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEnNkjv: As He also says in another place: "You are a priest forever According to the order of Melchizedek";
verses.textEnNlt: And in another passage God said to him, "You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEnNasb: just as He also says in another passage, "You are a priest forever According to the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEn: And he says in another place, "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

verses.textZh: 基督在世的时候，曾经流泪大声祷告恳求那位能救他脱离死亡的神；因着他的敬虔，就蒙了应允。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督在世的时候，曾经流泪大声祷告恳求那位能救他脱离死亡的神；因着他的敬虔，就蒙了应允。
verses.textZhCuv: 基督在肉体的时候，既大声哀哭，流泪祷告，恳求那能救他免死的主，就因他的虔诚蒙了应允。
verses.textEnNiv: During the days of Jesus’ life on earth, he offered up prayers and petitions with fervent cries and tears to the one who could save him from death, and he was heard because of his reverent submission.
verses.textEnEsv: In the days of his flesh, Jesus offered up prayers and supplications, with loud cries and tears, to him who was able to save him from death, and he was heard because of his reverence.
verses.textEnNkjv: who, in the days of His flesh, when He had offered up prayers and supplications, with vehement cries and tears to Him who was able to save Him from death, and was heard because of His godly fear,
verses.textEnNlt: While Jesus was here on earth, he offered prayers and pleadings, with a loud cry and tears, to the one who could rescue him from death. And God heard his prayers because of his deep reverence for God.
verses.textEnNasb: In the days of His humanity, He offered up both prayers and pleas with loud crying and tears to the One able to save Him from death, and He was heard because of His devout behavior.
verses.textEn: During the days of Jesus’ life on earth, he offered up prayers and petitions with fervent cries and tears to the one who could save him from death, and he was heard because of his reverent submission.

verses.textZh: 他虽然是儿子，还是因着所受的苦难学会了顺从。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他虽然是儿子，还是因着所受的苦难学会了顺从。
verses.textZhCuv: 他虽然为儿子，还是因所受的苦难学了顺从。
verses.textEnNiv: Son though he was, he learned obedience from what he suffered
verses.textEnEsv: Although he was a son, he learned obedience through what he suffered.
verses.textEnNkjv: though He was a Son, yet He learned obedience by the things which He suffered.
verses.textEnNlt: Even though Jesus was God’s Son, he learned obedience from the things he suffered.
verses.textEnNasb: Although He was a Son, He learned obedience from the things which He suffered.
verses.textEn: Son though he was, he learned obedience from what he suffered

verses.textZh: 他既然顺从到底 ，就成了所有顺从他的人得到永远救恩的根源；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他既然顺从到底 ，就成了所有顺从他的人得到永远救恩的根源；
verses.textZhCuv: 他既得以完全，就为凡顺从他的人成了永远得救的根源，
verses.textEnNiv: and, once made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation for all who obey him
verses.textEnEsv: And being made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation to all who obey him,
verses.textEnNkjv: And having been perfected, He became the author of eternal salvation to all who obey Him,
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, God qualified him as a perfect High Priest, and he became the source of eternal salvation for all those who obey him.
verses.textEnNasb: And having been perfected, He became the source of eternal salvation for all those who obey Him,
verses.textEn: and, once made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation for all who obey him

verses.textZh: 而且蒙神照着麦基洗德的体系，称他为大祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而且蒙神照着麦基洗德的体系，称他为大祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 并蒙神照着麦基洗德的等次称他为大祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: and was designated by God to be high priest in the order of Melchizedek.
verses.textEnEsv: being designated by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.textEnNkjv: called by God as High Priest "according to the order of Melchizedek,"
verses.textEnNlt: And God designated him to be a High Priest in the order of Melchizedek.
verses.textEnNasb: being designated by God as High Priest according to the order of Melchizedek.
verses.textEn: and was designated by God to be high priest in the order of Melchizedek.

verses.textZh: 论到这些事，我们有很多话要说，可是很难解释；因为你们已经迟钝了，听不进去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到这些事，我们有很多话要说，可是很难解释；因为你们已经迟钝了，听不进去。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到麦基洗德，我们有好些话，并且难以解明，因为你们听不进去。
verses.textEnNiv: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to make it clear to you because you no longer try to understand.
verses.textEnEsv: About this we have much to say, and it is hard to explain, since you have become dull of hearing.
verses.textEnNkjv: of whom we have much to say, and hard to explain, since you have become dull of hearing.
verses.textEnNlt: There is much more we would like to say about this, but it is difficult to explain, especially since you are spiritually dull and don’t seem to listen.
verses.textEnNasb: Concerning him we have much to say, and it is difficult to explain, since you have become poor listeners.
verses.textEn: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to make it clear to you because you no longer try to understand.

verses.textZh: 到这个时候，你们应该已经作老师了；可是你们还需要有人再把神道理的初步教导你们。你们成了只能吃奶而不能吃干粮的人！
verses.textZhCnvs: 到这个时候，你们应该已经作老师了；可是你们还需要有人再把神道理的初步教导你们。你们成了只能吃奶而不能吃干粮的人！
verses.textZhCuv: 看你们学习的工夫，本该作师傅，谁知还得有人将神圣言小学的开端另教导你们，并且成了那必须吃奶、不能吃干粮的人。
verses.textEnNiv: In fact, though by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to teach you the elementary truths of God’s word all over again. You need milk, not solid food!
verses.textEnEsv: For though by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to teach you again the basic principles of the oracles of God. You need milk, not solid food,
verses.textEnNkjv: For though by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to teach you again the first principles of the oracles of God; and you have come to need milk and not solid food.
verses.textEnNlt: You have been believers so long now that you ought to be teaching others. Instead, you need someone to teach you again the basic things about God’s word. You are like babies who need milk and cannot eat solid food.
verses.textEnNasb: For though by this time you ought to be teachers, you have need again for someone to teach you the elementary principles of the actual words of God, and you have come to need milk and not solid food.
verses.textEn: In fact, though by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to teach you the elementary truths of God’s word all over again. You need milk, not solid food!

verses.textZh: 凡是吃奶的，还是个婴孩，对公义的道理没有经历；
