verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是吃奶的，还是个婴孩，对公义的道理没有经历；
verses.textZhCuv: 凡只能吃奶的都不熟练仁义的道理，因为他是婴孩；
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who lives on milk, being still an infant, is not acquainted with the teaching about righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: for everyone who lives on milk is unskilled in the word of righteousness, since he is a child.
verses.textEnNkjv: For everyone who partakes only of milk is unskilled in the word of righteousness, for he is a babe.
verses.textEnNlt: For someone who lives on milk is still an infant and doesn’t know how to do what is right.
verses.textEnNasb: For everyone who partakes only of milk is unacquainted with the word of righteousness, for he is an infant.
verses.textEn: Anyone who lives on milk, being still an infant, is not acquainted with the teaching about righteousness.

verses.textZh: 只有长大成人的，才能吃干粮，他们的官能因为操练纯熟，就能分辨是非了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有长大成人的，才能吃干粮，他们的官能因为操练纯熟，就能分辨是非了。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独长大成人的才能吃干粮；他们的心窍习练得通达，就能分辨好歹了。
verses.textEnNiv: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained themselves to distinguish good from evil.
verses.textEnEsv: But solid food is for the mature, for those who have their powers of discernment trained by constant practice to distinguish good from evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: But solid food belongs to those who are of full age, thatis, those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
verses.textEnNlt: Solid food is for those who are mature, who through training have the skill to recognize the difference between right and wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: But solid food is for the mature, who because of practice have their senses trained to distinguish between good and evil.
verses.textEn: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained themselves to distinguish good from evil.

verses.textZh: 只要神允许，我们就这样作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要神允许，我们就这样作。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我们应当离开基督道理的开端，竭力进到完全的地步，不必再立根基，就如那懊悔死行、信靠神、
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore let us move beyond the elementary teachings about Christ and be taken forward to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from acts that lead to death, and of faith in God,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore let us leave the elementary doctrine of Christ and go on to maturity, not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works and of faith toward God,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, leaving the discussion of the elementary principles of Christ, let us go on to perfection, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works and of faith toward God,
verses.textEnNlt: So let us stop going over the basic teachings about Christ again and again. Let us go on instead and become mature in our understanding. Surely we don’t need to start again with the fundamental importance of repenting from evil deeds and placing our faith in God.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore leaving the elementary teaching about the Christ, let us press on to maturity, not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works and of faith toward God,
verses.textEn: Therefore let us move beyond the elementary teachings about Christ and be taken forward to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from acts that lead to death, and of faith in God,

verses.textZh: 因为那些曾经蒙了光照，尝过属天的恩赐的滋味，与圣灵有分，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那些曾经蒙了光照，尝过属天的恩赐的滋味，与圣灵有分，
verses.textZhCuv: 各样洗礼、按手之礼、死人复活，以及永远审判各等教训。
verses.textEnNiv: instruction about cleansing rites, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.
verses.textEnEsv: and of instruction about washings, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the doctrine of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: You don’t need further instruction about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: of instruction about washings and laying on of hands, and about the resurrection of the dead and eternal judgment.
verses.textEn: instruction about cleansing rites, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.

verses.textZh: 并且尝过神美善的道和来世的权能的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且尝过神美善的道和来世的权能的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 神若许我们，我们必如此行。
verses.textEnNiv: And God permitting, we will do so.
verses.textEnEsv: And this we will do if God permits.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this we will do if God permits.
verses.textEnNlt: And so, God willing, we will move forward to further understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: And this we will do, if God permits.
verses.textEn: And God permitting, we will do so.

verses.textZh: 如果偏离了正道，就不可能再使他们重新悔改了。因为他们亲自把神的儿子再钉在十字架上，公然羞辱他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果偏离了正道，就不可能再使他们重新悔改了。因为他们亲自把神的儿子再钉在十字架上，公然羞辱他。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到那些已经蒙了光照、尝过天恩的滋味、又于圣灵有分，
verses.textEnNiv: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnEsv: For it is impossible, in the case of those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, and have shared in the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNkjv: For itis impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted the heavenly gift, and have become partakers of the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNlt: For it is impossible to bring back to repentance those who were once enlightened—those who have experienced the good things of heaven and shared in the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNasb: For it is impossible, in the case of those who have once been enlightened and have tasted of the heavenly gift and have been made partakers of the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEn: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,

verses.textZh: 这就像一块地，吸收了常常下在它上面的雨水，如果长出对种植的人有用的菜蔬，就从神那里得福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就像一块地，吸收了常常下在它上面的雨水，如果长出对种植的人有用的菜蔬，就从神那里得福。
verses.textZhCuv: 并尝过神善道的滋味、觉悟来世权能的人，
verses.textEnNiv: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age
verses.textEnEsv: and have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the age to come,
verses.textEnNkjv: and have tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,
verses.textEnNlt: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the power of the age to come—
verses.textEnNasb: and have tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,
verses.textEn: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age

verses.textZh: 但如果这块地长出荆棘和蒺藜来，就被废弃，近于咒诅，结局就是焚烧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但如果这块地长出荆棘和蒺藜来，就被废弃，近于咒诅，结局就是焚烧。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是离弃道理，就不能叫他们重新懊悔了。因为他们把神的儿子重钉十字架，明明地羞辱他。
verses.textEnNiv: and who have fallen away, to be brought back to repentance. To their loss they are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting him to public disgrace.
verses.textEnEsv: and then have fallen away, to restore them again to repentance, since they are crucifying once again the Son of God to their own harm and holding him up to contempt.
verses.textEnNkjv: if they fall away, to renew them again to repentance, since they crucify again for themselves the Son of God, and put Him to an open shame.
verses.textEnNlt: and who then turn away from God. It is impossible to bring such people back to repentance; by rejecting the Son of God, they themselves are nailing him to the cross once again and holding him up to public shame.
verses.textEnNasb: and then have fallen away, to restore them again to repentance, since they again crucify to themselves the Son of God and put Him to open shame.
verses.textEn: and who have fallen away, to be brought back to repentance. To their loss they are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting him to public disgrace.

verses.textZh: 不过，亲爱的弟兄们，我们虽然这样说，但对于你们，我们却深信你们有更好的表现，结局就是得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过，亲爱的弟兄们，我们虽然这样说，但对于你们，我们却深信你们有更好的表现，结局就是得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 就如一块田地，吃过屡次下的雨水，生长菜蔬，合乎耕种的人用，就从神得福；
verses.textEnNiv: Land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is farmed receives the blessing of God.
verses.textEnEsv: For land that has drunk the rain that often falls on it, and produces a crop useful to those for whose sake it is cultivated, receives a blessing from God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the earth which drinks in the rain that often comes upon it, and bears herbs useful for those by whom it is cultivated, receives blessing from God;
verses.textEnNlt: When the ground soaks up the falling rain and bears a good crop for the farmer, it has God’s blessing.
verses.textEnNasb: For ground that drinks the rain which often falls on it and produces vegetation useful to those for whose sake it is also tilled, receives a blessing from God;
verses.textEn: Land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is farmed receives the blessing of God.

verses.textZh: 因为神并不是不公义，以致忘记了你们的工作，和你们为他的名所表现的爱心，就是你们以前服事圣徒，现在还是服事他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神并不是不公义，以致忘记了你们的工作，和你们为他的名所表现的爱心，就是你们以前服事圣徒，现在还是服事他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 若长荆棘和蒺藜，必被废弃，近于咒诅，结局就是焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless and is in danger of being cursed. In the end it will be burned.
verses.textEnEsv: But if it bears thorns and thistles, it is worthless and near to being cursed, and its end is to be burned.
verses.textEnNkjv: but if it bears thorns and briers, itis rejected and near to being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
verses.textEnNlt: But if a field bears thorns and thistles, it is useless. The farmer will soon condemn that field and burn it.
verses.textEnNasb: but if it yields thorns and thistles, it is worthless and close to being cursed, and it ends up being burned.
verses.textEn: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless and is in danger of being cursed. In the end it will be burned.

verses.textZh: 我们深愿你们各人都表现同样的热诚，一直到底，使你们的盼望可以完全实现，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们深愿你们各人都表现同样的热诚，一直到底，使你们的盼望可以完全实现，
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄们，我们虽是这样说，却深信你们的行为强过这些，而且近乎得救。
verses.textEnNiv: Even though we speak like this, dear friends, we are convinced of better things in your case—the things that have to do with salvation.
verses.textEnEsv: Though we speak in this way, yet in your case, beloved, we feel sure of better things—things that belong to salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: But, beloved, we are confident of better things concerning you, yes, things that accompany salvation, though we speak in this manner.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friends, even though we are talking this way, we really don’t believe it applies to you. We are confident that you are meant for better things, things that come with salvation.
verses.textEnNasb: But, beloved, we are convinced of better things regarding you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we are speaking in this way.
verses.textEn: Even though we speak like this, dear friends, we are convinced of better things in your case—the things that have to do with salvation.

verses.textZh: 并且不要懒惰，却要效法那些凭着信心和忍耐承受应许的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且不要懒惰，却要效法那些凭着信心和忍耐承受应许的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神并非不公义，竟忘记你们所做的工和你们为他名所显的爱心，就是先前伺候圣徒，如今还是伺候。
verses.textEnNiv: God is not unjust; he will not forget your work and the love you have shown him as you have helped his people and continue to help them.
verses.textEnEsv: For God is not unjust so as to overlook your work and the love that you have shown for his name in serving the saints, as you still do.
verses.textEnNkjv: For God is not unjust to forget your work and labor of love which you have shown toward His name, inthat you have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
verses.textEnNlt: For God is not unjust. He will not forget how hard you have worked for him and how you have shown your love to him by caring for other believers, as you still do.
verses.textEnNasb: For God is not unjust so as to forget your work and the love which you have shown toward His name, by having served and by still serving the saints.
verses.textEn: God is not unjust; he will not forget your work and the love you have shown him as you have helped his people and continue to help them.

verses.textZh: 神应许亚伯拉罕的时候，因为没有比自己更大的可以指着起誓，他就指着自己起誓，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神应许亚伯拉罕的时候，因为没有比自己更大的可以指着起誓，他就指着自己起誓，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们愿你们各人都显出这样的殷勤，使你们有满足的指望，一直到底。
verses.textEnNiv: We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, so that what you hope for may be fully realized.
verses.textEnEsv: And we desire each one of you to show the same earnestness to have the full assurance of hope until the end,
verses.textEnNkjv: And we desire that each one of you show the same diligence to the full assurance of hope until the end,
verses.textEnNlt: Our great desire is that you will keep on loving others as long as life lasts, in order to make certain that what you hope for will come true.
verses.textEnNasb: And we desire that each one of you demonstrate the same diligence so as to realize the full assurance of hope until the end,
verses.textEn: We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, so that what you hope for may be fully realized.

verses.textZh: 说："我必定赐福给你，必定使你的后裔繁多。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："我必定赐福给你，必定使你的后裔繁多。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且不懈怠，总要效法那些凭信心和忍耐承受应许的人。
verses.textEnNiv: We do not want you to become lazy, but to imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.
verses.textEnEsv: so that you may not be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you do not become sluggish, but imitate those who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will not become spiritually dull and indifferent. Instead, you will follow the example of those who are going to inherit God’s promises because of their faith and endurance.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you will not be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and endurance inherit the promises.
verses.textEn: We do not want you to become lazy, but to imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.

verses.textZh: 这样，亚伯拉罕耐心等待，终于获得了所应许的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，亚伯拉罕耐心等待，终于获得了所应许的。
verses.textZhCuv: 当初神应许亚伯拉罕的时候，因为没有比自己更大可以指着起誓的，就指着自己起誓，说：
verses.textEnNiv: When God made his promise to Abraham, since there was no one greater for him to swear by, he swore by himself,
verses.textEnEsv: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he had no one greater by whom to swear, he swore by himself,
verses.textEnNkjv: For when God made a promise to Abraham, because He could swear by no one greater, He swore by Himself,
verses.textEnNlt: For example, there was God’s promise to Abraham. Since there was no one greater to swear by, God took an oath in his own name, saying:
verses.textEnNasb: For when God made the promise to Abraham, since He could swear an oath by no one greater, He swore by Himself,
verses.textEn: When God made his promise to Abraham, since there was no one greater for him to swear by, he swore by himself,

verses.textZh: 因为人起誓都是指着比自己大的起誓。这誓言就了结了他们中间的一切纠纷，作为保证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为人起誓都是指着比自己大的起誓。这誓言就了结了他们中间的一切纠纷，作为保证。
verses.textZhCuv: 「论福，我必赐大福给你；论子孙，我必叫你的子孙多起来。」
verses.textEnNiv: saying, "I will surely bless you and give you many descendants."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Surely I will bless you and multiply you."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you."
verses.textEnNlt: "I will certainly bless you, and I will multiply your descendants beyond number."
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "indeed I will greatly bless you and I will greatly multiply you."
verses.textEn: saying, "I will surely bless you and give you many descendants."

verses.textZh: 照样，神定意向那些承受应许的人，更清楚地表明他的旨意是不更改的，就用起誓作保证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，神定意向那些承受应许的人，更清楚地表明他的旨意是不更改的，就用起誓作保证。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，亚伯拉罕既恒久忍耐，就得了所应许的。
verses.textEnNiv: And so after waiting patiently, Abraham received what was promised.
verses.textEnEsv: And thus Abraham, having patiently waited, obtained the promise.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abraham waited patiently, and he received what God had promised.
verses.textEnNasb: And so, having patiently waited, he obtained the promise.
verses.textEn: And so after waiting patiently, Abraham received what was promised.

verses.textZh: 这两件事是不能更改的，因为神是决不说谎的。因此，我们这些逃进避难所的人，就大得安慰，抓紧那摆在我们面前的盼望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这两件事是不能更改的，因为神是决不说谎的。因此，我们这些逃进避难所的人，就大得安慰，抓紧那摆在我们面前的盼望。
verses.textZhCuv: 人都是指着比自己大的起誓，并且以起誓为实据，了结各样的争论。
verses.textEnNiv: People swear by someone greater than themselves, and the oath confirms what is said and puts an end to all argument.
verses.textEnEsv: For people swear by something greater than themselves, and in all their disputes an oath is final for confirmation.
verses.textEnNkjv: For men indeed swear by the greater, and an oath for confirmation is for them an end of all dispute.
verses.textEnNlt: Now when people take an oath, they call on someone greater than themselves to hold them to it. And without any question that oath is binding.
verses.textEnNasb: For people swear an oath by one greater than themselves, and with them an oath serving as confirmation is an end of every dispute.
verses.textEn: People swear by someone greater than themselves, and the oath confirms what is said and puts an end to all argument.

verses.textZh: 我们有这盼望，就像灵魂的锚，又稳当又坚固，通过幔子直进到里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们有这盼望，就像灵魂的锚，又稳当又坚固，通过幔子直进到里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 照样，神愿意为那承受应许的人格外显明他的旨意是不更改的，就起誓为证。
verses.textEnNiv: Because God wanted to make the unchanging nature of his purpose very clear to the heirs of what was promised, he confirmed it with an oath.
verses.textEnEsv: So when God desired to show more convincingly to the heirs of the promise the unchangeable character of his purpose, he guaranteed it with an oath,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus God, determining to show more abundantly to the heirs of promise the immutability of His counsel, confirmed it by an oath,
verses.textEnNlt: God also bound himself with an oath, so that those who received the promise could be perfectly sure that he would never change his mind.
verses.textEnNasb: In the same way God, desiring even more to demonstrate to the heirs of the promise the fact that His purpose is unchangeable, confirmed it with an oath,
verses.textEn: Because God wanted to make the unchanging nature of his purpose very clear to the heirs of what was promised, he confirmed it with an oath.

verses.textZh: 耶稣已经为我们作先锋进入了幔子里面；他是照着麦基洗德的体系，成了永远的大祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣已经为我们作先锋进入了幔子里面；他是照着麦基洗德的体系，成了永远的大祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 藉这两件不更改的事，神决不能说谎，好叫我们这逃往避难所、持定摆在我们前头指望的人可以大得勉励。
verses.textEnNiv: God did this so that, by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be greatly encouraged.
verses.textEnEsv: so that by two unchangeable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled for refuge might have strong encouragement to hold fast to the hope set before us.
verses.textEnNkjv: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we might have strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold of the hope set before us.
verses.textEnNlt: So God has given both his promise and his oath. These two things are unchangeable because it is impossible for God to lie. Therefore, we who have fled to him for refuge can have great confidence as we hold to the hope that lies before us.
verses.textEnNasb: so that by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have taken refuge would have strong encouragement to hold firmly to the hope set before us.
verses.textEn: God did this so that, by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be greatly encouraged.

verses.textZh: 我们有这指望，如同灵魂的锚，又坚固又牢靠，且通入幔内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们有这指望，如同灵魂的锚，又坚固又牢靠，且通入幔内。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们有这指望，如同灵魂的锚，又坚固又牢靠，且通入幔内。
verses.textEnNiv: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,
verses.textEnEsv: We have this as a sure and steadfast anchor of the soul, a hope that enters into the inner place behind the curtain,
verses.textEnNkjv: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and steadfast, and which enters the Presence behind the veil,
verses.textEnNlt: This hope is a strong and trustworthy anchor for our souls. It leads us through the curtain into God’s inner sanctuary.
verses.textEnNasb: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and reliable and one which enters within the veil,
verses.textEn: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,

verses.textZh: 作先锋的耶稣，既照着麦基洗德的等次成了永远的大祭司，就为我们进入幔内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作先锋的耶稣，既照着麦基洗德的等次成了永远的大祭司，就为我们进入幔内。
verses.textZhCuv: 作先锋的耶稣，既照着麦基洗德的等次成了永远的大祭司，就为我们进入幔内。
verses.textEnNiv: where our forerunner, Jesus, has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.
verses.textEnEsv: where Jesus has gone as a forerunner on our behalf, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.textEnNkjv: where the forerunner has entered for us, even Jesus, having become High Priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus has already gone in there for us. He has become our eternal High Priest in the order of Melchizedek.
verses.textEnNasb: where Jesus has entered as a forerunner for us, having become a high priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek.
verses.textEn: where our forerunner, Jesus, has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.

verses.textZh: 这麦基洗德就是撒冷王，又是至高神的祭司。亚伯拉罕杀败众王回来的时候，麦基洗德迎接他，并且给他祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这麦基洗德就是撒冷王，又是至高神的祭司。亚伯拉罕杀败众王回来的时候，麦基洗德迎接他，并且给他祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 这麦基洗德就是撒冷王，又是至高神的祭司，本是长远为祭司的。他当亚伯拉罕杀败诸王回来的时候，就迎接他，给他祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the defeat of the kings and blessed him,
verses.textEnEsv: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of the Most High God, met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
verses.textEnNkjv: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of the Most High God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
verses.textEnNlt: This Melchizedek was king of the city of Salem and also a priest of God Most High. When Abraham was returning home after winning a great battle against the kings, Melchizedek met him and blessed him.
verses.textEnNasb: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of the Most High God, who met Abraham as he was returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
verses.textEn: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the defeat of the kings and blessed him,

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕也把自己得来的一切，拿出十分之一来给他。麦基洗德这名字翻译出来，头一个意思就是"公义的王"；其次是"撒冷王"，就是"平安的王"的意思。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕也把自己得来的一切，拿出十分之一来给他。麦基洗德这名字翻译出来，头一个意思就是"公义的王"；其次是"撒冷王"，就是"平安的王"的意思。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕也将自己所得来的，取十分之一给他。他头一个名翻出来就是仁义王，他又名撒冷王，就是平安王的意思。
verses.textEnNiv: and Abraham gave him a tenth of everything. First, the name Melchizedek means "king of righteousness"; then also, "king of Salem" means "king of peace."
verses.textEnEsv: and to him Abraham apportioned a tenth part of everything. He is first, by translation of his name, king of righteousness, and then he is also king of Salem, that is, king of peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: to whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all, first being translated "king of righteousness," and then also king of Salem, meaning "king of peace,"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abraham took a tenth of all he had captured in battle and gave it to Melchizedek. The name Melchizedek means "king of justice," and king of Salem means "king of peace."
verses.textEnNasb: to whom also Abraham apportioned a tenth of all the spoils, was first of all, by the translation of his name, king of righteousness, and then also king of Salem, which is king of peace.
verses.textEn: and Abraham gave him a tenth of everything. First, the name Melchizedek means "king of righteousness"; then also, "king of Salem" means "king of peace."

verses.textZh: 他没有父亲，没有母亲，没有族谱，也没有生死的记录，而是与神的儿子相似，永远作祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他没有父亲，没有母亲，没有族谱，也没有生死的记录，而是与神的儿子相似，永远作祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 他无父，无母，无族谱，无生之始，无命之终，乃是与神的儿子相似。
verses.textEnNiv: Without father or mother, without genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, resembling the Son of God, he remains a priest forever.
verses.textEnEsv: He is without father or mother or genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but resembling the Son of God he continues a priest forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God, remains a priest continually.
verses.textEnNlt: There is no record of his father or mother or any of his ancestors—no beginning or end to his life. He remains a priest forever, resembling the Son of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God, he remains a priest perpetually.
verses.textEn: Without father or mother, without genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, resembling the Son of God, he remains a priest forever.

verses.textZh: 你们想一想这人是多么伟大啊！祖先亚伯拉罕也要从上等的掳物中，拿出十分之一来给了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们想一想这人是多么伟大啊！祖先亚伯拉罕也要从上等的掳物中，拿出十分之一来给了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们想一想，先祖亚伯拉罕将自己所掳来上等之物取十分之一给他，这人是何等尊贵呢！
verses.textEnNiv: Just think how great he was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder!
verses.textEnEsv: See how great this man was to whom Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth of the spoils!
verses.textEnNkjv: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even the patriarch Abraham gave a tenth of the spoils.
verses.textEnNlt: Consider then how great this Melchizedek was. Even Abraham, the great patriarch of Israel, recognized this by giving him a tenth of what he had taken in battle.
verses.textEnNasb: Now observe how great this man was to whom Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth of the choicest spoils.
verses.textEn: Just think how great he was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder!

verses.textZh: 那些领受祭司职分的利未子孙，奉命按照律法向人民，就是自己的弟兄，收取十分之一；虽然他们都是出于亚伯拉罕的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些领受祭司职分的利未子孙，奉命按照律法向人民，就是自己的弟兄，收取十分之一；虽然他们都是出于亚伯拉罕的。
verses.textZhCuv: 那得祭司职任的利未子孙，领命照例向百姓取十分之一，这百姓是自己的弟兄，虽是从亚伯拉罕身 中生的，还是照例取十分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the law requires the descendants of Levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people—that is, from their fellow Israelites—even though they also are descended from Abraham.
verses.textEnEsv: And those descendants of Levi who receive the priestly office have a commandment in the law to take tithes from the people, that is, from their brothers, though these also are descended from Abraham.
verses.textEnNkjv: And indeed those who are of the sons of Levi, who receive the priesthood, have a commandment to receive tithes from the people according to the law, that is, from their brethren, though they have come from the loins of Abraham;
verses.textEnNlt: Now the law of Moses required that the priests, who are descendants of Levi, must collect a tithe from the rest of the people of Israel, who are also descendants of Abraham.
verses.textEnNasb: And those indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment in the Law to collect a tenth from the people, that is, from their countrymen, although they are descended from Abraham.
verses.textEn: Now the law requires the descendants of Levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people—that is, from their fellow Israelites—even though they also are descended from Abraham.

verses.textZh: 可是那不与他们同谱系的麦基洗德，反而收纳了亚伯拉罕的十分之一，并且给这蒙受应许的人祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是那不与他们同谱系的麦基洗德，反而收纳了亚伯拉罕的十分之一，并且给这蒙受应许的人祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 独有麦基洗德，不与他们同谱，倒收纳亚伯拉罕的十分之一，为那蒙应许的亚伯拉罕祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: This man, however, did not trace his descent from Levi, yet he collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.
verses.textEnEsv: But this man who does not have his descent from them received tithes from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.
verses.textEnNkjv: but he whose genealogy is not derived from them received tithes from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.
verses.textEnNlt: But Melchizedek, who was not a descendant of Levi, collected a tenth from Abraham. And Melchizedek placed a blessing upon Abraham, the one who had already received the promises of God.
verses.textEnNasb: But the one whose genealogy is not traced from them collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed the one who had the promises.
verses.textEn: This man, however, did not trace his descent from Levi, yet he collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.

verses.textZh: 向来都是位分大的给位分小的祝福，这是毫无疑问的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 向来都是位分大的给位分小的祝福，这是毫无疑问的。
verses.textZhCuv: 从来位分大的给位分小的祝福，这是驳不倒的理。
verses.textEnNiv: And without doubt the lesser is blessed by the greater.
verses.textEnEsv: It is beyond dispute that the inferior is blessed by the superior.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now beyond all contradiction the lesser is blessed by the better.
verses.textEnNlt: And without question, the person who has the power to give a blessing is greater than the one who is blessed.
verses.textEnNasb: But without any dispute the lesser person is blessed by the greater.
verses.textEn: And without doubt the lesser is blessed by the greater.

verses.textZh: 在这里，收取十分之一的，都是必死的；但在那里，收纳十分之一的，却被证实是一位活着的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这里，收取十分之一的，都是必死的；但在那里，收纳十分之一的，却被证实是一位活着的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这里收十分之一的都是必死的人；但在那里收十分之一的，有为他作见证的说，他是活的；
verses.textEnNiv: In the one case, the tenth is collected by people who die; but in the other case, by him who is declared to be living.
verses.textEnEsv: In the one case tithes are received by mortal men, but in the other case, by one of whom it is testified that he lives.
verses.textEnNkjv: Here mortal men receive tithes, but there he receivesthem, of whom it is witnessed that he lives.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests who collect tithes are men who die, so Melchizedek is greater than they are, because we are told that he lives on.
verses.textEnNasb: In this case mortal men receive tithes, but in that case one receives them, of whom it is witnessed that he lives on.
verses.textEn: In the one case, the tenth is collected by people who die; but in the other case, by him who is declared to be living.

verses.textZh: 并且可以这样说，连那收取十分之一的利未，也透过亚伯拉罕缴纳了十分之一。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且可以这样说，连那收取十分之一的利未，也透过亚伯拉罕缴纳了十分之一。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且可说那受十分之一的利未，也是藉着亚伯拉罕纳了十分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: One might even say that Levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through Abraham,
verses.textEnEsv: One might even say that Levi himself, who receives tithes, paid tithes through Abraham,
verses.textEnNkjv: Even Levi, who receives tithes, paid tithes through Abraham, so to speak,
verses.textEnNlt: In addition, we might even say that these Levites—the ones who collect the tithe—paid a tithe to Melchizedek when their ancestor Abraham paid a tithe to him.
verses.textEnNasb: And, so to speak, through Abraham even Levi, who received tithes, has paid tithes,
verses.textEn: One might even say that Levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through Abraham,

verses.textZh: 因为麦基洗德迎接亚伯拉罕的时候，利未还在他祖先的身体里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为麦基洗德迎接亚伯拉罕的时候，利未还在他祖先的身体里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为麦基洗德迎接亚伯拉罕的时候，利未已经在他先祖的身 中。
verses.textEnNiv: because when Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in the body of his ancestor.
verses.textEnEsv: for he was still in the loins of his ancestor when Melchizedek met him.
verses.textEnNkjv: for he was still in the loins of his father when Melchizedek met him.
verses.textEnNlt: For although Levi wasn’t born yet, the seed from which he came was in Abraham’s body when Melchizedek collected the tithe from him.
verses.textEnNasb: for he was still in the loins of his forefather when Melchizedek met him.
verses.textEn: because when Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in the body of his ancestor.

verses.textZh: 这样看来，如果借着利未人的祭司制度能达到完全的地步 ，为甚么还需要照着麦基洗德的体系，另外兴起一位祭司，而不照着亚伦的体系呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样看来，如果借着利未人的祭司制度能达到完全的地步 ，为甚么还需要照着麦基洗德的体系，另外兴起一位祭司，而不照着亚伦的体系呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 从前百姓在利未人祭司职任以下受律法，倘若藉这职任能得完全，又何用另外兴起一位祭司，照麦基洗德的等次，不照亚伦的等次呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If perfection could have been attained through the Levitical priesthood—and indeed the law given to the people established that priesthood—why was there still need for another priest to come, one in the order of Melchizedek, not in the order of Aaron?
verses.textEnEsv: Now if perfection had been attainable through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people received the law), what further need would there have been for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, rather than one named after the order of Aaron?
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, if perfection were through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people received the law), what further need wasthere that another priest should rise according to the order of Melchizedek, and not be called according to the order of Aaron?
verses.textEnNlt: So if the priesthood of Levi, on which the law was based, could have achieved the perfection God intended, why did God need to establish a different priesthood, with a priest in the order of Melchizedek instead of the order of Levi and Aaron?
verses.textEnNasb: So if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for on the basis of it the people received the Law), what further need was there for another priest to arise according to the order of Melchizedek, and not be designated according to the order of Aaron?
verses.textEn: If perfection could have been attained through the Levitical priesthood—and indeed the law given to the people established that priesthood—why was there still need for another priest to come, one in the order of Melchizedek, not in the order of Aaron?

verses.textZh: 祭司的制度既然更改了，律法也必须更改。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司的制度既然更改了，律法也必须更改。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司的职任既已更改，律法也必须更改。
verses.textEnNiv: For when the priesthood is changed, the law must be changed also.
verses.textEnEsv: For when there is a change in the priesthood, there is necessarily a change in the law as well.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the priesthood being changed, of necessity there is also a change of the law.
verses.textEnNlt: And if the priesthood is changed, the law must also be changed to permit it.
verses.textEnNasb: For when the priesthood is changed, of necessity there takes place a change of law also.
verses.textEn: For when the priesthood is changed, the law must be changed also.

verses.textZh: 因为这些话所指的那位，原是属于另外一个支派的，这支派向来没有人在祭坛前供职。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这些话所指的那位，原是属于另外一个支派的，这支派向来没有人在祭坛前供职。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为这话所指的人本属别的支派，那支派里从来没有一人伺候祭坛。
verses.textEnNiv: He of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, and no one from that tribe has ever served at the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: For the one of whom these things are spoken belonged to another tribe, from which no one has ever served at the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He of whom these things are spoken belongs to another tribe, from which no man has officiated at the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: For the priest we are talking about belongs to a different tribe, whose members have never served at the altar as priests.
verses.textEnNasb: For the one about whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.
verses.textEn: He of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, and no one from that tribe has ever served at the altar.

verses.textZh: 我们的主明明是从犹大支派出来的，关于这个支派，摩西并没有提及祭司的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的主明明是从犹大支派出来的，关于这个支派，摩西并没有提及祭司的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的主分明是从犹大出来的；但这支派，摩西并没有提到祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, and in regard to that tribe Moses said nothing about priests.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is evident that our Lord was descended from Judah, and in connection with that tribe Moses said nothing about priests.
verses.textEnNkjv: For itis evident that our Lord arose from Judah, of which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
verses.textEnNlt: What I mean is, our Lord came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never mentioned priests coming from that tribe.
verses.textEnNasb: For it is evident that our Lord was descended from Judah, a tribe with reference to which Moses said nothing concerning priests.
verses.textEn: For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, and in regard to that tribe Moses said nothing about priests.

verses.textZh: 如果有另一位像麦基洗德那样的祭司兴起来，那么，这里所说的就更明显了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有另一位像麦基洗德那样的祭司兴起来，那么，这里所说的就更明显了。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若照麦基洗德的样式，另外兴起一位祭司来，我的话更是显而易见的了。
verses.textEnNiv: And what we have said is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,
verses.textEnEsv: This becomes even more evident when another priest arises in the likeness of Melchizedek,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it is yet far more evident if, in the likeness of Melchizedek, there arises another priest
verses.textEnNlt: This change has been made very clear since a different priest, who is like Melchizedek, has appeared.
verses.textEnNasb: And this is clearer still, if another priest arises according to the likeness of Melchizedek,
verses.textEn: And what we have said is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,

verses.textZh: 他成了祭司，不是按着律法上肉身的条例，却是按着不能毁坏的生命的大能。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他成了祭司，不是按着律法上肉身的条例，却是按着不能毁坏的生命的大能。
verses.textZhCuv: 他成为祭司，并不是照属肉体的条例，乃是照无穷 之生命的大能。
verses.textEnNiv: one who has become a priest not on the basis of a regulation as to his ancestry but on the basis of the power of an indestructible life.
verses.textEnEsv: who has become a priest, not on the basis of a legal requirement concerning bodily descent, but by the power of an indestructible life.
verses.textEnNkjv: who has come, not according to the law of a fleshly commandment, but according to the power of an endless life.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus became a priest, not by meeting the physical requirement of belonging to the tribe of Levi, but by the power of a life that cannot be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: who has become a priest not on the basis of a law of physical requirement, but according to the power of an indestructible life.
verses.textEn: one who has become a priest not on the basis of a regulation as to his ancestry but on the basis of the power of an indestructible life.

verses.textZh: 因为有为他作证的说： "你永远作祭司， 是照着麦基洗德的体系。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有为他作证的说： "你永远作祭司， 是照着麦基洗德的体系。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有给他作见证的说：「你是照着麦基洗德的等次永远为祭司。」
verses.textEnNiv: For it is declared: "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEnEsv: For it is witnessed of him, "You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEnNkjv: For He testifies: "You are a priest forever According to the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEnNlt: And the psalmist pointed this out when he prophesied, "You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEnNasb: For it is attested of Him, "You are a priest forever According to the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEn: For it is declared: "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

verses.textZh: 一方面，从前的条例因为软弱，没有用处，就废弃了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 一方面，从前的条例因为软弱，没有用处，就废弃了；
verses.textZhCuv: 先前的条例，因软弱无益，所以废掉了，
verses.textEnNiv: The former regulation is set aside because it was weak and useless
verses.textEnEsv: For on the one hand, a former commandment is set aside because of its weakness and uselessness
verses.textEnNkjv: For on the one hand there is an annulling of the former commandment because of its weakness and unprofitableness,
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, the old requirement about the priesthood was set aside because it was weak and useless.
verses.textEnNasb: For, on the one hand, there is the nullification of a former commandment because of its weakness and uselessness
verses.textEn: The former regulation is set aside because it was weak and useless

verses.textZh: 另一方面，它却带来了更美的盼望，借着这盼望，我们就可以亲近神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 另一方面，它却带来了更美的盼望，借着这盼望，我们就可以亲近神。
verses.textZhCuv: （律法原来一无所成）就引进了更美的指望；靠这指望，我们便可以进到神面前。
verses.textEnNiv: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a better hope is introduced, by which we draw near to God.
verses.textEnEsv: (for the law made nothing perfect); but on the other hand, a better hope is introduced, through which we draw near to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: for the law made nothing perfect; on the other hand, thereisthe bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.
verses.textEnNlt: For the law never made anything perfect. But now we have confidence in a better hope, through which we draw near to God.
verses.textEnNasb: (for the Law made nothing perfect); on the other hand, there is the introduction of a better hope, through which we come near to God.
verses.textEn: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a better hope is introduced, by which we draw near to God.

verses.textZh: 此外，还有关于誓言的事。其他成为祭司的，并不是用誓言立的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，还有关于誓言的事。其他成为祭司的，并不是用誓言立的；
verses.textZhCuv: 再者，耶稣为祭司，并不是不起誓立的。
verses.textEnNiv: And it was not without an oath! Others became priests without any oath,
verses.textEnEsv: And it was not without an oath. For those who formerly became priests were made such without an oath,
verses.textEnNkjv: And inasmuch as Hewas not madepriest without an oath
verses.textEnNlt: This new system was established with a solemn oath. Aaron’s descendants became priests without such an oath,
verses.textEnNasb: And to the extent that it was not without an oath
verses.textEn: And it was not without an oath! Others became priests without any oath,

verses.textZh: 只有耶稣是用誓言立的，因为那立他的对他说： "主已经起了誓， 决不改变， 你永远作祭司。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有耶稣是用誓言立的，因为那立他的对他说： "主已经起了誓， 决不改变， 你永远作祭司。"
verses.textZhCuv: 至于那些祭司，原不是起誓立的，只有耶稣是起誓立的；因为那立他的对他说：「主起了誓，决不后悔，你是永远为祭司。」
verses.textEnNiv: but he became a priest with an oath when God said to him: "The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind: ‘You are a priest forever.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: but this one was made a priest with an oath by the one who said to him: "The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: (for they have become priests without an oath, but He with an oath by Him who said to Him: "The Lord has sworn And will not relent, ‘You are a priest forever According to the order of Melchizedek’ "),
verses.textEnNlt: but there was an oath regarding Jesus. For God said to him, "The Lord has taken an oath and will not break his vow: ‘You are a priest forever.’"
verses.textEnNasb: (for they indeed became priests without an oath, but He with an oath through the One who said to Him, "The Lord has sworn And will not change His mind, ‘You are a priest forever’ ");
verses.textEn: but he became a priest with an oath when God said to him: "The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind: ‘You are a priest forever.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶稣既然是用誓言立的，就成了更美好的约的保证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣既然是用誓言立的，就成了更美好的约的保证。
verses.textZhCuv: 既是起誓立的，耶稣就作了更美之约的中保。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantor of a better covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: This makes Jesus the guarantor of a better covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: by so much more Jesus has become a surety of a better covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of this oath, Jesus is the one who guarantees this better covenant with God.
verses.textEnNasb: by the same extent Jesus also has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
verses.textEn: Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantor of a better covenant.

verses.textZh: 一方面，从前那些作祭司的，因为受死亡的限制，不能长久留任，所以人数众多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一方面，从前那些作祭司的，因为受死亡的限制，不能长久留任，所以人数众多。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些成为祭司的，数目本来多，是因为有死阻隔，不能长久。
verses.textEnNiv: Now there have been many of those priests, since death prevented them from continuing in office;
verses.textEnEsv: The former priests were many in number, because they were prevented by death from continuing in office,
verses.textEnNkjv: Also there were many priests, because they were prevented by death from continuing.
verses.textEnNlt: There were many priests under the old system, for death prevented them from remaining in office.
verses.textEnNasb: The former priests, on the one hand, existed in greater numbers because they were prevented by death from continuing;
verses.textEn: Now there have been many of those priests, since death prevented them from continuing in office;

verses.textZh: 另一方面，因为耶稣是永远长存的，就拥有他永不更改的祭司职位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 另一方面，因为耶稣是永远长存的，就拥有他永不更改的祭司职位。
verses.textZhCuv: 这位既是永远常存的，他祭司的职任就长久不更换。
verses.textEnNiv: but because Jesus lives forever, he has a permanent priesthood.
verses.textEnEsv: but he holds his priesthood permanently, because he continues forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He, because He continues forever, has an unchangeable priesthood.
verses.textEnNlt: But because Jesus lives forever, his priesthood lasts forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus, on the other hand, because He continues forever, holds His priesthood permanently.
verses.textEn: but because Jesus lives forever, he has a permanent priesthood.

verses.textZh: 因此，那些靠着他进到神面前的人，他都能拯救到底；因为他长远活着，为他们代求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，那些靠着他进到神面前的人，他都能拯救到底；因为他长远活着，为他们代求。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡靠着他进到神面前的人，他都能拯救到底；因为他是长远活着，替他们祈求。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore he is able to save completely those who come to God through him, because he always lives to intercede for them.
verses.textEnEsv: Consequently, he is able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, since he always lives to make intercession for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore He is also able to save to the uttermost those who come to God through Him, since He always lives to make intercession for them.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore he is able, once and forever, to save those who come to God through him. He lives forever to intercede with God on their behalf.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore He is also able to save forever those who come to God through Him, since He always lives to make intercession for them.
verses.textEn: Therefore he is able to save completely those who come to God through him, because he always lives to intercede for them.

verses.textZh: 这样的一位大祭司，对我们本是合适的。他是圣洁、没有邪恶、没有玷污、从罪人中分别出来、高过众天的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样的一位大祭司，对我们本是合适的。他是圣洁、没有邪恶、没有玷污、从罪人中分别出来、高过众天的。
verses.textZhCuv: 像这样圣洁、无邪恶、无玷污、远离罪人、高过诸天的大祭司，原是与我们合宜的。
verses.textEnNiv: Such a high priest truly meets our need—one who is holy, blameless, pure, set apart from sinners, exalted above the heavens.
verses.textEnEsv: For it was indeed fitting that we should have such a high priest, holy, innocent, unstained, separated from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.
verses.textEnNkjv: For such a High Priest was fitting for us, whois holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and has become higher than the heavens;
verses.textEnNlt: He is the kind of high priest we need because he is holy and blameless, unstained by sin. He has been set apart from sinners and has been given the highest place of honor in heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: For it was fitting for us to have such a high priest, holy, innocent, undefiled, separated from sinners, and exalted above the heavens;
verses.textEn: Such a high priest truly meets our need—one who is holy, blameless, pure, set apart from sinners, exalted above the heavens.

verses.textZh: 他不必像那些大祭司，天天先为自己的罪献祭，然后为人民的罪献祭；因为他献上了自己，就把这事一次而永远的成全了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不必像那些大祭司，天天先为自己的罪献祭，然后为人民的罪献祭；因为他献上了自己，就把这事一次而永远的成全了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不像那些大祭司，每日必须先为自己的罪，后为百姓的罪献祭；因为他只一次将自己献上，就把这事成全了。
verses.textEnNiv: Unlike the other high priests, he does not need to offer sacrifices day after day, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. He sacrificed for their sins once for all when he offered himself.
verses.textEnEsv: He has no need, like those high priests, to offer sacrifices daily, first for his own sins and then for those of the people, since he did this once for all when he offered up himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: who does not need daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifices, first for His own sins and then for the people’s, for this He did once for all when He offered up Himself.
verses.textEnNlt: Unlike those other high priests, he does not need to offer sacrifices every day. They did this for their own sins first and then for the sins of the people. But Jesus did this once for all when he offered himself as the sacrifice for the people’s sins.
verses.textEnNasb: who has no daily need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices, first for His own sins and then for the sins of the people, because He did this once for all time when He offered up Himself.
verses.textEn: Unlike the other high priests, he does not need to offer sacrifices day after day, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. He sacrificed for their sins once for all when he offered himself.

verses.textZh: 律法所立的大祭司，都是软弱的人；可是在律法以后，用誓言所立的儿子，却是成为完全直到永远的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 律法所立的大祭司，都是软弱的人；可是在律法以后，用誓言所立的儿子，却是成为完全直到永远的。
verses.textZhCuv: 律法本是立软弱的人为大祭司；但在律法以后起誓的话，是立儿子为大祭司，乃是成全到永远的。
verses.textEnNiv: For the law appoints as high priests men in all their weakness; but the oath, which came after the law, appointed the Son, who has been made perfect forever.
verses.textEnEsv: For the law appoints men in their weakness as high priests, but the word of the oath, which came later than the law, appoints a Son who has been made perfect forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the law appoints as high priests men who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints the Son who has been perfected forever.
verses.textEnNlt: The law appointed high priests who were limited by human weakness. But after the law was given, God appointed his Son with an oath, and his Son has been made the perfect High Priest forever.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Law appoints men as high priests who are weak, but the word of the oath, which came after the Law, appoints a Son, who has been made perfect forever.
verses.textEn: For the law appoints as high priests men in all their weakness; but the oath, which came after the law, appointed the Son, who has been made perfect forever.

verses.textZh: 我们所讲论的重点，就是我们有这样的一位大祭司，他已经坐在众天之上至尊者的宝座右边，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们所讲论的重点，就是我们有这样的一位大祭司，他已经坐在众天之上至尊者的宝座右边，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们所讲的事，其中第一要紧的，就是我们有这样的大祭司，已经坐在天上至大者宝座的右边，
verses.textEnNiv: Now the main point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,
verses.textEnEsv: Now the point in what we are saying is this: we have such a high priest, one who is seated at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now thisis the main point of the things we are saying: We have such a High Priest, who is seated at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
verses.textEnNlt: Here is the main point: We have a High Priest who sat down in the place of honor beside the throne of the majestic God in heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the main point in what has been said is this: we have such a high priest, who has taken His seat at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
verses.textEn: Now the main point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,

verses.textZh: 在至圣所和真会幕里供职；这真会幕是主支搭的，不是人支搭的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在至圣所和真会幕里供职；这真会幕是主支搭的，不是人支搭的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在圣所，就是真帐幕里，作执事；这帐幕是主所支的，不是人所支的。
verses.textEnNiv: and who serves in the sanctuary, the true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by a mere human being.
verses.textEnEsv: a minister in the holy places, in the true tent that the Lord set up, not man.
verses.textEnNkjv: a Minister of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord erected, and not man.
verses.textEnNlt: There he ministers in the heavenly Tabernacle, the true place of worship that was built by the Lord and not by human hands.
verses.textEnNasb: a minister in the sanctuary and in the true tabernacle, which the Lord set up, not man.
verses.textEn: and who serves in the sanctuary, the true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by a mere human being.

verses.textZh: 所有大祭司都是为了献礼物和祭品而设立的，所以这位大祭司，也必须有所献上的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有大祭司都是为了献礼物和祭品而设立的，所以这位大祭司，也必须有所献上的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡大祭司都是为献礼物和祭物设立的，所以这位大祭司也必须有所献的。
verses.textEnNiv: Every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, and so it was necessary for this one also to have something to offer.
verses.textEnEsv: For every high priest is appointed to offer gifts and sacrifices; thus it is necessary for this priest also to have something to offer.
verses.textEnNkjv: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore itis necessary that this One also have something to offer.
verses.textEnNlt: And since every high priest is required to offer gifts and sacrifices, our High Priest must make an offering, too.
verses.textEnNasb: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices; so it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.
verses.textEn: Every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, and so it was necessary for this one also to have something to offer.

verses.textZh: 如果他在地上，就不会作祭司，因为已经有按照律法献礼物的祭司了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他在地上，就不会作祭司，因为已经有按照律法献礼物的祭司了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若在地上，必不得为祭司，因为已经有照律法献礼物的祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: If he were on earth, he would not be a priest, for there are already priests who offer the gifts prescribed by the law.
verses.textEnEsv: Now if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, since there are priests who offer gifts according to the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if He were on earth, He would not be a priest, since there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law;
verses.textEnNlt: If he were here on earth, he would not even be a priest, since there already are priests who offer the gifts required by the law.
verses.textEnNasb: Now if He were on earth, He would not be a priest at all, since there are those who offer the gifts according to the Law;
verses.textEn: If he were on earth, he would not be a priest, for there are already priests who offer the gifts prescribed by the law.

verses.textZh: 这些祭司所供奉的职事，不过是天上的事物的副本和影像，就如摩西将要造会幕的时候，神曾经警告他说："你要留心，各样物件，都要照着在山上指示你的样式去作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些祭司所供奉的职事，不过是天上的事物的副本和影像，就如摩西将要造会幕的时候，神曾经警告他说："你要留心，各样物件，都要照着在山上指示你的样式去作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们供奉的事本是天上事的形状和影像，正如摩西将要造帐幕的时候，蒙神警戒他，说：「你要谨慎，作各样的物件都要照着在山上指示你的样式。」
verses.textEnNiv: They serve at a sanctuary that is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: "See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain."
verses.textEnEsv: They serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things. For when Moses was about to erect the tent, he was instructed by God, saying, "See that you make everything according to the pattern that was shown you on the mountain."
verses.textEnNkjv: who serve the copy and shadow of the heavenly things, as Moses was divinely instructed when he was about to make the tabernacle. For He said, "See that you make all things according to the pattern shown you on the mountain."
verses.textEnNlt: They serve in a system of worship that is only a copy, a shadow of the real one in heaven. For when Moses was getting ready to build the Tabernacle, God gave him this warning: "Be sure that you make everything according to the pattern I have shown you here on the mountain."
verses.textEnNasb: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, just as Moses was warned by God when he was about to erect the tabernacle; for, "See," He says, "that you make all things by the pattern which was shown to you on the mountain."
verses.textEn: They serve at a sanctuary that is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: "See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain."

verses.textZh: 但是现在耶稣得了更尊贵的职分，正好象他是更美的约的中保，这约是凭着更美的应许立的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是现在耶稣得了更尊贵的职分，正好象他是更美的约的中保，这约是凭着更美的应许立的。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今耶稣所得的职任是更美的，正如他作更美之约的中保；这约原是凭更美之应许立的。
verses.textEnNiv: But in fact the ministry Jesus has received is as superior to theirs as the covenant of which he is mediator is superior to the old one, since the new covenant is established on better promises.
verses.textEnEsv: But as it is, Christ has obtained a ministry that is as much more excellent than the old as the covenant he mediates is better, since it is enacted on better promises.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now He has obtained a more excellent ministry, inasmuch as He is also Mediator of a better covenant, which was established on better promises.
verses.textEnNlt: But now Jesus, our High Priest, has been given a ministry that is far superior to the old priesthood, for he is the one who mediates for us a far better covenant with God, based on better promises.
verses.textEnNasb: But now He has obtained a more excellent ministry, to the extent that He is also the mediator of a better covenant, which has been enacted on better promises.
verses.textEn: But in fact the ministry Jesus has received is as superior to theirs as the covenant of which he is mediator is superior to the old one, since the new covenant is established on better promises.

verses.textZh: 如果头一个约没有缺点，就没有寻求另一个约的必要了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果头一个约没有缺点，就没有寻求另一个约的必要了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那前约若没有瑕疵，就无处寻求后约了。
verses.textEnNiv: For if there had been nothing wrong with that first covenant, no place would have been sought for another.
verses.textEnEsv: For if that first covenant had been faultless, there would have been no occasion to look for a second.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.
verses.textEnNlt: If the first covenant had been faultless, there would have been no need for a second covenant to replace it.
verses.textEnNasb: For if that first covenant had been free of fault, no circumstances would have been sought for a second.
verses.textEn: For if there had been nothing wrong with that first covenant, no place would have been sought for another.

verses.textZh: 可是神指责他们，说： "看哪，主说，日子要到了， 我要与以色列家 和犹大家订立新约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是神指责他们，说： "看哪，主说，日子要到了， 我要与以色列家 和犹大家订立新约。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主指责他的百姓说 ： 日子将到， 我要与以色列家和犹大家另立新约，
verses.textEnNiv: But God found fault with the people and said : "The days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and with the people of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: For he finds fault with them when he says: "Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will establish a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Because finding fault with them, He says: "Behold, the days are coming, says the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah—
verses.textEnNlt: But when God found fault with the people, he said: "The day is coming, says the Lord , when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: For in finding fault with the people, He says, "Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, When I will bring about a new covenant With the house of Israel and the house of Judah,
verses.textEn: But God found fault with the people and said : "The days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and with the people of Judah.

verses.textZh: 这新约不像从前我拉他们祖先的手， 领他们出埃及的日子与他们所立的约。 因为他们没有遵守我的约， 我就不理会他们。这是主说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这新约不像从前我拉他们祖先的手， 领他们出埃及的日子与他们所立的约。 因为他们没有遵守我的约， 我就不理会他们。这是主说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 不像我拉着他们祖宗的手， 领他们出埃及的时候， 与他们所立的约。 因为他们不恒心守我的约， 我也不理他们。 这是主说的。
verses.textEnNiv: It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt, because they did not remain faithful to my covenant, and I turned away from them, declares the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: not like the covenant that I made with their fathers on the day when I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt. For they did not continue in my covenant, and so I showed no concern for them, declares the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they did not continue in My covenant, and I disregarded them, says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: This covenant will not be like the one I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand and led them out of the land of Egypt. They did not remain faithful to my covenant, so I turned my back on them, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Not like the covenant which I made with their fathers On the day I took them by the hand To bring them out of the land of Egypt; For they did not continue in My covenant, And I did not care about them, says the Lord.
verses.textEn: It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt, because they did not remain faithful to my covenant, and I turned away from them, declares the Lord.

verses.textZh: 主说：‘因为在那些日子以后， 我要与以色列家所立的约是这样： 我要把我的律法放在他们的心思里面， 写在他们的心上。 我要作他们的神， 他们要作我的子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主说：‘因为在那些日子以后， 我要与以色列家所立的约是这样： 我要把我的律法放在他们的心思里面， 写在他们的心上。 我要作他们的神， 他们要作我的子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 主又说： 那些日子以后， 我与以色列家所立的约乃是这样： 我要将我的律法放在他们里面， 写在他们心上； 我要作他们的神； 他们要作我的子民。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the covenant I will establish with the people of Israel after that time, declares the Lord. I will put my laws in their minds and write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.textEnEsv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the Lord: I will put my laws into their minds, and write them on their hearts, and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord: I will put My laws in their mind and write them on their hearts; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.
verses.textEnNlt: But this is the new covenant I will make with the people of Israel on that day, says the Lord : I will put my laws in their minds, and I will write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.textEnNasb: "For this is the covenant which I will make with the house of Israel After those days, declares the Lord: I will put My laws into their minds, And write them on their hearts. And I will be their God, And they shall be My people.
verses.textEn: This is the covenant I will establish with the people of Israel after that time, declares the Lord. I will put my laws in their minds and write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

verses.textZh: 他们各人必不用教导自己的邻居， 和自己的同胞，说： 你要认识主。 因为所有的人，从最小到最大的， 都必认识我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们各人必不用教导自己的邻居， 和自己的同胞，说： 你要认识主。 因为所有的人，从最小到最大的， 都必认识我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不用各人教导自己的乡邻和自己的弟兄， 说：你该认识主； 因为他们从最小的到至大的，都必认识我。
verses.textEnNiv: No longer will they teach their neighbor, or say to one another, ‘Know the Lord,’ because they will all know me, from the least of them to the greatest.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall not teach, each one his neighbor and each one his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for they shall all know me, from the least of them to the greatest.
verses.textEnNkjv: None of them shall teach his neighbor, and none his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all shall know Me, from the least of them to the greatest of them.
verses.textEnNlt: And they will not need to teach their neighbors, nor will they need to teach their relatives, saying, ‘You should know the Lord .’ For everyone, from the least to the greatest, will know me already.
verses.textEnNasb: "And they will not teach, each one his fellow citizen, And each one his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ For they will all know Me, From the least to the greatest of them.
verses.textEn: No longer will they teach their neighbor, or say to one another, ‘Know the Lord,’ because they will all know me, from the least of them to the greatest.

verses.textZh: 我也要宽恕他们的不义， 决不再记着他们的罪恶。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也要宽恕他们的不义， 决不再记着他们的罪恶。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要宽恕他们的不义， 不再记念他们的罪愆。
verses.textEnNiv: For I will forgive their wickedness and will remember their sins no more."
verses.textEnEsv: For I will be merciful toward their iniquities, and I will remember their sins no more."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their lawless deeds I will remember no more."
verses.textEnNlt: And I will forgive their wickedness, and I will never again remember their sins."
verses.textEnNasb: "For I will be merciful toward their wrongdoings, And their sins I will no longer remember."
verses.textEn: For I will forgive their wickedness and will remember their sins no more."

verses.textZh: 神既然说到新的约，就是把前约当作旧的了；那变成陈旧衰老的，就快要消逝了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神既然说到新的约，就是把前约当作旧的了；那变成陈旧衰老的，就快要消逝了。
verses.textZhCuv: 既说新约，就以前约为旧了；但那渐旧渐衰的，就必快归无有了。
verses.textEnNiv: By calling this covenant "new," he has made the first one obsolete; and what is obsolete and outdated will soon disappear.
verses.textEnEsv: In speaking of a new covenant, he makes the first one obsolete. And what is becoming obsolete and growing old is ready to vanish away.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that He says, "A new covenant," He has made the first obsolete. Now what is becoming obsolete and growing old is ready to vanish away.
verses.textEnNlt: When God speaks of a "new" covenant, it means he has made the first one obsolete. It is now out of date and will soon disappear.
verses.textEnNasb: When He said, "A new covenant," He has made the first obsolete. But whatever is becoming obsolete and growing old is about to disappear.
verses.textEn: By calling this covenant "new," he has made the first one obsolete; and what is obsolete and outdated will soon disappear.

verses.textZh: 前约也有它敬拜的规例，和属世界的圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 前约也有它敬拜的规例，和属世界的圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来前约有礼拜的条例和属世界的圣幕。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: Now even the first covenant had regulations for worship and an earthly place of holiness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then indeed, even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and the earthly sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: That first covenant between God and Israel had regulations for worship and a place of worship here on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Now even the first covenant had regulations for divine worship and the earthly sanctuary.
verses.textEn: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 因为有一个支搭好了的会幕，第一进叫作圣所，里面有灯台、桌子和陈设饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有一个支搭好了的会幕，第一进叫作圣所，里面有灯台、桌子和陈设饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有预备的帐幕，头一层叫作圣所，里面有灯台、桌子，和陈设饼。
verses.textEnNiv: A tabernacle was set up. In its first room were the lampstand and the table with its consecrated bread; this was called the Holy Place.
verses.textEnEsv: For a tent was prepared, the first section, in which were the lampstand and the table and the bread of the Presence. It is called the Holy Place.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a tabernacle was prepared: the first part, in which was the lampstand, the table, and the showbread, which is called the sanctuary;
verses.textEnNlt: There were two rooms in that Tabernacle. In the first room were a lampstand, a table, and sacred loaves of bread on the table. This room was called the Holy Place.
verses.textEnNasb: For a tabernacle was equipped, the outer sanctuary, in which were the lampstand, the table, and the sacred bread; this is called the Holy Place.
verses.textEn: A tabernacle was set up. In its first room were the lampstand and the table with its consecrated bread; this was called the Holy Place.

verses.textZh: 在第二层幔子后面还有一个会幕，叫作至圣所，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在第二层幔子后面还有一个会幕，叫作至圣所，
verses.textZhCuv: 第二幔子后又有一层帐幕，叫作至圣所，
verses.textEnNiv: Behind the second curtain was a room called the Most Holy Place,
verses.textEnEsv: Behind the second curtain was a second section called the Most Holy Place,
verses.textEnNkjv: and behind the second veil, the part of the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of All,
verses.textEnNlt: Then there was a curtain, and behind the curtain was the second room called the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNasb: Behind the second veil there was a tabernacle which is called the Most Holy Place,
verses.textEn: Behind the second curtain was a room called the Most Holy Place,

verses.textZh: 里面有金香坛，有全部包金的约柜，柜里有盛着吗哪的金罐、亚伦那发过芽的杖和两块约板。
verses.textZhCnvs: 里面有金香坛，有全部包金的约柜，柜里有盛着吗哪的金罐、亚伦那发过芽的杖和两块约板。
verses.textZhCuv: 有金香炉 ，有包金的约柜，柜里有盛吗哪的金罐和亚伦发过芽的杖，并两块约版；
verses.textEnNiv: which had the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered ark of the covenant. This ark contained the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: having the golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant covered on all sides with gold, in which was a golden urn holding the manna, and Aaron’s staff that budded, and the tablets of the covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: which had the golden censer and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which were the golden pot that had the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;
verses.textEnNlt: In that room were a gold incense altar and a wooden chest called the Ark of the Covenant, which was covered with gold on all sides. Inside the Ark were a gold jar containing manna, Aaron’s staff that sprouted leaves, and the stone tablets of the covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant covered on all sides with gold, in which was a golden jar holding the manna, Aaron’s staff which budded, and the tablets of the covenant;
verses.textEn: which had the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered ark of the covenant. This ark contained the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.

verses.textZh: 柜的上面有荣耀的基路伯罩着施恩座，关于这一切，现在不能一一细说了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 柜的上面有荣耀的基路伯罩着施恩座，关于这一切，现在不能一一细说了。
verses.textZhCuv: 柜上面有荣耀基路伯的影罩着施恩 座。这几件我现在不能一一细说。
verses.textEnNiv: Above the ark were the cherubim of the Glory, overshadowing the atonement cover. But we cannot discuss these things in detail now.
verses.textEnEsv: Above it were the cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat. Of these things we cannot now speak in detail.
verses.textEnNkjv: and above it were the cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat. Of these things we cannot now speak in detail.
verses.textEnNlt: Above the Ark were the cherubim of divine glory, whose wings stretched out over the Ark’s cover, the place of atonement. But we cannot explain these things in detail now.
verses.textEnNasb: and above it were the cherubim of glory overshadowing the atoning cover; but about these things we cannot now speak in detail.
verses.textEn: Above the ark were the cherubim of the Glory, overshadowing the atonement cover. But we cannot discuss these things in detail now.

verses.textZh: 这一切物件都这样预备好了，祭司就常常进入第一进会幕，执行敬拜的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切物件都这样预备好了，祭司就常常进入第一进会幕，执行敬拜的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些物件既如此预备齐了，众祭司就常进头一层帐幕，行拜神的礼。
verses.textEnNiv: When everything had been arranged like this, the priests entered regularly into the outer room to carry on their ministry.
verses.textEnEsv: These preparations having thus been made, the priests go regularly into the first section, performing their ritual duties,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when these things had been thus prepared, the priests always went into the first part of the tabernacle, performing the services.
verses.textEnNlt: When these things were all in place, the priests regularly entered the first room as they performed their religious duties.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when these things have been so prepared, the priests are continually entering the outer tabernacle, performing the divine worship,
verses.textEn: When everything had been arranged like this, the priests entered regularly into the outer room to carry on their ministry.

verses.textZh: 至于第二进会幕，只有大祭司一年一次独自进去，并且非带着血不可，好为自己和人民的愚妄把血献上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于第二进会幕，只有大祭司一年一次独自进去，并且非带着血不可，好为自己和人民的愚妄把血献上。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于第二层帐幕，惟有大祭司一年一次独自进去，没有不带着血为自己和百姓的过错献上。
verses.textEnNiv: But only the high priest entered the inner room, and that only once a year, and never without blood, which he offered for himself and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.
verses.textEnEsv: but into the second only the high priest goes, and he but once a year, and not without taking blood, which he offers for himself and for the unintentional sins of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: But into the second part the high priest went alone once a year, not without blood, which he offered for himself and for the people’s sins committed in ignorance;
verses.textEnNlt: But only the high priest ever entered the Most Holy Place, and only once a year. And he always offered blood for his own sins and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.
verses.textEnNasb: but into the second, only the high priest enters once a year, not without taking blood which he offers for himself and for the sins of the people committed in ignorance.
verses.textEn: But only the high priest entered the inner room, and that only once a year, and never without blood, which he offered for himself and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.

verses.textZh: 圣灵借着这事表明，当第一进会幕存在的时候，进入至圣所的路，还没有显明出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣灵借着这事表明，当第一进会幕存在的时候，进入至圣所的路，还没有显明出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵用此指明，头一层帐幕仍存的时候，进入至圣所的路还未显明。
verses.textEnNiv: The Holy Spirit was showing by this that the way into the Most Holy Place had not yet been disclosed as long as the first tabernacle was still functioning.
verses.textEnEsv: By this the Holy Spirit indicates that the way into the holy places is not yet opened as long as the first section is still standing
verses.textEnNkjv: the Holy Spirit indicating this, that the way into the Holiest of All was not yet made manifest while the first tabernacle was still standing.
verses.textEnNlt: By these regulations the Holy Spirit revealed that the entrance to the Most Holy Place was not freely open as long as the Tabernacle and the system it represented were still in use.
verses.textEnNasb: The Holy Spirit is signifying this, that the way into the holy place has not yet been disclosed while the outer tabernacle is still standing,
verses.textEn: The Holy Spirit was showing by this that the way into the Most Holy Place had not yet been disclosed as long as the first tabernacle was still functioning.

verses.textZh: 这第一进会幕是现今的时代的预表，其实所献的礼物和祭品，都不能使敬拜的人在良心上得到完全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这第一进会幕是现今的时代的预表，其实所献的礼物和祭品，都不能使敬拜的人在良心上得到完全。
verses.textZhCuv: 那头一层帐幕作现今的一个表样，所献的礼物和祭物，就着良心说，都不能叫礼拜的人得以完全。
verses.textEnNiv: This is an illustration for the present time, indicating that the gifts and sacrifices being offered were not able to clear the conscience of the worshiper.
verses.textEnEsv: (which is symbolic for the present age). According to this arrangement, gifts and sacrifices are offered that cannot perfect the conscience of the worshiper,
verses.textEnNkjv: It was symbolic for the present time in which both gifts and sacrifices are offered which cannot make him who performed the service perfect in regard to the conscience—
verses.textEnNlt: This is an illustration pointing to the present time. For the gifts and sacrifices that the priests offer are not able to cleanse the consciences of the people who bring them.
verses.textEnNasb: which is a symbol for the present time. Accordingly both gifts and sacrifices are offered which cannot make the worshiper perfect in conscience,
verses.textEn: This is an illustration for the present time, indicating that the gifts and sacrifices being offered were not able to clear the conscience of the worshiper.

verses.textZh: 这些只是关于饮食和各样洁净的礼仪，是在"更新的时候"来到之前，为肉体立的规例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些只是关于饮食和各样洁净的礼仪，是在"更新的时候"来到之前，为肉体立的规例。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事，连那饮食和诸般洗濯的规矩，都不过是属肉体的条例，命定到振兴的时候为止。
verses.textEnNiv: They are only a matter of food and drink and various ceremonial washings—external regulations applying until the time of the new order.
verses.textEnEsv: but deal only with food and drink and various washings, regulations for the body imposed until the time of reformation.
verses.textEnNkjv: concerned only with foods and drinks, various washings, and fleshly ordinances imposed until the time of reformation.
verses.textEnNlt: For that old system deals only with food and drink and various cleansing ceremonies—physical regulations that were in effect only until a better system could be established.
verses.textEnNasb: since they relate only to food, drink, and various washings, regulations for the body imposed until a time of reformation.
verses.textEn: They are only a matter of food and drink and various ceremonial washings—external regulations applying until the time of the new order.

verses.textZh: 但基督已经来了，作了已经实现的美好事物的大祭司；他经过更大、更完备的会幕 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但基督已经来了，作了已经实现的美好事物的大祭司；他经过更大、更完备的会幕 。
verses.textZhCuv: 但现在基督已经来到，作了将来美事的大祭司，经过那更大更全备的帐幕，不是人手所造，也不是属乎这世界的；
verses.textEnNiv: But when Christ came as high priest of the good things that are now already here, he went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not made with human hands, that is to say, is not a part of this creation.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Christ appeared as a high priest of the good things that have come, then through the greater and more perfect tent ( not made with hands, that is, not of this creation)
verses.textEnNkjv: But Christ came as High Priest of the good things to come, with the greater and more perfect tabernacle not made with hands, that is, not of this creation.
verses.textEnNlt: So Christ has now become the High Priest over all the good things that have come. He has entered that greater, more perfect Tabernacle in heaven, which was not made by human hands and is not part of this created world.
verses.textEnNasb: But when Christ appeared as a high priest of the good things having come, He entered through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made by hands, that is, not of this creation;
verses.textEn: But when Christ came as high priest of the good things that are now already here, he went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not made with human hands, that is to say, is not a part of this creation.

verses.textZh: 他不是用山羊和牛犊的血，而是用自己的血，只一次进了至圣所，就得到了永远的救赎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不是用山羊和牛犊的血，而是用自己的血，只一次进了至圣所，就得到了永远的救赎。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且不用山羊和牛犊的血，乃用自己的血，只一次进入圣所，成了永远赎罪的事。
verses.textEnNiv: He did not enter by means of the blood of goats and calves; but he entered the Most Holy Place once for all by his own blood, thus obtaining eternal redemption.
verses.textEnEsv: he entered once for all into the holy places, not by means of the blood of goats and calves but by means of his own blood, thus securing an eternal redemption.
verses.textEnNkjv: Not with the blood of goats and calves, but with His own blood He entered the Most Holy Place once for all, having obtained eternal redemption.
verses.textEnNlt: With his own blood—not the blood of goats and calves—he entered the Most Holy Place once for all time and secured our redemption forever.
verses.textEnNasb: and not through the blood of goats and calves, but through His own blood, He entered the holy place once for all time, having obtained eternal redemption.
