verses.textEn: He did not enter by means of the blood of goats and calves; but he entered the Most Holy Place once for all by his own blood, thus obtaining eternal redemption.

verses.textZh: 如果山羊和公牛的血，以及母牛犊的灰，洒在不洁的人身上，尚且可以使他们成为圣洁，身体洁净，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果山羊和公牛的血，以及母牛犊的灰，洒在不洁的人身上，尚且可以使他们成为圣洁，身体洁净，
verses.textZhCuv: 若山羊和公牛的血，并母牛犊的灰，洒在不洁的人身上，尚且叫人成圣，身体洁净，
verses.textEnNiv: The blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean sanctify them so that they are outwardly clean.
verses.textEnEsv: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the sprinkling of defiled persons with the ashes of a heifer, sanctify for the purification of the flesh,
verses.textEnNkjv: For if the blood of bulls and goats and the ashes of a heifer, sprinkling the unclean, sanctifies for the purifying of the flesh,
verses.textEnNlt: Under the old system, the blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer could cleanse people’s bodies from ceremonial impurity.
verses.textEnNasb: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify for the cleansing of the flesh,
verses.textEn: The blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean sanctify them so that they are outwardly clean.

verses.textZh: 何况基督的血呢？他借着永远的灵，把自己无瑕无疵的献给神，他的血不是更能洁净我们的良心脱离致死的行为，使我们可以事奉永活的神吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 何况基督的血呢？他借着永远的灵，把自己无瑕无疵的献给神，他的血不是更能洁净我们的良心脱离致死的行为，使我们可以事奉永活的神吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 何况基督藉着永远的灵，将自己无瑕无疵献给神，他的血岂不更能洗净你们的心 ，除去你们的死行，使你们事奉那永生神吗？
verses.textEnNiv: How much more, then, will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself unblemished to God, cleanse our consciences from acts that lead to death, so that we may serve the living God!
verses.textEnEsv: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish to God, purify our conscience from dead works to serve the living God.
verses.textEnNkjv: how much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself without spot to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
verses.textEnNlt: Just think how much more the blood of Christ will purify our consciences from sinful deeds so that we can worship the living God. For by the power of the eternal Spirit, Christ offered himself to God as a perfect sacrifice for our sins.
verses.textEnNasb: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself without blemish to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
verses.textEn: How much more, then, will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself unblemished to God, cleanse our consciences from acts that lead to death, so that we may serve the living God!

verses.textZh: 因此，他作了新约的中保，借着他的死，使人在前约之下的过犯得到救赎，就叫那些蒙召的人，得着永远基业的应许。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，他作了新约的中保，借着他的死，使人在前约之下的过犯得到救赎，就叫那些蒙召的人，得着永远基业的应许。
verses.textZhCuv: 为此，他作了新约的中保，既然受死赎了人在前约之时所犯的罪过，便叫蒙召之人得着所应许永远的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: For this reason Christ is the mediator of a new covenant, that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance—now that he has died as a ransom to set them free from the sins committed under the first covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore he is the mediator of a new covenant, so that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance, since a death has occurred that redeems them from the transgressions committed under the first covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: And for this reason He is the Mediator of the new covenant, by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions under the first covenant, that those who are called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why he is the one who mediates a new covenant between God and people, so that all who are called can receive the eternal inheritance God has promised them. For Christ died to set them free from the penalty of the sins they had committed under that first covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason He is the mediator of a new covenant, so that, since a death has taken place for the redemption of the violations that were committed under the first covenant, those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
verses.textEn: For this reason Christ is the mediator of a new covenant, that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance—now that he has died as a ransom to set them free from the sins committed under the first covenant.

verses.textZh: 凡有遗嘱 ，必须证实立遗嘱的人死了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡有遗嘱 ，必须证实立遗嘱的人死了；
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有遗命必须等到留遗命 的人死了；
verses.textEnNiv: In the case of a will, it is necessary to prove the death of the one who made it,
verses.textEnEsv: For where a will is involved, the death of the one who made it must be established.
verses.textEnNkjv: For where there is a testament, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
verses.textEnNlt: Now when someone leaves a will, it is necessary to prove that the person who made it is dead.
verses.textEnNasb: For where there is a covenant, there must of necessity be the death of the one who made it.
verses.textEn: In the case of a will, it is necessary to prove the death of the one who made it,

verses.textZh: 因为人死了，遗嘱才能确立，立遗嘱的人还活着的时候，遗嘱决不生效。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为人死了，遗嘱才能确立，立遗嘱的人还活着的时候，遗嘱决不生效。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为人死了，遗命才有效力，若留遗命的尚在，那遗命还有用处吗？
verses.textEnNiv: because a will is in force only when somebody has died; it never takes effect while the one who made it is living.
verses.textEnEsv: For a will takes effect only at death, since it is not in force as long as the one who made it is alive.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a testament is in force after men are dead, since it has no power at all while the testator lives.
verses.textEnNlt: The will goes into effect only after the person’s death. While the person who made it is still alive, the will cannot be put into effect.
verses.textEnNasb: For a covenant is valid only when people are dead, for it is never in force while the one who made it lives.
verses.textEn: because a will is in force only when somebody has died; it never takes effect while the one who made it is living.

verses.textZh: 因此，前约并不是没有用血立的：
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，前约并不是没有用血立的：
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，前约也不是不用血立的；
verses.textEnNiv: This is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore not even the first covenant was inaugurated without blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore not even the first covenant was dedicated without blood.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why even the first covenant was put into effect with the blood of an animal.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore even the first covenant was not inaugurated without blood.
verses.textEn: This is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood.

verses.textZh: 当日摩西按照律法，向所有人民宣布了各样的诫命，就拿牛犊 的血和水，用朱红色的羊毛与牛膝草，洒在律法书上和人民身上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 当日摩西按照律法，向所有人民宣布了各样的诫命，就拿牛犊 的血和水，用朱红色的羊毛与牛膝草，洒在律法书上和人民身上，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为摩西当日照着律法将各样诫命传给众百姓，就拿朱红色绒和牛膝草，把牛犊山羊的血和水洒在书上，又洒在众百姓身上，说：
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses had proclaimed every command of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves, together with water, scarlet wool and branches of hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people.
verses.textEnEsv: For when every commandment of the law had been declared by Moses to all the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
verses.textEnNkjv: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and goats, with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
verses.textEnNlt: For after Moses had read each of God’s commandments to all the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, and sprinkled both the book of God’s law and all the people, using hyssop branches and scarlet wool.
verses.textEnNasb: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the Law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
verses.textEn: When Moses had proclaimed every command of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves, together with water, scarlet wool and branches of hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people.

verses.textZh: 说："这就是神规定你们立约的血。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："这就是神规定你们立约的血。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「这血就是神与你们立约的凭据。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "This is the blood of the covenant, which God has commanded you to keep."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "This is the blood of the covenant that God commanded for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "This blood confirms the covenant God has made with you."
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "This is the blood of the covenant which God commanded you."
verses.textEn: He said, "This is the blood of the covenant, which God has commanded you to keep."

verses.textZh: 他照样把血洒在会幕和各样应用的器皿上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他照样把血洒在会幕和各样应用的器皿上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又照样把血洒在帐幕和各样器皿上。
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, he sprinkled with the blood both the tabernacle and everything used in its ceremonies.
verses.textEnEsv: And in the same way he sprinkled with the blood both the tent and all the vessels used in worship.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then likewise he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry.
verses.textEnNlt: And in the same way, he sprinkled blood on the Tabernacle and on everything used for worship.
verses.textEnNasb: And in the same way he sprinkled both the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry with the blood.
verses.textEn: In the same way, he sprinkled with the blood both the tabernacle and everything used in its ceremonies.

verses.textZh: 按着律法，几乎所有都是用血洁净的，如果没有流血，就没有赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 按着律法，几乎所有都是用血洁净的，如果没有流血，就没有赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 按着律法，凡物差不多都是用血洁净的；若不流血，罪就不得赦免了。
verses.textEnNiv: In fact, the law requires that nearly everything be cleansed with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.
verses.textEnEsv: Indeed, under the law almost everything is purified with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: And according to the law almost all things are purified with blood, and without shedding of blood there is no remission.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, according to the law of Moses, nearly everything was purified with blood. For without the shedding of blood, there is no forgiveness.
verses.textEnNasb: And almost all things are cleansed with blood, according to the Law, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.
verses.textEn: In fact, the law requires that nearly everything be cleansed with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.

verses.textZh: 照着天上样式作的既然必须这样去洁净，天上物体的本身，就应该用更美的祭品去洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照着天上样式作的既然必须这样去洁净，天上物体的本身，就应该用更美的祭品去洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 照着天上样式做的物件必须用这些祭物去洁净；但那天上的本物自然当用更美的祭物去洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: It was necessary, then, for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus it was necessary for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these rites, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore itwas necessary that the copies of the things in the heavens should be purified with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the Tabernacle and everything in it, which were copies of things in heaven, had to be purified by the blood of animals. But the real things in heaven had to be purified with far better sacrifices than the blood of animals.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore it was necessary for the copies of the things in the heavens to be cleansed with these things, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.textEn: It was necessary, then, for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

verses.textZh: 因为基督不是进了人手所做的圣所 ，而是进到天上，现在替我们显露在神的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为基督不是进了人手所做的圣所 ，而是进到天上，现在替我们显露在神的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为基督并不是进了人手所造的圣所（这不过是真圣所的影像），乃是进了天堂，如今为我们显在神面前；
verses.textEnNiv: For Christ did not enter a sanctuary made with human hands that was only a copy of the true one; he entered heaven itself, now to appear for us in God’s presence.
verses.textEnEsv: For Christ has entered, not into holy places made with hands, which are copies of the true things, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God on our behalf.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Christ has not entered the holy places made with hands, whichare copies of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;
verses.textEnNlt: For Christ did not enter into a holy place made with human hands, which was only a copy of the true one in heaven. He entered into heaven itself to appear now before God on our behalf.
verses.textEnNasb: For Christ did not enter a holy place made by hands, a mere copy of the true one, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;
verses.textEn: For Christ did not enter a sanctuary made with human hands that was only a copy of the true one; he entered heaven itself, now to appear for us in God’s presence.

verses.textZh: 他不必多次把自己献上，好象大祭司每年带着不是自己的血进入至圣所一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不必多次把自己献上，好象大祭司每年带着不是自己的血进入至圣所一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不是多次将自己献上，像那大祭司每年带着牛羊的血 进入圣所，
verses.textEnNiv: Nor did he enter heaven to offer himself again and again, the way the high priest enters the Most Holy Place every year with blood that is not his own.
verses.textEnEsv: Nor was it to offer himself repeatedly, as the high priest enters the holy places every year with blood not his own,
verses.textEnNkjv: not that He should offer Himself often, as the high priest enters the Most Holy Place every year with blood of another—
verses.textEnNlt: And he did not enter heaven to offer himself again and again, like the high priest here on earth who enters the Most Holy Place year after year with the blood of an animal.
verses.textEnNasb: nor was it that He would offer Himself often, as the high priest enters the Holy Place year by year with blood that is not his own.
verses.textEn: Nor did he enter heaven to offer himself again and again, the way the high priest enters the Most Holy Place every year with blood that is not his own.

verses.textZh: 如果这样，他从创世以来，就必须受许多次的苦了。可是现在他在这世代的终结，只显现一次，把自己作为祭品献上，好除掉罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果这样，他从创世以来，就必须受许多次的苦了。可是现在他在这世代的终结，只显现一次，把自己作为祭品献上，好除掉罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 如果这样，他从创世以来，就必多次受苦了。但如今在这末世显现一次，把自己献为祭，好除掉罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Otherwise Christ would have had to suffer many times since the creation of the world. But he has appeared once for all at the culmination of the ages to do away with sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.textEnEsv: for then he would have had to suffer repeatedly since the foundation of the world. But as it is, he has appeared once for all at the end of the ages to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: He then would have had to suffer often since the foundation of the world; but now, once at the end of the ages, He has appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of Himself.
verses.textEnNlt: If that had been necessary, Christ would have had to die again and again, ever since the world began. But now, once for all time, he has appeared at the end of the age to remove sin by his own death as a sacrifice.
verses.textEnNasb: Otherwise, He would have needed to suffer often since the foundation of the world; but now once at the consummation of the ages He has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of Himself.
verses.textEn: Otherwise Christ would have had to suffer many times since the creation of the world. But he has appeared once for all at the culmination of the ages to do away with sin by the sacrifice of himself.

verses.textZh: 按着定命，人人都要死一次，死后还有审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 按着定命，人人都要死一次，死后还有审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment,
verses.textEnEsv: And just as it is appointed for man to die once, and after that comes judgment,
verses.textEnNkjv: And as it is appointed for men to die once, but after this the judgment,
verses.textEnNlt: And just as each person is destined to die once and after that comes judgment,
verses.textEnNasb: And just as it is destined for people to die once, and after this comes judgment,
verses.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment,

verses.textZh: 照样，基督为了担当许多人的罪，也曾经一次把自己献上；将来他还要再一次显现，不是为担当罪，而是要向那些热切期待他的人成全救恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，基督为了担当许多人的罪，也曾经一次把自己献上；将来他还要再一次显现，不是为担当罪，而是要向那些热切期待他的人成全救恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 像这样，基督既然一次被献，担当了多人的罪，将来要向那等候他的人第二次显现，并与罪无关，乃是为拯救他们。
verses.textEnNiv: so Christ was sacrificed once to take away the sins of many; and he will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him.
verses.textEnEsv: so Christ, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: so Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many. To those who eagerly wait for Him He will appear a second time, apart from sin, for salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: so also Christ was offered once for all time as a sacrifice to take away the sins of many people. He will come again, not to deal with our sins, but to bring salvation to all who are eagerly waiting for him.
verses.textEnNasb: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time for salvation without reference to sin, to those who eagerly await Him.
verses.textEn: so Christ was sacrificed once to take away the sins of many; and he will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him.

verses.textZh: 律法既然是以后要来的美好事物的影子，不是本体的真象，就不能凭着每年献同样的祭品，使那些进前来的人得到完全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 律法既然是以后要来的美好事物的影子，不是本体的真象，就不能凭着每年献同样的祭品，使那些进前来的人得到完全。
verses.textZhCuv: 律法既是将来美事的影儿，不是本物的真像，总不能藉着每年常献一样的祭物叫那近前来的人得以完全。
verses.textEnNiv: The law is only a shadow of the good things that are coming—not the realities themselves. For this reason it can never, by the same sacrifices repeated endlessly year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.
verses.textEnEsv: For since the law has but a shadow of the good things to come instead of the true form of these realities, it can never, by the same sacrifices that are continually offered every year, make perfect those who draw near.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the law, having a shadow of the good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with these same sacrifices, which they offer continually year by year, make those who approach perfect.
verses.textEnNlt: The old system under the law of Moses was only a shadow, a dim preview of the good things to come, not the good things themselves. The sacrifices under that system were repeated again and again, year after year, but they were never able to provide perfect cleansing for those who came to worship.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Law, since it has only a shadow of the good things to come and not the form of those things itself, can never, by the same sacrifices which they offer continually every year, make those who approach perfect.
verses.textEn: The law is only a shadow of the good things that are coming—not the realities themselves. For this reason it can never, by the same sacrifices repeated endlessly year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.

verses.textZh: 如果敬拜的人一次得洁净，良心就不再觉得有罪，那么，献祭的事不是早就停止了吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果敬拜的人一次得洁净，良心就不再觉得有罪，那么，献祭的事不是早就停止了吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 若不然，献祭的事岂不早已止住了吗？因为礼拜的人，良心既被洁净，就不再觉得有罪了。
verses.textEnNiv: Otherwise, would they not have stopped being offered? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt guilty for their sins.
verses.textEnEsv: Otherwise, would they not have ceased to be offered, since the worshipers, having once been cleansed, would no longer have any consciousness of sins?
verses.textEnNkjv: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? For the worshipers, once purified, would have had no more consciousness of sins.
verses.textEnNlt: If they could have provided perfect cleansing, the sacrifices would have stopped, for the worshipers would have been purified once for all time, and their feelings of guilt would have disappeared.
verses.textEnNasb: Otherwise, would they not have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having once been cleansed, would no longer have had consciousness of sins?
verses.textEn: Otherwise, would they not have stopped being offered? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt guilty for their sins.

verses.textZh: 可是那些祭品，却使人每年都想起罪来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是那些祭品，却使人每年都想起罪来，
verses.textZhCuv: 但这些祭物是叫人每年想起罪来；
verses.textEnNiv: But those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins.
verses.textEnEsv: But in these sacrifices there is a reminder of sins every year.
verses.textEnNkjv: But in those sacrificesthereis a reminder of sins every year.
verses.textEnNlt: But instead, those sacrifices actually reminded them of their sins year after year.
verses.textEnNasb: But in those sacrifices there is a reminder of sins every year.
verses.textEn: But those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins.

verses.textZh: 因为公牛和山羊的血不能把罪除去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为公牛和山羊的血不能把罪除去。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为公牛和山羊的血，断不能除罪。
verses.textEnNiv: It is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: For itis not possible that the blood of bulls and goats could take away sins.
verses.textEnNlt: For it is not possible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
verses.textEnNasb: For it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
verses.textEn: It is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

verses.textZh: 所以，基督到世上来的时候，就说： "祭品和礼物不是你所要的， 你却为我预备了身体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，基督到世上来的时候，就说： "祭品和礼物不是你所要的， 你却为我预备了身体。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以基督到世上来的时候，就说：神啊，祭物和礼物是你不愿意的； 你曾给我预备了身体。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, he said: "Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but a body you prepared for me;
verses.textEnEsv: Consequently, when Christ came into the world, he said, "Sacrifices and offerings you have not desired, but a body have you prepared for me;
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, when He came into the world, He said: "Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, But a body You have prepared for Me.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why, when Christ came into the world, he said to God, "You did not want animal sacrifices or sin offerings. But you have given me a body to offer.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, when He comes into the world, He says, "You have not desired sacrifice and offering, But You have prepared a body for Me;
verses.textEn: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, he said: "Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but a body you prepared for me;

verses.textZh: 燔祭和赎罪祭， 不是你所喜悦的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 燔祭和赎罪祭， 不是你所喜悦的；
verses.textZhCuv: 燔祭和赎罪祭是你不喜欢的。
verses.textEnNiv: with burnt offerings and sin offerings you were not pleased.
verses.textEnEsv: in burnt offerings and sin offerings you have taken no pleasure.
verses.textEnNkjv: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin You had no pleasure.
verses.textEnNlt: You were not pleased with burnt offerings or other offerings for sin.
verses.textEnNasb: You have not taken pleasure in whole burnt offerings and offerings for sin.
verses.textEn: with burnt offerings and sin offerings you were not pleased.

verses.textZh: 那时我说： ‘看哪！我来了， 经卷上已经记载我的事，神啊！我来是要遵行你的旨意。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时我说： ‘看哪！我来了， 经卷上已经记载我的事，神啊！我来是要遵行你的旨意。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时我说：神啊，我来了， 为要照你的旨意行； 我的事在经卷上已经记载了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said, ‘Here I am—it is written about me in the scroll— I have come to do your will, my God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come to do your will, O God, as it is written of me in the scroll of the book.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come— In the volume of the book it is written of Me— To do Your will, O God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, ‘Look, I have come to do your will, O God— as is written about me in the Scriptures.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (It is written of Me in the scroll of the book) To do Your will, O God.’ "
verses.textEn: Then I said, ‘Here I am—it is written about me in the scroll— I have come to do your will, my God.’ "

verses.textZh: 前面说："祭品和礼物，燔祭和赎罪祭，不是你所要的，也不是你所喜悦的。"这些都是按照律法献的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 前面说："祭品和礼物，燔祭和赎罪祭，不是你所要的，也不是你所喜悦的。"这些都是按照律法献的；
verses.textZhCuv: 以上说：「祭物和礼物，燔祭和赎罪祭，是你不愿意的，也是你不喜欢的（这都是按着律法献的）」；
verses.textEnNiv: First he said, "Sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and sin offerings you did not desire, nor were you pleased with them"—though they were offered in accordance with the law.
verses.textEnEsv: When he said above, "You have neither desired nor taken pleasure in sacrifices and offerings and burnt offerings and sin offerings" (these are offered according to the law),
verses.textEnNkjv: Previously saying, "Sacrifice and offering, burnt offerings, and offerings for sin You did not desire, nor had pleasure inthem" (which are offered according to the law),
verses.textEnNlt: First, Christ said, "You did not want animal sacrifices or sin offerings or burnt offerings or other offerings for sin, nor were you pleased with them" (though they are required by the law of Moses).
verses.textEnNasb: After saying above, "Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and offerings for sin You have not desired, nor have You taken pleasure in them" (which are offered according to the Law),
verses.textEn: First he said, "Sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and sin offerings you did not desire, nor were you pleased with them"—though they were offered in accordance with the law.

verses.textZh: 接着又说："看哪！我来了，是要遵行你的旨意。"可见他废除那先前的，为要建立那后来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着又说："看哪！我来了，是要遵行你的旨意。"可见他废除那先前的，为要建立那后来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 后又说：「我来了为要照你的旨意行」；可见他是除去在先的，为要立定在后的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said, "Here I am, I have come to do your will." He sets aside the first to establish the second.
verses.textEnEsv: then he added, "Behold, I have come to do your will." He does away with the first in order to establish the second.
verses.textEnNkjv: then He said, "Behold, I have come to do Your will, O God." He takes away the first that He may establish the second.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "Look, I have come to do your will." He cancels the first covenant in order to put the second into effect.
verses.textEnNasb: then He said, "Behold, I have come to do Your will." He takes away the first in order to establish the second.
verses.textEn: Then he said, "Here I am, I have come to do your will." He sets aside the first to establish the second.

verses.textZh: 我们凭着这旨意，借着耶稣基督一次献上他的身体，就已经成圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们凭着这旨意，借着耶稣基督一次献上他的身体，就已经成圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们凭这旨意，靠耶稣基督，只一次献上他的身体，就得以成圣。
verses.textEnNiv: And by that will, we have been made holy through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
verses.textEnEsv: And by that will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
verses.textEnNkjv: By that will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once forall.
verses.textEnNlt: For God’s will was for us to be made holy by the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ, once for all time.
verses.textEnNasb: By this will, we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all time.
verses.textEn: And by that will, we have been made holy through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

verses.textZh: 所有的祭司都是天天站着事奉，多次献上同样的祭品，那些祭品永远不能把罪除去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的祭司都是天天站着事奉，多次献上同样的祭品，那些祭品永远不能把罪除去。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡祭司天天站着事奉神，屡次献上一样的祭物，这祭物永不能除罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Day after day every priest stands and performs his religious duties; again and again he offers the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.
verses.textEnEsv: And every priest stands daily at his service, offering repeatedly the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: And every priest stands ministering daily and offering repeatedly the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.
verses.textEnNlt: Under the old covenant, the priest stands and ministers before the altar day after day, offering the same sacrifices again and again, which can never take away sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Every priest stands daily ministering and offering time after time the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins;
verses.textEn: Day after day every priest stands and performs his religious duties; again and again he offers the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.

verses.textZh: 唯有基督献上了一次永远有效的赎罪祭，就在神的右边坐下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯有基督献上了一次永远有效的赎罪祭，就在神的右边坐下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 但基督献了一次永远的赎罪祭，就在神的右边坐下了。
verses.textEnNiv: But when this priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, he sat down at the right hand of God,
verses.textEnEsv: But when Christ had offered for all time a single sacrifice for sins, he sat down at the right hand of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: But this Man, after He had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down at the right hand of God,
verses.textEnNlt: But our High Priest offered himself to God as a single sacrifice for sins, good for all time. Then he sat down in the place of honor at God’s right hand.
verses.textEnNasb: but He, having offered one sacrifice for sins for all time, sat down at the right hand of God,
verses.textEn: But when this priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, he sat down at the right hand of God,

verses.textZh: 此后，只是等待神把他的仇敌放在他的脚下，作他的脚凳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此后，只是等待神把他的仇敌放在他的脚下，作他的脚凳。
verses.textZhCuv: 从此，等候他仇敌成了他的脚凳。
verses.textEnNiv: and since that time he waits for his enemies to be made his footstool.
verses.textEnEsv: waiting from that time until his enemies should be made a footstool for his feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: from that time waiting till His enemies are made His footstool.
verses.textEnNlt: There he waits until his enemies are humbled and made a footstool under his feet.
verses.textEnNasb: waiting from that time onward until His enemies are made a footstool for His feet.
verses.textEn: and since that time he waits for his enemies to be made his footstool.

verses.textZh: 因为他献上了一次的祭，就使那些成圣的人永远得到完全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他献上了一次的祭，就使那些成圣的人永远得到完全。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他一次献祭，便叫那得以成圣的人永远完全。
verses.textEnNiv: For by one sacrifice he has made perfect forever those who are being made holy.
verses.textEnEsv: For by a single offering he has perfected for all time those who are being sanctified.
verses.textEnNkjv: For by one offering He has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.
verses.textEnNlt: For by that one offering he forever made perfect those who are being made holy.
verses.textEnNasb: For by one offering He has perfected for all time those who are sanctified.
verses.textEn: For by one sacrifice he has made perfect forever those who are being made holy.

verses.textZh: 圣灵也向我们作见证，因为后来他说过：
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣灵也向我们作见证，因为后来他说过：
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵也对我们作见证；因为他既已说过：
verses.textEnNiv: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. First he says:
verses.textEnEsv: And the Holy Spirit also bears witness to us; for after saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Holy Spirit also witnesses to us; for after He had said before,
verses.textEnNlt: And the Holy Spirit also testifies that this is so. For he says,
verses.textEnNasb: And the Holy Spirit also testifies to us; for after saying,
verses.textEn: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. First he says:

verses.textZh: "主说：‘在那些日子以后， 我要与他们所立的约是这样： 我要把我的律法放在他们的心思里面， 写在他们的心上。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "主说：‘在那些日子以后， 我要与他们所立的约是这样： 我要把我的律法放在他们的心思里面， 写在他们的心上。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 主说：那些日子以后， 我与他们所立的约乃是这样： 我要将我的律法写在他们心上， 又要放在他们的里面。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the covenant I will make with them after that time, says the Lord. I will put my laws in their hearts, and I will write them on their minds."
verses.textEnEsv: "This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord: I will put my laws on their hearts, and write them on their minds,"
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says the Lord: I will put My laws into their hearts, and in their minds I will write them,"
verses.textEnNlt: "This is the new covenant I will make with my people on that day, says the Lord : I will put my laws in their hearts, and I will write them on their minds."
verses.textEnNasb: "This is the covenant which I will make with them After those days, declares the Lord: I will put My laws upon their hearts, And write them on their mind," He then says,
verses.textEn: "This is the covenant I will make with them after that time, says the Lord. I will put my laws in their hearts, and I will write them on their minds."

verses.textZh: 又说："我决不再记着他们的罪恶， 和不法的行为。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说："我决不再记着他们的罪恶， 和不法的行为。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以后就说： 我不再记念他们的罪愆和他们的过犯。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he adds: "Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more."
verses.textEnEsv: then he adds, "I will remember their sins and their lawless deeds no more."
verses.textEnNkjv: thenHeadds, "Their sins and their lawless deeds I will remember no more."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he says, "I will never again remember their sins and lawless deeds."
verses.textEnNasb: "And their sins and their lawless deeds I will no longer remember."
verses.textEn: Then he adds: "Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more."

verses.textZh: 这一切既然都赦免了，就不必再为罪献祭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切既然都赦免了，就不必再为罪献祭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些罪过既已赦免，就不用再为罪献祭了。
verses.textEnNiv: And where these have been forgiven, sacrifice for sin is no longer necessary.
verses.textEnEsv: Where there is forgiveness of these, there is no longer any offering for sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now where there is remission of these, thereis no longer an offering for sin.
verses.textEnNlt: And when sins have been forgiven, there is no need to offer any more sacrifices.
verses.textEnNasb: Now where there is forgiveness of these things, an offering for sin is no longer required.
verses.textEn: And where these have been forgiven, sacrifice for sin is no longer necessary.

verses.textZh: 所以，弟兄们！我们凭着耶稣的血，可以坦然无惧地进入至圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，弟兄们！我们凭着耶稣的血，可以坦然无惧地进入至圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我们既因耶稣的血得以坦然进入至圣所，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, brothers and sisters, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the holy places by the blood of Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, brethren, having boldness to enter the Holiest by the blood of Jesus,
verses.textEnNlt: And so, dear brothers and sisters, we can boldly enter heaven’s Most Holy Place because of the blood of Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, brothers and sisters, since we have confidence to enter the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
verses.textEn: Therefore, brothers and sisters, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,

verses.textZh: 这进入的路，是他给我们开辟的，是一条通过幔子、又新又活的路，这幔子就是他的身体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这进入的路，是他给我们开辟的，是一条通过幔子、又新又活的路，这幔子就是他的身体。
verses.textZhCuv: 是藉着他给我们开了一条又新又活的路，从幔子经过，这幔子就是他的身体。
verses.textEnNiv: by a new and living way opened for us through the curtain, that is, his body,
verses.textEnEsv: by the new and living way that he opened for us through the curtain, that is, through his flesh,
verses.textEnNkjv: by a new and living way which He consecrated for us, through the veil, that is, His flesh,
verses.textEnNlt: By his death, Jesus opened a new and life-giving way through the curtain into the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNasb: by a new and living way which He inaugurated for us through the veil, that is, through His flesh,
verses.textEn: by a new and living way opened for us through the curtain, that is, his body,

verses.textZh: 我们既然有一位伟大的祭司治理神的家，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们既然有一位伟大的祭司治理神的家，
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一位大祭司治理神的家，
verses.textEnNiv: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
verses.textEnEsv: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: and having a High Priest over the house of God,
verses.textEnNlt: And since we have a great High Priest who rules over God’s house,
verses.textEnNasb: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
verses.textEn: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,

verses.textZh: 我们良心的邪恶既然被洒净，身体也用清水洗净了，那么，我们就应该怀着真诚的心和完备的信，进到神面前；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们良心的邪恶既然被洒净，身体也用清水洗净了，那么，我们就应该怀着真诚的心和完备的信，进到神面前；
verses.textZhCuv: 并我们心中天良的亏欠已经洒去，身体用清水洗净了，就当存着诚心和充足的信心来到神面前；
verses.textEnNiv: let us draw near to God with a sincere heart and with the full assurance that faith brings, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and having our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.textEnEsv: let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, with our hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.textEnNkjv: let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.textEnNlt: let us go right into the presence of God with sincere hearts fully trusting him. For our guilty consciences have been sprinkled with Christ’s blood to make us clean, and our bodies have been washed with pure water.
verses.textEnNasb: let’s approach God with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.textEn: let us draw near to God with a sincere heart and with the full assurance that faith brings, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and having our bodies washed with pure water.

verses.textZh: 又应该坚持我们所宣认的盼望，毫不动摇，因为那应许我们的是信实的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又应该坚持我们所宣认的盼望，毫不动摇，因为那应许我们的是信实的。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要坚守我们所承认的指望，不至摇动，因为那应许我们的是信实的。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful.
verses.textEnEsv: Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for he who promised is faithful.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful.
verses.textEnNlt: Let us hold tightly without wavering to the hope we affirm, for God can be trusted to keep his promise.
verses.textEnNasb: Let’s hold firmly to the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful;
verses.textEn: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful.

verses.textZh: 我们又应该彼此关心，激发爱心，勉励行善。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们又应该彼此关心，激发爱心，勉励行善。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要彼此相顾，激发爱心，勉励行善。
verses.textEnNiv: And let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds,
verses.textEnEsv: And let us consider how to stir up one another to love and good works,
verses.textEnNkjv: And let us consider one another in order to stir up love and good works,
verses.textEnNlt: Let us think of ways to motivate one another to acts of love and good works.
verses.textEnNasb: and let’s consider how to encourage one another in love and good deeds,
verses.textEn: And let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds,

verses.textZh: 我们不可放弃聚会，好象有些人的习惯一样；却要互相劝勉。你们既然知道那日子临近，就更应该这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们不可放弃聚会，好象有些人的习惯一样；却要互相劝勉。你们既然知道那日子临近，就更应该这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不可停止聚会，好像那些停止惯了的人，倒要彼此劝勉，既知道 那日子临近，就更当如此。
verses.textEnNiv: not giving up meeting together, as some are in the habit of doing, but encouraging one another—and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
verses.textEnEsv: not neglecting to meet together, as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another, and all the more as you see the Day drawing near.
verses.textEnNkjv: not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as is the manner of some, but exhorting oneanother, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
verses.textEnNlt: And let us not neglect our meeting together, as some people do, but encourage one another, especially now that the day of his return is drawing near.
verses.textEnNasb: not abandoning our own meeting together, as is the habit of some people, but encouraging one another; and all the more as you see the day drawing near.
verses.textEn: not giving up meeting together, as some are in the habit of doing, but encouraging one another—and all the more as you see the Day approaching.

verses.textZh: 如果我们领受了真理的知识以后，还是故意犯罪，就再没有留下赎罪的祭品了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们领受了真理的知识以后，还是故意犯罪，就再没有留下赎罪的祭品了；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们得知真道以后，若故意犯罪，赎罪的祭就再没有了；
verses.textEnNiv: If we deliberately keep on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left,
verses.textEnEsv: For if we go on sinning deliberately after receiving the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,
verses.textEnNkjv: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friends, if we deliberately continue sinning after we have received knowledge of the truth, there is no longer any sacrifice that will cover these sins.
verses.textEnNasb: For if we go on sinning willfully after receiving the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,
verses.textEn: If we deliberately keep on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left,

verses.textZh: 只好恐惧地等待着审判，和那快要吞灭众仇敌的烈火。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只好恐惧地等待着审判，和那快要吞灭众仇敌的烈火。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有战惧等候审判和那烧灭众敌人的烈火。
verses.textEnNiv: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume the enemies of God.
verses.textEnEsv: but a fearful expectation of judgment, and a fury of fire that will consume the adversaries.
verses.textEnNkjv: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and fiery indignation which will devour the adversaries.
verses.textEnNlt: There is only the terrible expectation of God’s judgment and the raging fire that will consume his enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: but a terrifying expectation of judgment and the fury of a fire which will consume the adversaries.
verses.textEn: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume the enemies of God.

verses.textZh: 如果有人干犯了摩西的律法，凭着两三个证人，他尚且得不到怜悯而死；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人干犯了摩西的律法，凭着两三个证人，他尚且得不到怜悯而死；
verses.textZhCuv: 人干犯摩西的律法，凭两三个见证人，尚且不得怜恤而死，
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
verses.textEnEsv: Anyone who has set aside the law of Moses dies without mercy on the evidence of two or three witnesses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Anyone who has rejected Moses’ law dies without mercy on thetestimonyof two or three witnesses.
verses.textEnNlt: For anyone who refused to obey the law of Moses was put to death without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
verses.textEnNasb: Anyone who has ignored the Law of Moses is put to death without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
verses.textEn: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

verses.textZh: 何况是践踏神的儿子，把那使他成圣的立约的血当作俗物，又侮辱施恩的圣灵的人，你们想想，他不是应该受更严厉的刑罚吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 何况是践踏神的儿子，把那使他成圣的立约的血当作俗物，又侮辱施恩的圣灵的人，你们想想，他不是应该受更严厉的刑罚吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 何况人践踏神的儿子，将那使他成圣之约的血当作平常，又亵慢施恩的圣灵，你们想，他要受的刑罚该怎样加重呢！
verses.textEnNiv: How much more severely do you think someone deserves to be punished who has trampled the Son of God underfoot, who has treated as an unholy thing the blood of the covenant that sanctified them, and who has insulted the Spirit of grace?
verses.textEnEsv: How much worse punishment, do you think, will be deserved by the one who has trampled underfoot the Son of God, and has profaned the blood of the covenant by which he was sanctified, and has outraged the Spirit of grace?
verses.textEnNkjv: Of how much worse punishment, do you suppose, will he be thought worthy who has trampled the Son of God underfoot, counted the blood of the covenant by which he was sanctified a common thing, and insulted the Spirit of grace?
verses.textEnNlt: Just think how much worse the punishment will be for those who have trampled on the Son of God, and have treated the blood of the covenant, which made us holy, as if it were common and unholy, and have insulted and disdained the Holy Spirit who brings God’s mercy to us.
verses.textEnNasb: How much more severe punishment do you think he will deserve who has trampled underfoot the Son of God, and has regarded as unclean the blood of the covenant by which he was sanctified, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?
verses.textEn: How much more severely do you think someone deserves to be punished who has trampled the Son of God underfoot, who has treated as an unholy thing the blood of the covenant that sanctified them, and who has insulted the Spirit of grace?

verses.textZh: 因为我们知道谁说过： "伸冤在我，我必报应。" 又说： "主必定审判他自己的子民。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们知道谁说过： "伸冤在我，我必报应。" 又说： "主必定审判他自己的子民。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们知道谁说：「伸冤在我，我必报应」；又说：「主要审判他的百姓。」
verses.textEnNiv: For we know him who said, "It is mine to avenge; I will repay," and again, "The Lord will judge his people."
verses.textEnEsv: For we know him who said, "Vengeance is mine; I will repay." And again, "The Lord will judge his people."
verses.textEnNkjv: For we know Him who said, "Vengeance is Mine, I will repay," says the Lord. And again, "The Lord will judge His people."
verses.textEnNlt: For we know the one who said, "I will take revenge. I will pay them back." He also said, "The Lord will judge his own people."
verses.textEnNasb: For we know Him who said, "Vengeance is Mine, I will repay." And again, "The Lord will judge His people."
verses.textEn: For we know him who said, "It is mine to avenge; I will repay," and again, "The Lord will judge his people."

verses.textZh: 落在永活的神手里，真是可怕的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 落在永活的神手里，真是可怕的。
verses.textZhCuv: 落在永生神的手里，真是可怕的！
verses.textEnNiv: It is a dreadful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.textEnEsv: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.textEnNkjv: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.textEnNlt: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.textEnNasb: It is a terrifying thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.textEn: It is a dreadful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

verses.textZh: 你们要回想从前的日子，那时，你们蒙了光照，忍受了许多痛苦的煎熬；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要回想从前的日子，那时，你们蒙了光照，忍受了许多痛苦的煎熬；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要追念往日，蒙了光照以后所忍受大争战的各样苦难：
verses.textEnNiv: Remember those earlier days after you had received the light, when you endured in a great conflict full of suffering.
verses.textEnEsv: But recall the former days when, after you were enlightened, you endured a hard struggle with sufferings,
verses.textEnNkjv: But recall the former days in which, after you were illuminated, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:
verses.textEnNlt: Think back on those early days when you first learned about Christ. Remember how you remained faithful even though it meant terrible suffering.
verses.textEnNasb: But remember the former days, when, after being enlightened, you endured a great conflict of sufferings,
verses.textEn: Remember those earlier days after you had received the light, when you endured in a great conflict full of suffering.

verses.textZh: 有时在众人面前被辱骂，遭患难；有时却成了遭遇同样情形的人的同伴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有时在众人面前被辱骂，遭患难；有时却成了遭遇同样情形的人的同伴。
verses.textZhCuv: 一面被毁谤，遭患难，成了戏景，叫众人观看；一面陪伴那些受这样苦难的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to insult and persecution; at other times you stood side by side with those who were so treated.
verses.textEnEsv: sometimes being publicly exposed to reproach and affliction, and sometimes being partners with those so treated.
verses.textEnNkjv: partly while you were made a spectacle both by reproaches and tribulations, and partly while you became companions of those who were so treated;
verses.textEnNlt: Sometimes you were exposed to public ridicule and were beaten, and sometimes you helped others who were suffering the same things.
verses.textEnNasb: partly by being made a public spectacle through insults and distress, and partly by becoming companions with those who were so treated.
verses.textEn: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to insult and persecution; at other times you stood side by side with those who were so treated.

verses.textZh: 你们同情那些遭监禁的人；你们的家业被抢夺的时候，又以喜乐的心接受，因为知道自己有更美长存的家业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们同情那些遭监禁的人；你们的家业被抢夺的时候，又以喜乐的心接受，因为知道自己有更美长存的家业。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们体恤了那些被捆锁的人，并且你们的家业被人抢去，也甘心忍受，知道自己有更美长存的家业。
verses.textEnNiv: You suffered along with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, because you knew that you yourselves had better and lasting possessions.
verses.textEnEsv: For you had compassion on those in prison, and you joyfully accepted the plundering of your property, since you knew that you yourselves had a better possession and an abiding one.
verses.textEnNkjv: for you had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your goods, knowing that you have a better and an enduring possession for yourselves in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: You suffered along with those who were thrown into jail, and when all you owned was taken from you, you accepted it with joy. You knew there were better things waiting for you that will last forever.
verses.textEnNasb: For you showed sympathy to the prisoners and accepted joyfully the seizure of your property, knowing that you have for yourselves a better and lasting possession.
verses.textEn: You suffered along with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, because you knew that you yourselves had better and lasting possessions.

verses.textZh: 所以，你们不可丢弃坦然无惧的心，这样的心是带有大赏赐的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们不可丢弃坦然无惧的心，这样的心是带有大赏赐的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们不可丢弃勇敢的心；存这样的心必得大赏赐。
verses.textEnNiv: So do not throw away your confidence; it will be richly rewarded.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore do not throw away your confidence, which has a great reward.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore do not cast away your confidence, which has great reward.
verses.textEnNlt: So do not throw away this confident trust in the Lord. Remember the great reward it brings you!
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, do not throw away your confidence, which has a great reward.
verses.textEn: So do not throw away your confidence; it will be richly rewarded.

verses.textZh: 你们还需要忍耐，好使你们行完了神的旨意，可以领受所应许的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们还需要忍耐，好使你们行完了神的旨意，可以领受所应许的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们必须忍耐，使你们行完了神的旨意，就可以得着所应许的。
verses.textEnNiv: You need to persevere so that when you have done the will of God, you will receive what he has promised.
verses.textEnEsv: For you have need of endurance, so that when you have done the will of God you may receive what is promised.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you have need of endurance, so that after you have done the will of God, you may receive the promise:
verses.textEnNlt: Patient endurance is what you need now, so that you will continue to do God’s will. Then you will receive all that he has promised.
verses.textEnNasb: For you have need of endurance, so that when you have done the will of God, you may receive what was promised.
verses.textEn: You need to persevere so that when you have done the will of God, you will receive what he has promised.

verses.textZh: 因为： "还有一点点的时候， 那要来的就来， 并不迟延。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为： "还有一点点的时候， 那要来的就来， 并不迟延。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为还有一点点时候， 那要来的就来，并不迟延；
verses.textEnNiv: For, "In just a little while, he who is coming will come and will not delay."
verses.textEnEsv: For, "Yet a little while, and the coming one will come and will not delay;
verses.textEnNkjv: "For yet a little while, And He who is coming will come and will not tarry.
verses.textEnNlt: "For in just a little while, the Coming One will come and not delay.
verses.textEnNasb: For yet in a very little while, He who is coming will come, and will not delay.
verses.textEn: For, "In just a little while, he who is coming will come and will not delay."

verses.textZh: 我的义人必因信得生， 如果他后退， 我的心就不喜悦他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的义人必因信得生， 如果他后退， 我的心就不喜悦他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只是义人 必因信得生。 他若退后，我心里就不喜欢他。
verses.textEnNiv: And, "But my righteous one will live by faith. And I take no pleasure in the one who shrinks back."
verses.textEnEsv: but my righteous one shall live by faith, and if he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the just shall live by faith; But if anyone draws back, My soul has no pleasure in him."
verses.textEnNlt: And my righteous ones will live by faith. But I will take no pleasure in anyone who turns away."
verses.textEnNasb: But My righteous one will live by faith; And if he shrinks back, My soul has no pleasure in him.
verses.textEn: And, "But my righteous one will live by faith. And I take no pleasure in the one who shrinks back."

verses.textZh: 但我们不是那些后退以致灭亡的人，而是有信心以致保全生命的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我们不是那些后退以致灭亡的人，而是有信心以致保全生命的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们却不是退后入沉沦的那等人，乃是有信心以致灵魂得救的人。
verses.textEnNiv: But we do not belong to those who shrink back and are destroyed, but to those who have faith and are saved.
verses.textEnEsv: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who have faith and preserve their souls.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we are not of those who draw back to perdition, but of those who believe to the saving of the soul.
verses.textEnNlt: But we are not like those who turn away from God to their own destruction. We are the faithful ones, whose souls will be saved.
verses.textEnNasb: But we are not among those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith for the safekeeping of the soul.
verses.textEn: But we do not belong to those who shrink back and are destroyed, but to those who have faith and are saved.

verses.textZh: 信就是对所盼望的事的把握，是还没有看见的事的明证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 信就是对所盼望的事的把握，是还没有看见的事的明证。
verses.textZhCuv: 信就是所望之事的实底，是未见之事的确据。
verses.textEnNiv: Now faith is confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see.
verses.textEnEsv: Now faith is the assurance of things hoped for, the conviction of things not seen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
verses.textEnNlt: Faith shows the reality of what we hope for; it is the evidence of things we cannot see.
verses.textEnNasb: Now faith is the certainty of things hoped for, a proof of things not seen.
verses.textEn: Now faith is confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see.

verses.textZh: 因着这信心，古人得到了称许。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着这信心，古人得到了称许。
verses.textZhCuv: 古人在这信上得了美好的证据。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the ancients were commended for.
verses.textEnEsv: For by it the people of old received their commendation.
verses.textEnNkjv: For by it the elders obtained a good testimony.
verses.textEnNlt: Through their faith, the people in days of old earned a good reputation.
verses.textEnNasb: For by it the people of old gained approval.
verses.textEn: This is what the ancients were commended for.

verses.textZh: 因着信，我们就明白宇宙 是因着神的话造成的。这样，那看得见的就是从那看不见的造出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，我们就明白宇宙 是因着神的话造成的。这样，那看得见的就是从那看不见的造出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们因着信，就知道诸世界是藉神的话造成的；这样，所看见的，并不是从显然之物造出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith we understand that the universe was created by the word of God, so that what is seen was not made out of things that are visible.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that the things which are seen were not made of things which are visible.
verses.textEnNlt: By faith we understand that the entire universe was formed at God’s command, that what we now see did not come from anything that can be seen.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith we understand that the world has been created by the word of God so that what is seen has not been made out of things that are visible.
verses.textEn: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.

verses.textZh: 因着信，亚伯比该隐献上更美的祭品给神；借着这信心，他被神称许为义人，这是神指着他的礼物所作的见证；他虽然死了，却借着信仍然说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，亚伯比该隐献上更美的祭品给神；借着这信心，他被神称许为义人，这是神指着他的礼物所作的见证；他虽然死了，却借着信仍然说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯因着信，献祭与神，比该隐所献的更美，因此便得了称义的见证，就是神指他礼物作的见证。他虽然死了，却因这信，仍旧说话。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith Abel brought God a better offering than Cain did. By faith he was commended as righteous, when God spoke well of his offerings. And by faith Abel still speaks, even though he is dead.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith Abel offered to God a more acceptable sacrifice than Cain, through which he was commended as righteous, God commending him by accepting his gifts. And through his faith, though he died, he still speaks.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts; and through it he being dead still speaks.
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that Abel brought a more acceptable offering to God than Cain did. Abel’s offering gave evidence that he was a righteous man, and God showed his approval of his gifts. Although Abel is long dead, he still speaks to us by his example of faith.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith Abel offered to God a better sacrifice than Cain, through which he was attested to be righteous, God testifying about his gifts, and through faith, though he is dead, he still speaks.
verses.textEn: By faith Abel brought God a better offering than Cain did. By faith he was commended as righteous, when God spoke well of his offerings. And by faith Abel still speaks, even though he is dead.

verses.textZh: 因着信，以诺被迁去了，使他不至于死，人也找不着他，因为神把他迁去了。原来在迁去以前，他已经得了神喜悦他的明证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，以诺被迁去了，使他不至于死，人也找不着他，因为神把他迁去了。原来在迁去以前，他已经得了神喜悦他的明证。
verses.textZhCuv: 以诺因着信，被接去，不至于见死，人也找不着他，因为神已经把他接去了；只是他被接去以先，已经得了神喜悦他的明证。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith Enoch was taken from this life, so that he did not experience death: "He could not be found, because God had taken him away." For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he should not see death, and he was not found, because God had taken him. Now before he was taken he was commended as having pleased God.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith Enoch was taken away so that he did not see death, "and was not found, because God had taken him"; for before he was taken he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that Enoch was taken up to heaven without dying—"he disappeared, because God took him." For before he was taken up, he was known as a person who pleased God.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he would not see death; and he was not found because God took him up; for before he was taken up, he was attested to have been pleasing to God.
verses.textEn: By faith Enoch was taken from this life, so that he did not experience death: "He could not be found, because God had taken him away." For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.

verses.textZh: 没有信，就不能得到神的喜悦；因为来到神面前的人，必须信神存在，并且信他会赏赐那些寻求他的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有信，就不能得到神的喜悦；因为来到神面前的人，必须信神存在，并且信他会赏赐那些寻求他的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 人非有信，就不能得神的喜悦；因为到神面前来的人必须信有神，且信他赏赐那寻求他的人。
verses.textEnNiv: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who earnestly seek him.
verses.textEnEsv: And without faith it is impossible to please him, for whoever would draw near to God must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who seek him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But without faith itis impossible to please Him, for he who comes to God must believe that He is, and that He is a rewarder of those who diligently seek Him.
verses.textEnNlt: And it is impossible to please God without faith. Anyone who wants to come to him must believe that God exists and that he rewards those who sincerely seek him.
verses.textEnNasb: And without faith it is impossible to please Him, for the one who comes to God must believe that He exists, and that He proves to be One who rewards those who seek Him.
verses.textEn: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who earnestly seek him.

verses.textZh: 因着信，挪亚在还没有看见的事上，得了神的警告，就动了敬畏的心，做了一艘方舟，使他全家得救。借着这信心，他就定了那世代的罪，自己也承受了那因信而来的义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，挪亚在还没有看见的事上，得了神的警告，就动了敬畏的心，做了一艘方舟，使他全家得救。借着这信心，他就定了那世代的罪，自己也承受了那因信而来的义。
verses.textZhCuv: 挪亚因着信，既蒙神指示他未见的事，动了敬畏的心，预备了一只方舟，使他全家得救。因此就定了那世代的罪，自己也承受了那从信而来的义。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in holy fear built an ark to save his family. By his faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that is in keeping with faith.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith Noah, being warned by God concerning events as yet unseen, in reverent fear constructed an ark for the saving of his household. By this he condemned the world and became an heir of the righteousness that comes by faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith Noah, being divinely warned of things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared an ark for the saving of his household, by which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that Noah built a large boat to save his family from the flood. He obeyed God, who warned him about things that had never happened before. By his faith Noah condemned the rest of the world, and he received the righteousness that comes by faith.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith Noah, being warned by God about things not yet seen, in reverence prepared an ark for the salvation of his household, by which he condemned the world, and became an heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
verses.textEn: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in holy fear built an ark to save his family. By his faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that is in keeping with faith.

verses.textZh: 因着信，亚伯拉罕在蒙召的时候，就听命往他将要承受为业的地方去；他出去的时候，还不知道要往哪里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，亚伯拉罕在蒙召的时候，就听命往他将要承受为业的地方去；他出去的时候，还不知道要往哪里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕因着信，蒙召的时候就遵命出去，往将来要得为业的地方去；出去的时候，还不知往哪里去。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, even though he did not know where he was going.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith Abraham obeyed when he was called to go out to a place that he was to receive as an inheritance. And he went out, not knowing where he was going.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith Abraham obeyed when he was called to go out to the place which he would receive as an inheritance. And he went out, not knowing where he was going.
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that Abraham obeyed when God called him to leave home and go to another land that God would give him as his inheritance. He went without knowing where he was going.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed by going out to a place which he was to receive for an inheritance; and he left, not knowing where he was going.
verses.textEn: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, even though he did not know where he was going.

verses.textZh: 因着信，他在应许之地寄居，好象是在异乡，与承受同样应许的以撒、雅各一样住在帐棚里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，他在应许之地寄居，好象是在异乡，与承受同样应许的以撒、雅各一样住在帐棚里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他因着信，就在所应许之地作客，好像在异地居住帐棚，与那同蒙一个应许的以撒、雅各一样。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith he made his home in the promised land like a stranger in a foreign country; he lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith he went to live in the land of promise, as in a foreign land, living in tents with Isaac and Jacob, heirs with him of the same promise.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith he dwelt in the land of promise as in a foreign country, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise;
verses.textEnNlt: And even when he reached the land God promised him, he lived there by faith—for he was like a foreigner, living in tents. And so did Isaac and Jacob, who inherited the same promise.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith he lived as a stranger in the land of promise, as in a foreign land, living in tents with Isaac and Jacob, fellow heirs of the same promise;
verses.textEn: By faith he made his home in the promised land like a stranger in a foreign country; he lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.

verses.textZh: 因为他等待那座有根基的城，就是神所设计所建造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他等待那座有根基的城，就是神所设计所建造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他等候那座有根基的城，就是神所经营所建造的。
verses.textEnNiv: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
verses.textEnEsv: For he was looking forward to the city that has foundations, whose designer and builder is God.
verses.textEnNkjv: for he waited for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham was confidently looking forward to a city with eternal foundations, a city designed and built by God.
verses.textEnNasb: for he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
verses.textEn: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.

verses.textZh: 因着信，甚至撒拉，她虽然过了生育的年龄，还是能够怀孕，因为她认为那应许她的是信实的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，甚至撒拉，她虽然过了生育的年龄，还是能够怀孕，因为她认为那应许她的是信实的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因着信，连撒拉自己，虽然过了生育的岁数，还能怀孕，因她以为那应许她的是可信的。
verses.textEnNiv: And by faith even Sarah, who was past childbearing age, was enabled to bear children because she considered him faithful who had made the promise.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith Sarah herself received power to conceive, even when she was past the age, since she considered him faithful who had promised.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith Sarah herself also received strength to conceive seed, and she bore a child when she was past the age, because she judged Him faithful who had promised.
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that even Sarah was able to have a child, though she was barren and was too old. She believed that God would keep his promise.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith even Sarah herself received ability to conceive, even beyond the proper time of life, since she considered Him faithful who had promised.
verses.textEn: And by faith even Sarah, who was past childbearing age, was enabled to bear children because she considered him faithful who had made the promise.

verses.textZh: 所以从一个好象已死的人，竟然生出许多子孙来，仿佛天上的星那么众多，海边的沙那么无数。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以从一个好象已死的人，竟然生出许多子孙来，仿佛天上的星那么众多，海边的沙那么无数。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以从一个仿佛已死的人就生出子孙，如同天上的星那样众多，海边的沙那样无数。
verses.textEnNiv: And so from this one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore from one man, and him as good as dead, were born descendants as many as the stars of heaven and as many as the innumerable grains of sand by the seashore.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore from one man, and him as good as dead, were born asmany as the stars of the sky in multitude—innumerable as the sand which is by the seashore.
verses.textEnNlt: And so a whole nation came from this one man who was as good as dead—a nation with so many people that, like the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore, there is no way to count them.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore even from one man, and one who was as good as dead at that, there were born descendants who were just as the stars of heaven in number, and as the innumerable grains of sand along the seashore.
verses.textEn: And so from this one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.

verses.textZh: 这些人都是存着信心死了的，还没有得着所应许的，只不过是从远处看见，就表示欢迎，又承认他们在世上是异乡人，是客旅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人都是存着信心死了的，还没有得着所应许的，只不过是从远处看见，就表示欢迎，又承认他们在世上是异乡人，是客旅。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人都是存着信心死的，并没有得着所应许的；却从远处望见，且欢喜迎接，又承认自己在世上是客旅，是寄居的。
verses.textEnNiv: All these people were still living by faith when they died. They did not receive the things promised; they only saw them and welcomed them from a distance, admitting that they were foreigners and strangers on earth.
verses.textEnEsv: These all died in faith, not having received the things promised, but having seen them and greeted them from afar, and having acknowledged that they were strangers and exiles on the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off were assured of them, embraced them and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: All these people died still believing what God had promised them. They did not receive what was promised, but they saw it all from a distance and welcomed it. They agreed that they were foreigners and nomads here on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: All these died in faith, without receiving the promises, but having seen and welcomed them from a distance, and having confessed that they were strangers and exiles on the earth.
verses.textEn: All these people were still living by faith when they died. They did not receive the things promised; they only saw them and welcomed them from a distance, admitting that they were foreigners and strangers on earth.

verses.textZh: 因为说这样话的人，是表明他们在寻求一个家乡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为说这样话的人，是表明他们在寻求一个家乡。
verses.textZhCuv: 说这样话的人是表明自己要找一个家乡。
verses.textEnNiv: People who say such things show that they are looking for a country of their own.
verses.textEnEsv: For people who speak thus make it clear that they are seeking a homeland.
verses.textEnNkjv: For those who say such things declare plainly that they seek a homeland.
verses.textEnNlt: Obviously people who say such things are looking forward to a country they can call their own.
verses.textEnNasb: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.
verses.textEn: People who say such things show that they are looking for a country of their own.

verses.textZh: 如果他们怀念已经离开了的地方，还有可以回去的机会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们怀念已经离开了的地方，还有可以回去的机会。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若想念所离开的家乡，还有可以回去的机会。
verses.textEnNiv: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.
verses.textEnEsv: If they had been thinking of that land from which they had gone out, they would have had opportunity to return.
verses.textEnNkjv: And truly if they had called to mind that country from which they had come out, they would have had opportunity to return.
verses.textEnNlt: If they had longed for the country they came from, they could have gone back.
verses.textEnNasb: And indeed if they had been thinking of that country which they left, they would have had opportunity to return.
verses.textEn: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.

verses.textZh: 但是现在他们所向往的，是一个更美的、在天上的家乡。所以，神不以他们称他为神而觉得羞耻；因为他已经为他们预备了一座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是现在他们所向往的，是一个更美的、在天上的家乡。所以，神不以他们称他为神而觉得羞耻；因为他已经为他们预备了一座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却羡慕一个更美的家乡，就是在天上的。所以神被称为他们的神，并不以为耻，因为他已经给他们预备了一座城。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, they were longing for a better country—a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
verses.textEnEsv: But as it is, they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for he has prepared for them a city.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now they desire a better, that is, a heavenly country. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.
verses.textEnNlt: But they were looking for a better place, a heavenly homeland. That is why God is not ashamed to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
verses.textEnNasb: But as it is, they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God; for He has prepared a city for them.
verses.textEn: Instead, they were longing for a better country—a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

verses.textZh: 因着信，亚伯拉罕在受试验的时候，就把以撒献上；这就是那欢喜领受应许的人，献上了自己的独生子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，亚伯拉罕在受试验的时候，就把以撒献上；这就是那欢喜领受应许的人，献上了自己的独生子；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕因着信，被试验的时候，就把以撒献上；这便是那欢喜领受应许的，将自己独生的儿子献上。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith Abraham, when God tested him, offered Isaac as a sacrifice. He who had embraced the promises was about to sacrifice his one and only son,
verses.textEnEsv: By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac, and he who had received the promises was in the act of offering up his only son,
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac, and he who had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that Abraham offered Isaac as a sacrifice when God was testing him. Abraham, who had received God’s promises, was ready to sacrifice his only son, Isaac,
verses.textEnNasb: By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac, and the one who had received the promises was offering up his only son;
verses.textEn: By faith Abraham, when God tested him, offered Isaac as a sacrifice. He who had embraced the promises was about to sacrifice his one and only son,

verses.textZh: 论到这个儿子，曾经有话说："以撒生的，才可以称为你的后裔。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到这个儿子，曾经有话说："以撒生的，才可以称为你的后裔。"
verses.textZhCuv: 论到这儿子，曾有话说：「从以撒生的才要称为你的后裔。」
verses.textEnNiv: even though God had said to him, "It is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned."
verses.textEnEsv: of whom it was said, "Through Isaac shall your offspring be named."
verses.textEnNkjv: of whom it was said, "In Isaac your seed shall be called,"
verses.textEnNlt: even though God had told him, "Isaac is the son through whom your descendants will be counted."
verses.textEnNasb: it was he to whom it was said, "Through Isaac your descendants shall be named."
verses.textEn: even though God had said to him, "It is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕认定，神能使人从死人中复活，因此，就喻意说，他的确从死里得回他的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕认定，神能使人从死人中复活，因此，就喻意说，他的确从死里得回他的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他以为神还能叫人从死里复活；他也仿佛从死中得回他的儿子来。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham reasoned that God could even raise the dead, and so in a manner of speaking he did receive Isaac back from death.
verses.textEnEsv: He considered that God was able even to raise him from the dead, from which, figuratively speaking, he did receive him back.
verses.textEnNkjv: concluding that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead, from which he also received him in a figurative sense.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham reasoned that if Isaac died, God was able to bring him back to life again. And in a sense, Abraham did receive his son back from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: He considered that God is able to raise people even from the dead, from which he also received him back as a type.
verses.textEn: Abraham reasoned that God could even raise the dead, and so in a manner of speaking he did receive Isaac back from death.

verses.textZh: 因着信，以撒给雅各和以扫祝福，论到将来的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，以撒给雅各和以扫祝福，论到将来的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒因着信，就指着将来的事给雅各、以扫祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau in regard to their future.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith Isaac invoked future blessings on Jacob and Esau.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that Isaac promised blessings for the future to his sons, Jacob and Esau.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even regarding things to come.
verses.textEn: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau in regard to their future.

verses.textZh: 因着信，雅各临死的时候，分别为约瑟的儿子祝福，又倚着杖头敬拜神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，雅各临死的时候，分别为约瑟的儿子祝福，又倚着杖头敬拜神。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各因着信，临死的时候，给约瑟的两个儿子各自祝福，扶着杖头敬拜神。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons, and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith Jacob, when dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, bowing in worship over the head of his staff.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that Jacob, when he was old and dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons and bowed in worship as he leaned on his staff.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith Jacob, as he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
verses.textEn: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons, and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.

verses.textZh: 因着信，约瑟临终的时候，提到以色列子民出埃及的事，并且为自己的骸骨留下遗言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，约瑟临终的时候，提到以色列子民出埃及的事，并且为自己的骸骨留下遗言。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟因着信，临终的时候，提到以色列族将来要出埃及，并为自己的骸骨留下遗命。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites from Egypt and gave instructions concerning the burial of his bones.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith Joseph, at the end of his life, made mention of the exodus of the Israelites and gave directions concerning his bones.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith Joseph, when he was dying, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that Joseph, when he was about to die, said confidently that the people of Israel would leave Egypt. He even commanded them to take his bones with them when they left.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith Joseph, when he was dying, made mention of the exodus of the sons of Israel, and gave orders concerning his bones.
verses.textEn: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites from Egypt and gave instructions concerning the burial of his bones.

verses.textZh: 因着信，摩西的父母在摩西生下来以后，因为看见孩子俊美，就把他藏了三个月，不怕王的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，摩西的父母在摩西生下来以后，因为看见孩子俊美，就把他藏了三个月，不怕王的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西生下来，他的父母见他是个俊美的孩子，就因着信，把他藏了三个月，并不怕王命。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after he was born, because they saw he was no ordinary child, and they were not afraid of the king’s edict.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that the child was beautiful, and they were not afraid of the king’s edict.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden three months by his parents, because they saw hewas a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s command.
