verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that Moses’ parents hid him for three months when he was born. They saw that God had given them an unusual child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king’s command.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s edict.
verses.textEn: By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after he was born, because they saw he was no ordinary child, and they were not afraid of the king’s edict.

verses.textZh: 因着信，摩西长大了以后，就拒绝被称为法老女儿的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，摩西长大了以后，就拒绝被称为法老女儿的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西因着信，长大了就不肯称为法老女儿之子。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be known as the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith Moses, when he was grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith Moses, when he became of age, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that Moses, when he grew up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
verses.textEn: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be known as the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.

verses.textZh: 他宁愿选择和神的子民一同受苦，也不肯享受罪恶中暂时的快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他宁愿选择和神的子民一同受苦，也不肯享受罪恶中暂时的快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 他宁可和神的百姓同受苦害，也不愿暂时享受罪中之乐。
verses.textEnNiv: He chose to be mistreated along with the people of God rather than to enjoy the fleeting pleasures of sin.
verses.textEnEsv: choosing rather to be mistreated with the people of God than to enjoy the fleeting pleasures of sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God than to enjoy the passing pleasures of sin,
verses.textEnNlt: He chose to share the oppression of God’s people instead of enjoying the fleeting pleasures of sin.
verses.textEnNasb: choosing rather to endure ill-treatment with the people of God than to enjoy the temporary pleasures of sin,
verses.textEn: He chose to be mistreated along with the people of God rather than to enjoy the fleeting pleasures of sin.

verses.textZh: 在他看来，为着基督受的凌辱，比埃及的财物更宝贵，因为他注视将来的赏赐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他看来，为着基督受的凌辱，比埃及的财物更宝贵，因为他注视将来的赏赐。
verses.textZhCuv: 他看为基督受的凌辱比埃及的财物更宝贵，因他想望所要得的赏赐。
verses.textEnNiv: He regarded disgrace for the sake of Christ as of greater value than the treasures of Egypt, because he was looking ahead to his reward.
verses.textEnEsv: He considered the reproach of Christ greater wealth than the treasures of Egypt, for he was looking to the reward.
verses.textEnNkjv: esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
verses.textEnNlt: He thought it was better to suffer for the sake of Christ than to own the treasures of Egypt, for he was looking ahead to his great reward.
verses.textEnNasb: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he was looking to the reward.
verses.textEn: He regarded disgrace for the sake of Christ as of greater value than the treasures of Egypt, because he was looking ahead to his reward.

verses.textZh: 因着信，他离开了埃及，不怕王的忿怒；因为他坚定不移，就像看见了人不能看见的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，他离开了埃及，不怕王的忿怒；因为他坚定不移，就像看见了人不能看见的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他因着信，就离开埃及，不怕王怒；因为他恒心忍耐，如同看见那不能看见的主。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger; he persevered because he saw him who is invisible.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith he left Egypt, not being afraid of the anger of the king, for he endured as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured as seeing Him who is invisible.
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that Moses left the land of Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger. He kept right on going because he kept his eyes on the one who is invisible.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he persevered, as though seeing Him who is unseen.
verses.textEn: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger; he persevered because he saw him who is invisible.

verses.textZh: 因着信，他立了逾越节和洒血的礼，免得那灭命的侵犯以色列人的长子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，他立了逾越节和洒血的礼，免得那灭命的侵犯以色列人的长子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他因着信，就守 逾越节，行洒血的礼，免得那灭长子的临近以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith he kept the Passover and the application of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch the firstborn of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith he kept the Passover and sprinkled the blood, so that the Destroyer of the firstborn might not touch them.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, lest he who destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that Moses commanded the people of Israel to keep the Passover and to sprinkle blood on the doorposts so that the angel of death would not kill their firstborn sons.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch them.
verses.textEn: By faith he kept the Passover and the application of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch the firstborn of Israel.

verses.textZh: 因着信，他们走过了红海，好象走过旱地一样；埃及人也试着要过去，就被淹没了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，他们走过了红海，好象走过旱地一样；埃及人也试着要过去，就被淹没了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们因着信，过红海如行干地；埃及人试着要过去，就被吞灭了。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to do so, they were drowned.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith the people crossed the Red Sea as on dry land, but the Egyptians, when they attempted to do the same, were drowned.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as by dry land, whereas the Egyptians, attempting to do so, were drowned.
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that the people of Israel went right through the Red Sea as though they were on dry ground. But when the Egyptians tried to follow, they were all drowned.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as through dry land; and the Egyptians, when they attempted it, were drowned.
verses.textEn: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to do so, they were drowned.

verses.textZh: 因着信，耶利哥的城墙被围绕了七天，就倒塌了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，耶利哥的城墙被围绕了七天，就倒塌了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人因着信，围绕耶利哥城七日，城墙就倒塌了。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the army had marched around them for seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they were encircled for seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that the people of Israel marched around Jericho for seven days, and the walls came crashing down.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after the Israelites had marched around them for seven days.
verses.textEn: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the army had marched around them for seven days.

verses.textZh: 因着信，妓女喇合和和平平接待了侦察的人，就没有和那些不顺从的人一起灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着信，妓女喇合和和平平接待了侦察的人，就没有和那些不顺从的人一起灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 妓女喇合因着信，曾和和平平地接待探子，就不与那些不顺从的人一同灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies, was not killed with those who were disobedient.
verses.textEnEsv: By faith Rahab the prostitute did not perish with those who were disobedient, because she had given a friendly welcome to the spies.
verses.textEnNkjv: By faith the harlot Rahab did not perish with those who did not believe, when she had received the spies with peace.
verses.textEnNlt: It was by faith that Rahab the prostitute was not destroyed with the people in her city who refused to obey God. For she had given a friendly welcome to the spies.
verses.textEnNasb: By faith the prostitute Rahab did not perish along with those who were disobedient, after she had welcomed the spies in peace.
verses.textEn: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies, was not killed with those who were disobedient.

verses.textZh: 我还要再说甚么呢？如果再要述说基甸、巴拉、参孙、耶弗他、大卫、撒母耳和众先知的事，时间就不够了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我还要再说甚么呢？如果再要述说基甸、巴拉、参孙、耶弗他、大卫、撒母耳和众先知的事，时间就不够了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又何必再说呢？若要一一细说，基甸、巴拉、参孙、耶弗他、大卫、撒母耳，和众先知的事，时候就不够了。
verses.textEnNiv: And what more shall I say? I do not have time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson and Jephthah, about David and Samuel and the prophets,
verses.textEnEsv: And what more shall I say? For time would fail me to tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, of David and Samuel and the prophets—
verses.textEnNkjv: And what more shall I say? For the time would fail me to tell of Gideon and Barak and Samson and Jephthah, also of David and Samuel and the prophets:
verses.textEnNlt: How much more do I need to say? It would take too long to recount the stories of the faith of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and all the prophets.
verses.textEnNasb: And what more shall I say? For time will fail me if I tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, of David and Samuel and the prophets,
verses.textEn: And what more shall I say? I do not have time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson and Jephthah, about David and Samuel and the prophets,

verses.textZh: 他们借着信，就战胜了敌国，伸张了正义，得到了应许，堵住了狮子的口，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们借着信，就战胜了敌国，伸张了正义，得到了应许，堵住了狮子的口，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们因着信，制伏了敌国，行了公义，得了应许，堵了狮子的口，
verses.textEnNiv: who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,
verses.textEnEsv: who through faith conquered kingdoms, enforced justice, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
verses.textEnNkjv: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
verses.textEnNlt: By faith these people overthrew kingdoms, ruled with justice, and received what God had promised them. They shut the mouths of lions,
verses.textEnNasb: who by faith conquered kingdoms, performed acts of righteousness, obtained promises, shut the mouths of lions,
verses.textEn: who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,

verses.textZh: 消灭了烈火的威力，逃脱了刀剑的锋刃，软弱变成刚强，在战争中显出大能，把外国的军队击退。
verses.textZhCnvs: 消灭了烈火的威力，逃脱了刀剑的锋刃，软弱变成刚强，在战争中显出大能，把外国的军队击退。
verses.textZhCuv: 灭了烈火的猛势，脱了刀剑的锋刃；软弱变为刚强，争战显出勇敢，打退外邦的全军。
verses.textEnNiv: quenched the fury of the flames, and escaped the edge of the sword; whose weakness was turned to strength; and who became powerful in battle and routed foreign armies.
verses.textEnEsv: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, were made strong out of weakness, became mighty in war, put foreign armies to flight.
verses.textEnNkjv: quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, became valiant in battle, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
verses.textEnNlt: quenched the flames of fire, and escaped death by the edge of the sword. Their weakness was turned to strength. They became strong in battle and put whole armies to flight.
verses.textEnNasb: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, became mighty in war, put foreign armies to flight.
verses.textEn: quenched the fury of the flames, and escaped the edge of the sword; whose weakness was turned to strength; and who became powerful in battle and routed foreign armies.

verses.textZh: 有些妇女得回从死里复活的亲人；但也有些人忍受了酷刑，不肯接受释放，为的是要得着更美的复活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些妇女得回从死里复活的亲人；但也有些人忍受了酷刑，不肯接受释放，为的是要得着更美的复活。
verses.textZhCuv: 有妇人得自己的死人复活。又有人忍受严刑，不肯苟且得释放 ，为要得着更美的复活。
verses.textEnNiv: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. There were others who were tortured, refusing to be released so that they might gain an even better resurrection.
verses.textEnEsv: Women received back their dead by resurrection. Some were tortured, refusing to accept release, so that they might rise again to a better life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Women received their dead raised to life again. Others were tortured, not accepting deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
verses.textEnNlt: Women received their loved ones back again from death. But others were tortured, refusing to turn from God in order to be set free. They placed their hope in a better life after the resurrection.
verses.textEnNasb: Women received back their dead by resurrection; and others were tortured, not accepting their release, so that they might obtain a better resurrection;
verses.textEn: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. There were others who were tortured, refusing to be released so that they might gain an even better resurrection.

verses.textZh: 又有些人遭受了戏弄、鞭打，甚至捆锁、监禁；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有些人遭受了戏弄、鞭打，甚至捆锁、监禁；
verses.textZhCuv: 又有人忍受戏弄、鞭打、捆锁、监禁、各等的磨炼，
verses.textEnNiv: Some faced jeers and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.
verses.textEnEsv: Others suffered mocking and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Still others had trial of mockings and scourgings, yes, and of chains and imprisonment.
verses.textEnNlt: Some were jeered at, and their backs were cut open with whips. Others were chained in prisons.
verses.textEnNasb: and others experienced mocking and flogging, and further, chains and imprisonment.
verses.textEn: Some faced jeers and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.

verses.textZh: 被石头打死，被锯锯死， 被刀杀死。他们披着绵羊山羊的皮到处奔跑、受穷乏、遭患难、被虐待；
verses.textZhCnvs: 被石头打死，被锯锯死， 被刀杀死。他们披着绵羊山羊的皮到处奔跑、受穷乏、遭患难、被虐待；
verses.textZhCuv: 被石头打死，被锯锯死，受试探，被刀杀，披着绵羊山羊的皮各处奔跑，受穷乏、患难、苦害，
verses.textEnNiv: They were put to death by stoning; they were sawed in two; they were killed by the sword. They went about in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, persecuted and mistreated—
verses.textEnEsv: They were stoned, they were sawn in two, they were killed with the sword. They went about in skins of sheep and goats, destitute, afflicted, mistreated—
verses.textEnNkjv: They were stoned, they were sawn in two, were tempted, were slain with the sword. They wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins, being destitute, afflicted, tormented—
verses.textEnNlt: Some died by stoning, some were sawed in half, and others were killed with the sword. Some went about wearing skins of sheep and goats, destitute and oppressed and mistreated.
verses.textEnNasb: They were stoned, they were sawn in two, they were tempted, they were put to death with the sword; they went about in sheepskins, in goatskins, being destitute, afflicted, tormented
verses.textEn: They were put to death by stoning; they were sawed in two; they were killed by the sword. They went about in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, persecuted and mistreated—

verses.textZh: 原是这世界不配有的人。他们飘流无定，在旷野、山岭、石洞和地穴栖身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原是这世界不配有的人。他们飘流无定，在旷野、山岭、石洞和地穴栖身。
verses.textZhCuv: 在旷野、山岭、山洞、地穴，飘流无定，本是世界不配有的人。
verses.textEnNiv: the world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, living in caves and in holes in the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: of whom the world was not worthy— wandering about in deserts and mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: of whom the world was not worthy. They wandered in deserts and mountains, in dens and caves of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: They were too good for this world, wandering over deserts and mountains, hiding in caves and holes in the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: (people of whom the world was not worthy), wandering in deserts, on mountains, and sheltering in caves and holes in the ground.
verses.textEn: the world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, living in caves and in holes in the ground.

verses.textZh: 所有这些人都借着信得了称许，却还没有得着所应许的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有这些人都借着信得了称许，却还没有得着所应许的；
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人都是因信得了美好的证据，却仍未得着所应许的；
verses.textEnNiv: These were all commended for their faith, yet none of them received what had been promised,
verses.textEnEsv: And all these, though commended through their faith, did not receive what was promised,
verses.textEnNkjv: And all these, having obtained a good testimony through faith, did not receive the promise,
verses.textEnNlt: All these people earned a good reputation because of their faith, yet none of them received all that God had promised.
verses.textEnNasb: And all these, having gained approval through their faith, did not receive what was promised,
verses.textEn: These were all commended for their faith, yet none of them received what had been promised,

verses.textZh: 因为神已经为我们预备了更美的事，使他们若不跟我们在一起，就不能完全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神已经为我们预备了更美的事，使他们若不跟我们在一起，就不能完全。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神给我们预备了更美的事，叫他们若不与我们同得，就不能完全。
verses.textEnNiv: since God had planned something better for us so that only together with us would they be made perfect.
verses.textEnEsv: since God had provided something better for us, that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
verses.textEnNkjv: God having provided something better for us, that they should not be made perfect apart from us.
verses.textEnNlt: For God had something better in mind for us, so that they would not reach perfection without us.
verses.textEnNasb: because God had provided something better for us, so that apart from us they would not be made perfect.
verses.textEn: since God had planned something better for us so that only together with us would they be made perfect.

verses.textZh: 所以，我们既然有这么多的见证人，像云彩围绕着我们，就应该脱下各样的拖累，和容易缠住我们的罪，以坚忍的心奔跑那摆在我们面前的赛程；
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们既然有这么多的见证人，像云彩围绕着我们，就应该脱下各样的拖累，和容易缠住我们的罪，以坚忍的心奔跑那摆在我们面前的赛程；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既有这许多的见证人，如同云彩围着我们，就当放下各样的重担，脱去容易缠累我们的罪，存心忍耐，奔那摆在我们前头的路程，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that hinders and the sin that so easily entangles. And let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us also lay aside every weight, and sin which clings so closely, and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore we also, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which so easily ensnares us, and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us,
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a huge crowd of witnesses to the life of faith, let us strip off every weight that slows us down, especially the sin that so easily trips us up. And let us run with endurance the race God has set before us.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, since we also have such a great cloud of witnesses surrounding us, let’s rid ourselves of every obstacle and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with endurance the race that is set before us,
verses.textEn: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that hinders and the sin that so easily entangles. And let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us,

verses.textZh: 专一注视耶稣，就是那位信心的创造者和完成者。他因为那摆在面前的喜乐，就忍受了十字架，轻看了羞辱，现在就坐在神宝座的右边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 专一注视耶稣，就是那位信心的创造者和完成者。他因为那摆在面前的喜乐，就忍受了十字架，轻看了羞辱，现在就坐在神宝座的右边。
verses.textZhCuv: 仰望为我们信心创始成终的耶稣 。他因那摆在前面的喜乐，就轻看羞辱，忍受了十字架的苦难，便坐在神宝座的右边。
verses.textEnNiv: fixing our eyes on Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of faith. For the joy set before him he endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.textEnEsv: looking to Jesus, the founder and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is seated at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith, who for the joy that was set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.textEnNlt: We do this by keeping our eyes on Jesus, the champion who initiates and perfects our faith. Because of the joy awaiting him, he endured the cross, disregarding its shame. Now he is seated in the place of honor beside God’s throne.
verses.textEnNasb: looking only at Jesus, the originator and perfecter of the faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.textEn: fixing our eyes on Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of faith. For the joy set before him he endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

verses.textZh: 这位忍受罪人那样顶撞的耶稣，你们要仔细思想，免得疲倦灰心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这位忍受罪人那样顶撞的耶稣，你们要仔细思想，免得疲倦灰心。
verses.textZhCuv: 那忍受罪人这样顶撞的，你们要思想，免得疲倦灰心。
verses.textEnNiv: Consider him who endured such opposition from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Consider him who endured from sinners such hostility against himself, so that you may not grow weary or fainthearted.
verses.textEnNkjv: For consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners against Himself, lest you become weary and discouraged in your souls.
verses.textEnNlt: Think of all the hostility he endured from sinful people; then you won’t become weary and give up.
verses.textEnNasb: For consider Him who has endured such hostility by sinners against Himself, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.
verses.textEn: Consider him who endured such opposition from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.

verses.textZh: 你们与罪恶斗争，还没有对抗到流血的地步；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们与罪恶斗争，还没有对抗到流血的地步；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们与罪恶相争，还没有抵挡到流血的地步。
verses.textEnNiv: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.
verses.textEnEsv: In your struggle against sin you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have not yet resisted to bloodshed, striving against sin.
verses.textEnNlt: After all, you have not yet given your lives in your struggle against sin.
verses.textEnNasb: You have not yet resisted to the point of shedding blood in your striving against sin;
verses.textEn: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.

verses.textZh: 你们又忘记了那劝你们好象劝儿子的话，说： "我儿！你不可轻看主的管教， 受责备的时候也不要灰心；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们又忘记了那劝你们好象劝儿子的话，说： "我儿！你不可轻看主的管教， 受责备的时候也不要灰心；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们又忘了那劝你们如同劝儿子的话，说： 我儿，你不可轻看主的管教， 被他责备的时候也不可灰心；
verses.textEnNiv: And have you completely forgotten this word of encouragement that addresses you as a father addresses his son? It says, "My son, do not make light of the Lord’s discipline, and do not lose heart when he rebukes you,
verses.textEnEsv: And have you forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons? "My son, do not regard lightly the discipline of the Lord, nor be weary when reproved by him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you have forgotten the exhortation which speaks to you as to sons: "My son, do not despise the chastening of the Lord, Nor be discouraged when you are rebuked by Him;
verses.textEnNlt: And have you forgotten the encouraging words God spoke to you as his children? He said, "My child, don’t make light of the Lord ’s discipline, and don’t give up when he corrects you.
verses.textEnNasb: and you have forgotten the exhortation which is addressed to you as sons, "My son, do not regard lightly the discipline of the Lord, Nor faint when you are punished by Him;
verses.textEn: And have you completely forgotten this word of encouragement that addresses you as a father addresses his son? It says, "My son, do not make light of the Lord’s discipline, and do not lose heart when he rebukes you,

verses.textZh: 因为主所爱的，他必管教， 他又鞭打所收纳的每一个儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为主所爱的，他必管教， 他又鞭打所收纳的每一个儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为主所爱的，他必管教， 又鞭打凡所收纳的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: because the Lord disciplines the one he loves, and he chastens everyone he accepts as his son."
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord disciplines the one he loves, and chastises every son whom he receives."
verses.textEnNkjv: For whom the Lord loves He chastens, And scourges every son whom He receives."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord disciplines those he loves, and he punishes each one he accepts as his child."
verses.textEnNasb: For whom the Lord loves He disciplines, And He punishes every son whom He accepts."
verses.textEn: because the Lord disciplines the one he loves, and he chastens everyone he accepts as his son."

verses.textZh: 为了接受管教，你们要忍受，因为神待你们好象待儿子一样；哪有儿子不受父亲管教的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了接受管教，你们要忍受，因为神待你们好象待儿子一样；哪有儿子不受父亲管教的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们所忍受的，是神管教你们，待你们如同待儿子。焉有儿子不被父亲管教的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Endure hardship as discipline; God is treating you as his children. For what children are not disciplined by their father?
verses.textEnEsv: It is for discipline that you have to endure. God is treating you as sons. For what son is there whom his father does not discipline?
verses.textEnNkjv: If you endure chastening, God deals with you as with sons; for what son is there whom a father does not chasten?
verses.textEnNlt: As you endure this divine discipline, remember that God is treating you as his own children. Who ever heard of a child who is never disciplined by its father?
verses.textEnNasb: It is for discipline that you endure; God deals with you as with sons; for what son is there whom his father does not discipline?
verses.textEn: Endure hardship as discipline; God is treating you as his children. For what children are not disciplined by their father?

verses.textZh: 作儿子的都受过管教。如果你们没有受管教，就是私生子，不是儿子了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作儿子的都受过管教。如果你们没有受管教，就是私生子，不是儿子了。
verses.textZhCuv: 管教原是众子所共受的。你们若不受管教，就是私子，不是儿子了。
verses.textEnNiv: If you are not disciplined—and everyone undergoes discipline—then you are not legitimate, not true sons and daughters at all.
verses.textEnEsv: If you are left without discipline, in which all have participated, then you are illegitimate children and not sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you are without chastening, of which all have become partakers, then you are illegitimate and not sons.
verses.textEnNlt: If God doesn’t discipline you as he does all of his children, it means that you are illegitimate and are not really his children at all.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you are without discipline, of which all have become partakers, then you are illegitimate children and not sons.
verses.textEn: If you are not disciplined—and everyone undergoes discipline—then you are not legitimate, not true sons and daughters at all.

verses.textZh: 还有，肉身的父亲管教我们，我们尚且敬重他们；何况那万灵的父，我们不是更要顺服他而得生吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有，肉身的父亲管教我们，我们尚且敬重他们；何况那万灵的父，我们不是更要顺服他而得生吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 再者，我们曾有生身的父管教我们，我们尚且敬重他，何况万灵的父，我们岂不更当顺服他得生吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, we have all had human fathers who disciplined us and we respected them for it. How much more should we submit to the Father of spirits and live!
verses.textEnEsv: Besides this, we have had earthly fathers who disciplined us and we respected them. Shall we not much more be subject to the Father of spirits and live?
verses.textEnNkjv: Furthermore, we have had human fathers who corrected us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much more readily be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?
verses.textEnNlt: Since we respected our earthly fathers who disciplined us, shouldn’t we submit even more to the discipline of the Father of our spirits, and live forever?
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, we had earthly fathers to discipline us, and we respected them; shall we not much more be subject to the Father of spirits, and live?
verses.textEn: Moreover, we have all had human fathers who disciplined us and we respected them for it. How much more should we submit to the Father of spirits and live!

verses.textZh: 肉身的父亲照着自己的意思管教我们，只有短暂的日子；唯有神管教我们，是为着我们的好处，使我们在他的圣洁上有分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 肉身的父亲照着自己的意思管教我们，只有短暂的日子；唯有神管教我们，是为着我们的好处，使我们在他的圣洁上有分。
verses.textZhCuv: 生身的父都是暂随己意管教我们；惟有万灵的父管教我们，是要我们得益处，使我们在他的圣洁上有分。
verses.textEnNiv: They disciplined us for a little while as they thought best; but God disciplines us for our good, in order that we may share in his holiness.
verses.textEnEsv: For they disciplined us for a short time as it seemed best to them, but he disciplines us for our good, that we may share his holiness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they indeed for a few days chastened us as seemed best to them, but He for our profit, that we may be partakers of His holiness.
verses.textEnNlt: For our earthly fathers disciplined us for a few years, doing the best they knew how. But God’s discipline is always good for us, so that we might share in his holiness.
verses.textEnNasb: For they disciplined us for a short time as seemed best to them, but He disciplines us for our good, so that we may share His holiness.
verses.textEn: They disciplined us for a little while as they thought best; but God disciplines us for our good, in order that we may share in his holiness.

verses.textZh: 但是一切管教，在当时似乎不觉得快乐，反觉得痛苦；后来却为那些经过这种操练的人，结出平安的果子来，就是义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是一切管教，在当时似乎不觉得快乐，反觉得痛苦；后来却为那些经过这种操练的人，结出平安的果子来，就是义。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡管教的事，当时不觉得快乐，反觉得愁苦；后来却为那经练过的人结出平安的果子，就是义。
verses.textEnNiv: No discipline seems pleasant at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it produces a harvest of righteousness and peace for those who have been trained by it.
verses.textEnEsv: For the moment all discipline seems painful rather than pleasant, but later it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now no chastening seems to be joyful for the present, but painful; nevertheless, afterward it yields the peaceable fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
verses.textEnNlt: No discipline is enjoyable while it is happening—it’s painful! But afterward there will be a peaceful harvest of right living for those who are trained in this way.
verses.textEnNasb: For the moment, all discipline seems not to be pleasant, but painful; yet to those who have been trained by it, afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness.
verses.textEn: No discipline seems pleasant at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it produces a harvest of righteousness and peace for those who have been trained by it.

verses.textZh: 所以，你们要把下垂的手和发软的腿挺直起来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们要把下垂的手和发软的腿挺直起来；
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们要把下垂的手、发酸的腿挺起来；
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, strengthen your feeble arms and weak knees.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore lift your drooping hands and strengthen your weak knees,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore strengthen the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees,
verses.textEnNlt: So take a new grip with your tired hands and strengthen your weak knees.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, strengthen the hands that are weak and the knees that are feeble,
verses.textEn: Therefore, strengthen your feeble arms and weak knees.

verses.textZh: 也要把你们所走的道路修直，使瘸子不至于扭脚，反而得到复原。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也要把你们所走的道路修直，使瘸子不至于扭脚，反而得到复原。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要为自己的脚，把道路修直了，使瘸子不致歪脚 ，反得痊愈。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make level paths for your feet," so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.
verses.textEnEsv: and make straight paths for your feet, so that what is lame may not be put out of joint but rather be healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: and make straight paths for your feet, so that what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
verses.textEnNlt: Mark out a straight path for your feet so that those who are weak and lame will not fall but become strong.
verses.textEnNasb: and make straight paths for your feet, so that the limb which is impaired may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
verses.textEn: "Make level paths for your feet," so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.

verses.textZh: 你们要竭力寻求与众人和睦，并且要竭力追求圣洁。如果没有圣洁，谁也不能见主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要竭力寻求与众人和睦，并且要竭力追求圣洁。如果没有圣洁，谁也不能见主。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要追求与众人和睦，并要追求圣洁；非圣洁没有人能见主。
verses.textEnNiv: Make every effort to live in peace with everyone and to be holy; without holiness no one will see the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Strive for peace with everyone, and for the holiness without which no one will see the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pursue peace with all people, and holiness, without which no one will see the Lord:
verses.textEnNlt: Work at living in peace with everyone, and work at living a holy life, for those who are not holy will not see the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Pursue peace with all people, and the holiness without which no one will see the Lord.
verses.textEn: Make every effort to live in peace with everyone and to be holy; without holiness no one will see the Lord.

verses.textZh: 你们要小心，免得有人失去了神的恩典；免得有苦根长起来缠绕你们，因而污染了许多人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要小心，免得有人失去了神的恩典；免得有苦根长起来缠绕你们，因而污染了许多人；
verses.textZhCuv: 又要谨慎，恐怕有人失了神的恩；恐怕有毒根生出来扰乱你们，因此叫众人沾染污秽；
verses.textEnNiv: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God and that no bitter root grows up to cause trouble and defile many.
verses.textEnEsv: See to it that no one fails to obtain the grace of God; that no "root of bitterness" springs up and causes trouble, and by it many become defiled;
verses.textEnNkjv: looking carefully lest anyone fall short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up cause trouble, and by this many become defiled;
verses.textEnNlt: Look after each other so that none of you fails to receive the grace of God. Watch out that no poisonous root of bitterness grows up to trouble you, corrupting many.
verses.textEnNasb: See to it that no one comes short of the grace of God; that no root of bitterness springing up causes trouble, and by it many become defiled;
verses.textEn: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God and that no bitter root grows up to cause trouble and defile many.

verses.textZh: 又免得有人成为淫乱的和贪恋世俗的，好象以扫一样，为了一点点食物，竟把自己长子的名分出卖了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又免得有人成为淫乱的和贪恋世俗的，好象以扫一样，为了一点点食物，竟把自己长子的名分出卖了。
verses.textZhCuv: 恐怕有淫乱的，有贪恋世俗如以扫的，他因一点食物把自己长子的名分卖了。
verses.textEnNiv: See that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his inheritance rights as the oldest son.
verses.textEnEsv: that no one is sexually immoral or unholy like Esau, who sold his birthright for a single meal.
verses.textEnNkjv: lest there be any fornicator or profane person like Esau, who for one morsel of food sold his birthright.
verses.textEnNlt: Make sure that no one is immoral or godless like Esau, who traded his birthright as the firstborn son for a single meal.
verses.textEnNasb: that there be no sexually immoral or godless person like Esau, who sold his own birthright for a single meal.
verses.textEn: See that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his inheritance rights as the oldest son.

verses.textZh: 你们知道，后来以扫想要承受祝福，却被拒绝了；他虽然带着眼泪寻求，还是没有反悔的余地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们知道，后来以扫想要承受祝福，却被拒绝了；他虽然带着眼泪寻求，还是没有反悔的余地。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来想要承受父所祝的福，竟被弃绝，虽然号哭切求，却得不着门路使他父亲的心意回转。这是你们知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: Afterward, as you know, when he wanted to inherit this blessing, he was rejected. Even though he sought the blessing with tears, he could not change what he had done.
verses.textEnEsv: For you know that afterward, when he desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no chance to repent, though he sought it with tears.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for repentance, though he sought it diligently with tears.
verses.textEnNlt: You know that afterward, when he wanted his father’s blessing, he was rejected. It was too late for repentance, even though he begged with bitter tears.
verses.textEnNasb: For you know that even afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for repentance, though he sought for it with tears.
verses.textEn: Afterward, as you know, when he wanted to inherit this blessing, he was rejected. Even though he sought the blessing with tears, he could not change what he had done.

verses.textZh: 你们不是来到那座摸得着的山。那里有烈火、密云、幽暗、暴风、
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不是来到那座摸得着的山。那里有烈火、密云、幽暗、暴风、
verses.textZhCuv: 你们原不是来到那能摸的山；此山有火焰、密云、黑暗、暴风、
verses.textEnNiv: You have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom and storm;
verses.textEnEsv: For you have not come to what may be touched, a blazing fire and darkness and gloom and a tempest
verses.textEnNkjv: For you have not come to the mountain that may be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness and darkness and tempest,
verses.textEnNlt: You have not come to a physical mountain, to a place of flaming fire, darkness, gloom, and whirlwind, as the Israelites did at Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNasb: For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and to a blazing fire, and to darkness and gloom and whirlwind,
verses.textEn: You have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom and storm;

verses.textZh: 号筒的响声和说话的声音；那些听见这声音的人，都请求神不要再向他们多说话；
verses.textZhCnvs: 号筒的响声和说话的声音；那些听见这声音的人，都请求神不要再向他们多说话；
verses.textZhCuv: 角声与说话的声音。那些听见这声音的，都求不要再向他们说话；
verses.textEnNiv: to a trumpet blast or to such a voice speaking words that those who heard it begged that no further word be spoken to them,
verses.textEnEsv: and the sound of a trumpet and a voice whose words made the hearers beg that no further messages be spoken to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the sound of a trumpet and the voice of words, so that those who heard it begged that the word should not be spoken to them anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: For they heard an awesome trumpet blast and a voice so terrible that they begged God to stop speaking.
verses.textEnNasb: and to the blast of a trumpet and the sound of words, which sound was such that those who heard begged that no further word be spoken to them.
verses.textEn: to a trumpet blast or to such a voice speaking words that those who heard it begged that no further word be spoken to them,

verses.textZh: 因为他们担当不起那命令："就是走兽挨近这山，也要用石头把牠打死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们担当不起那命令："就是走兽挨近这山，也要用石头把牠打死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们当不起所命他们的话，说：「靠近这山的，即便是走兽，也要用石头打死。」
verses.textEnNiv: because they could not bear what was commanded: "If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned to death."
verses.textEnEsv: For they could not endure the order that was given, "If even a beast touches the mountain, it shall be stoned."
verses.textEnNkjv: (For they could not endure what was commanded: "And if so much as a beast touches the mountain, it shall be stoned or shot with an arrow."
verses.textEnNlt: They staggered back under God’s command: "If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned to death."
verses.textEnNasb: For they could not cope with the command, "If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned."
verses.textEn: because they could not bear what was commanded: "If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned to death."

verses.textZh: 当时，显出的景象是那么可怕，连摩西也说："我非常恐惧战兢。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，显出的景象是那么可怕，连摩西也说："我非常恐惧战兢。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所见的极其可怕，甚至摩西说：「我甚是恐惧战兢。」
verses.textEnNiv: The sight was so terrifying that Moses said, "I am trembling with fear."
verses.textEnEsv: Indeed, so terrifying was the sight that Moses said, "I tremble with fear."
verses.textEnNkjv: And so terrifying was the sight that Moses said, "I am exceedingly afraid and trembling.")
verses.textEnNlt: Moses himself was so frightened at the sight that he said, "I am terrified and trembling."
verses.textEnNasb: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, "I am terrified and trembling."
verses.textEn: The sight was so terrifying that Moses said, "I am trembling with fear."

verses.textZh: 你们却是来到锡安山和永活的神的城，就是天上的耶路撒冷；在那里有千万的天使聚集，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们却是来到锡安山和永活的神的城，就是天上的耶路撒冷；在那里有千万的天使聚集，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们乃是来到锡安山，永生神的城邑，就是天上的耶路撒冷。那里有千万的天使，
verses.textEnNiv: But you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to thousands upon thousands of angels in joyful assembly,
verses.textEnEsv: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable angels in festal gathering,
verses.textEnNkjv: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, to an innumerable company of angels,
verses.textEnNlt: No, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to countless thousands of angels in a joyful gathering.
verses.textEnNasb: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to myriads of angels,
verses.textEn: But you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to thousands upon thousands of angels in joyful assembly,

verses.textZh: 有名字登记在天上众长子的教会，有审判众人的神，有被成全的义人的灵魂，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有名字登记在天上众长子的教会，有审判众人的神，有被成全的义人的灵魂，
verses.textZhCuv: 有名录在天上诸长子之会所共聚的总会，有审判众人的神和被成全之义人的灵魂，
verses.textEnNiv: to the church of the firstborn, whose names are written in heaven. You have come to God, the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,
verses.textEnEsv: and to the assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, and to God, the judge of all, and to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,
verses.textEnNkjv: to the general assembly and church of the firstborn whoare registered in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
verses.textEnNlt: You have come to the assembly of God’s firstborn children, whose names are written in heaven. You have come to God himself, who is the judge over all things. You have come to the spirits of the righteous ones in heaven who have now been made perfect.
verses.textEnNasb: to the general assembly and church of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, and to God, the Judge of all, and to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,
verses.textEn: to the church of the firstborn, whose names are written in heaven. You have come to God, the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,

verses.textZh: 有新约的中保耶稣，还有他所洒的血。这血所传的信息比亚伯的血所传的更美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有新约的中保耶稣，还有他所洒的血。这血所传的信息比亚伯的血所传的更美。
verses.textZhCuv: 并新约的中保耶稣，以及所洒的血；这血所说的比亚伯的血所说的更美。
verses.textEnNiv: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.
verses.textEnEsv: and to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.
verses.textEnNkjv: to Jesus the Mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better things than thatof Abel.
verses.textEnNlt: You have come to Jesus, the one who mediates the new covenant between God and people, and to the sprinkled blood, which speaks of forgiveness instead of crying out for vengeance like the blood of Abel.
verses.textEnNasb: and to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood, which speaks better than the blood of Abel.
verses.textEn: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.

verses.textZh: 你们要谨慎，不要弃绝那位说话的，因为从前的人弃绝了那位在地上警戒他们的，尚且不能逃罪；何况现在我们背弃那位从天上警戒我们的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要谨慎，不要弃绝那位说话的，因为从前的人弃绝了那位在地上警戒他们的，尚且不能逃罪；何况现在我们背弃那位从天上警戒我们的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们总要谨慎，不可弃绝那向你们说话的。因为，那些弃绝在地上警戒他们的尚且不能逃罪，何况我们违背那从天上警戒我们的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: See to it that you do not refuse him who speaks. If they did not escape when they refused him who warned them on earth, how much less will we, if we turn away from him who warns us from heaven?
verses.textEnEsv: See that you do not refuse him who is speaking. For if they did not escape when they refused him who warned them on earth, much less will we escape if we reject him who warns from heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: See that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if they did not escape who refused Him who spoke on earth, much more shallwenotescape if we turn away from Him who speaks from heaven,
verses.textEnNlt: Be careful that you do not refuse to listen to the One who is speaking. For if the people of Israel did not escape when they refused to listen to Moses, the earthly messenger, we will certainly not escape if we reject the One who speaks to us from heaven!
verses.textEnNasb: See to it that you do not refuse Him who is speaking. For if those did not escape when they refused him who warned them on earth, much less will we escape who turn away from Him who warns us from heaven.
verses.textEn: See to it that you do not refuse him who speaks. If they did not escape when they refused him who warned them on earth, how much less will we, if we turn away from him who warns us from heaven?

verses.textZh: 当时他的声音震动了地；现在他却应许说："下一次，我不但要震动地，还要震动天。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时他的声音震动了地；现在他却应许说："下一次，我不但要震动地，还要震动天。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当时他的声音震动了地，但如今他应许说：「再一次我不单要震动地，还要震动天。」
verses.textEnNiv: At that time his voice shook the earth, but now he has promised, "Once more I will shake not only the earth but also the heavens."
verses.textEnEsv: At that time his voice shook the earth, but now he has promised, "Yet once more I will shake not only the earth but also the heavens."
verses.textEnNkjv: whose voice then shook the earth; but now He has promised, saying, "Yet once more I shake not only the earth, but also heaven."
verses.textEnNlt: When God spoke from Mount Sinai his voice shook the earth, but now he makes another promise: "Once again I will shake not only the earth but the heavens also."
verses.textEnNasb: And His voice shook the earth then, but now He has promised, saying, "Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heaven."
verses.textEn: At that time his voice shook the earth, but now he has promised, "Once more I will shake not only the earth but also the heavens."

verses.textZh: "下一次"这句话，是表明那些被震动的，要像被造之物那样被除去，好使那些不能震动的可以留存，
verses.textZhCnvs: "下一次"这句话，是表明那些被震动的，要像被造之物那样被除去，好使那些不能震动的可以留存，
verses.textZhCuv: 这再一次的话，是指明被震动的，就是受造之物都要挪去，使那不被震动的常存。
verses.textEnNiv: The words "once more" indicate the removing of what can be shaken—that is, created things—so that what cannot be shaken may remain.
verses.textEnEsv: This phrase, "Yet once more," indicates the removal of things that are shaken—that is, things that have been made—in order that the things that cannot be shaken may remain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this, "Yet once more," indicates the removal of those things that are being shaken, as of things that are made, that the things which cannot be shaken may remain.
verses.textEnNlt: This means that all of creation will be shaken and removed, so that only unshakable things will remain.
verses.textEnNasb: This expression, "Yet once more," denotes the removing of those things which can be shaken, as of created things, so that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
verses.textEn: The words "once more" indicate the removing of what can be shaken—that is, created things—so that what cannot be shaken may remain.

verses.textZh: 因此，我们既然领受了不能震动的国，就应该感恩，照着神所喜悦的，用虔诚敬畏的心事奉他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我们既然领受了不能震动的国，就应该感恩，照着神所喜悦的，用虔诚敬畏的心事奉他；
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我们既得了不能震动的国，就当感恩，照神所喜悦的，用虔诚、敬畏的心事奉神。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us be thankful, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore let us be grateful for receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, and thus let us offer to God acceptable worship, with reverence and awe,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom which cannot be shaken, let us have grace, by which we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear.
verses.textEnNlt: Since we are receiving a Kingdom that is unshakable, let us be thankful and please God by worshiping him with holy fear and awe.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, since we receive a kingdom which cannot be shaken, let’s show gratitude, by which we may offer to God an acceptable service with reverence and awe;
verses.textEn: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us be thankful, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe,

verses.textZh: 因为我们的神是烈火。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们的神是烈火。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们的神乃是烈火。
verses.textEnNiv: for our "God is a consuming fire."
verses.textEnEsv: for our God is a consuming fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: For our God is a consuming fire.
verses.textEnNlt: For our God is a devouring fire.
verses.textEnNasb: for our God is a consuming fire.
verses.textEn: for our "God is a consuming fire."

verses.textZh: 你们总要保持弟兄的爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们总要保持弟兄的爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们务要常存弟兄相爱的心。
verses.textEnNiv: Keep on loving one another as brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnEsv: Let brotherly love continue.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let brotherly love continue.
verses.textEnNlt: Keep on loving each other as brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnNasb: Let love of the brothers and sisters continue.
verses.textEn: Keep on loving one another as brothers and sisters.

verses.textZh: 不要忘了用爱心接待人，有人就是这样作，在无意中就款待了天使。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要忘了用爱心接待人，有人就是这样作，在无意中就款待了天使。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可忘记用爱心接待客旅；因为曾有接待客旅的，不知不觉就接待了天使。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not forget to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have shown hospitality to angels without knowing it.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not forget to entertain strangers, for by so doing some have unwittingly entertained angels.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for some who have done this have entertained angels without realizing it!
verses.textEnNasb: Do not neglect hospitality to strangers, for by this some have entertained angels without knowing it.
verses.textEn: Do not forget to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have shown hospitality to angels without knowing it.

verses.textZh: 你们要记念那些被囚禁的人，好象跟他们一起被囚禁；也要记念那些受虐待的人，好象你们也亲自受过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要记念那些被囚禁的人，好象跟他们一起被囚禁；也要记念那些受虐待的人，好象你们也亲自受过。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要记念被捆绑的人，好像与他们同受捆绑；也要记念遭苦害的人，想到自己也在肉身之内。
verses.textEnNiv: Continue to remember those in prison as if you were together with them in prison, and those who are mistreated as if you yourselves were suffering.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember those who are in prison, as though in prison with them, and those who are mistreated, since you also are in the body.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember the prisoners as if chained with them—those who are mistreated—since you yourselves are in the body also.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember those in prison, as if you were there yourself. Remember also those being mistreated, as if you felt their pain in your own bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember the prisoners, as though in prison with them, and those who are badly treated, since you yourselves also are in the body.
verses.textEn: Continue to remember those in prison as if you were together with them in prison, and those who are mistreated as if you yourselves were suffering.

verses.textZh: 人人都应该尊重婚姻，婚床也不要玷污，因为神一定审判淫乱的和奸淫的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人人都应该尊重婚姻，婚床也不要玷污，因为神一定审判淫乱的和奸淫的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 婚姻，人人都当尊重，床也不可污秽；因为苟合行淫的人，神必要审判。
verses.textEnNiv: Marriage should be honored by all, and the marriage bed kept pure, for God will judge the adulterer and all the sexually immoral.
verses.textEnEsv: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the marriage bed be undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterous.
verses.textEnNkjv: Marriage is honorable among all, and the bed undefiled; but fornicators and adulterers God will judge.
verses.textEnNlt: Give honor to marriage, and remain faithful to one another in marriage. God will surely judge people who are immoral and those who commit adultery.
verses.textEnNasb: Marriage is to be held in honor among all, and the marriage bed is to be undefiled; for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
verses.textEn: Marriage should be honored by all, and the marriage bed kept pure, for God will judge the adulterer and all the sexually immoral.

verses.textZh: 你们为人不要贪爱钱财，要以现在所有的为满足；因为神亲自说过："我决不撇下你，也不离弃你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们为人不要贪爱钱财，要以现在所有的为满足；因为神亲自说过："我决不撇下你，也不离弃你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们存心不可贪爱钱财，要以自己所有的为足；因为主曾说：「我总不撇下你，也不丢弃你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, because God has said, "Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you."
verses.textEnEsv: Keep your life free from love of money, and be content with what you have, for he has said, "I will never leave you nor forsake you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Letyour conduct be without covetousness; be content with such things as you have. For He Himself has said, "I will never leave you nor forsake you."
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t love money; be satisfied with what you have. For God has said, "I will never fail you. I will never abandon you."
verses.textEnNasb: Make sure that your character is free from the love of money, being content with what you have; for He Himself has said, "I will never desert you, nor will I ever abandon you,"
verses.textEn: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, because God has said, "Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you."

verses.textZh: 所以我们可以放胆说： "主是我的帮助， 我决不害怕， 人能把我怎么样呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我们可以放胆说： "主是我的帮助， 我决不害怕， 人能把我怎么样呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我们可以放胆说： 主是帮助我的，我必不惧怕； 人能把我怎么样呢？
verses.textEnNiv: So we say with confidence, "The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?"
verses.textEnEsv: So we can confidently say, "The Lord is my helper; I will not fear; what can man do to me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So we may boldly say: "The Lordis my helper; I will not fear. What can man do to me?"
verses.textEnNlt: So we can say with confidence, "The Lord is my helper, so I will have no fear. What can mere people do to me?"
verses.textEnNasb: so that we confidently say, "The Lord is my helper, I will not be afraid. What will man do to me?"
verses.textEn: So we say with confidence, "The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?"

verses.textZh: 你们要记念那些领导过你们，把神的道传给你们的人；你们要观察他们一生的成果，要效法他们的信心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要记念那些领导过你们，把神的道传给你们的人；你们要观察他们一生的成果，要效法他们的信心。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前引导你们、传神之道给你们的人，你们要想念他们，效法他们的信心，留心看他们为人的结局。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember your leaders, who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember your leaders, those who spoke to you the word of God. Consider the outcome of their way of life, and imitate their faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember those who rule over you, who have spoken the word of God to you, whose faith follow, considering the outcome of their conduct.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember your leaders who taught you the word of God. Think of all the good that has come from their lives, and follow the example of their faith.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember those who led you, who spoke the word of God to you; and considering the result of their way of life, imitate their faith.
verses.textEn: Remember your leaders, who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.

verses.textZh: 耶稣基督昨天、今天、一直到永远都是一样的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣基督昨天、今天、一直到永远都是一样的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣基督昨日、今日、一直到永远，是一样的。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today, and forever.
verses.textEn: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

verses.textZh: 你们不要被各样怪异的教训勾引去了。人心靠着恩典，而不是靠着食物得到坚定，才是好的；因为那些拘守食物的人，从来没有得过益处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要被各样怪异的教训勾引去了。人心靠着恩典，而不是靠着食物得到坚定，才是好的；因为那些拘守食物的人，从来没有得过益处。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不要被那诸般怪异的教训勾引了去；因为人心靠恩得坚固才是好的，并不是靠饮食。那在饮食上专心的从来没有得着益处。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings. It is good for our hearts to be strengthened by grace, not by eating ceremonial foods, which is of no benefit to those who do so.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be led away by diverse and strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace, not by foods, which have not benefited those devoted to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be carried about with various and strange doctrines. For itis good that the heart be established by grace, not with foods which have not profited those who have been occupied with them.
verses.textEnNlt: So do not be attracted by strange, new ideas. Your strength comes from God’s grace, not from rules about food, which don’t help those who follow them.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be misled by varied and strange teachings; for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.
verses.textEn: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings. It is good for our hearts to be strengthened by grace, not by eating ceremonial foods, which is of no benefit to those who do so.

verses.textZh: 我们有一座祭坛，坛上的祭物，是那些在会幕中供职的人没有权利吃的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们有一座祭坛，坛上的祭物，是那些在会幕中供职的人没有权利吃的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们有一祭坛，上面的祭物是那些在帐幕中供职的人不可同吃的。
verses.textEnNiv: We have an altar from which those who minister at the tabernacle have no right to eat.
verses.textEnEsv: We have an altar from which those who serve the tent have no right to eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: We have an altar from which those who serve the tabernacle have no right to eat.
verses.textEnNlt: We have an altar from which the priests in the Tabernacle have no right to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: We have an altar from which those who serve the tabernacle have no right to eat.
verses.textEn: We have an altar from which those who minister at the tabernacle have no right to eat.

verses.textZh: 那些祭牲的血，由大祭司带进圣所作赎罪祭，祭牲的身体却要在营外焚烧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些祭牲的血，由大祭司带进圣所作赎罪祭，祭牲的身体却要在营外焚烧。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来牲畜的血被大祭司带入圣所作赎罪祭；牲畜的身子被烧在营外。
verses.textEnNiv: The high priest carries the blood of animals into the Most Holy Place as a sin offering, but the bodies are burned outside the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: For the bodies of those animals whose blood is brought into the holy places by the high priest as a sacrifice for sin are burned outside the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned outside the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: Under the old system, the high priest brought the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, and the bodies of the animals were burned outside the camp.
verses.textEnNasb: For the bodies of those animals whose blood is brought into the Holy Place by the high priest as an offering for sin are burned outside the camp.
verses.textEn: The high priest carries the blood of animals into the Most Holy Place as a sin offering, but the bodies are burned outside the camp.

verses.textZh: 所以耶稣也是这样在城门外受苦，为的是要借着自己的血使人民成圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶稣也是这样在城门外受苦，为的是要借着自己的血使人民成圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶稣要用自己的血叫百姓成圣，也就在城门外受苦。
verses.textEnNiv: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate to make the people holy through his own blood.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus also suffered outside the gate in order to sanctify the people through his own blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Jesus also, that He might sanctify the people with His own blood, suffered outside the gate.
verses.textEnNlt: So also Jesus suffered and died outside the city gates to make his people holy by means of his own blood.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore Jesus also suffered outside the gate, that He might sanctify the people through His own blood.
verses.textEn: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate to make the people holy through his own blood.

verses.textZh: 那么，让我们也出到营外到他那里去，担当他的凌辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，让我们也出到营外到他那里去，担当他的凌辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我们也当出到营外，就了他去，忍受他所受的凌辱。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us, then, go to him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace he bore.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore let us go to him outside the camp and bear the reproach he endured.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let us go forth to Him, outside the camp, bearing His reproach.
verses.textEnNlt: So let us go out to him, outside the camp, and bear the disgrace he bore.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, let us go out to Him outside the camp, bearing His reproach.
verses.textEn: Let us, then, go to him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace he bore.

verses.textZh: 因为在这里我们没有长存的城，我们却是寻求那将要来的城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在这里我们没有长存的城，我们却是寻求那将要来的城。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在这里本没有常存的城，乃是寻求那将来的城。
verses.textEnNiv: For here we do not have an enduring city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.
verses.textEnEsv: For here we have no lasting city, but we seek the city that is to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: For here we have no continuing city, but we seek the one to come.
verses.textEnNlt: For this world is not our permanent home; we are looking forward to a home yet to come.
verses.textEnNasb: For here we do not have a lasting city, but we are seeking the city which is to come.
verses.textEn: For here we do not have an enduring city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.

verses.textZh: 所以，我们要借着耶稣，常常把颂赞的祭品献给神，这就是承认他的名的人嘴唇的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们要借着耶稣，常常把颂赞的祭品献给神，这就是承认他的名的人嘴唇的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们应当靠着耶稣，常常以颂赞为祭献给神，这就是那承认主名之人嘴唇的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise—the fruit of lips that openly profess his name.
verses.textEnEsv: Through him then let us continually offer up a sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of lips that acknowledge his name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore by Him let us continually offer the sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of our lips, giving thanks to His name.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, let us offer through Jesus a continual sacrifice of praise to God, proclaiming our allegiance to his name.
verses.textEnNasb: Through Him then, let’s continually offer up a sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of lips praising His name.
verses.textEn: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise—the fruit of lips that openly profess his name.

verses.textZh: 你们也不要忘记行善和捐输，这样的祭是神所喜悦的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也不要忘记行善和捐输，这样的祭是神所喜悦的。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是不可忘记行善和捐输的事，因为这样的祭是神所喜悦的。
verses.textEnNiv: And do not forget to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not neglect to do good and to share what you have, for such sacrifices are pleasing to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But do not forget to do good and to share, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
verses.textEnNlt: And don’t forget to do good and to share with those in need. These are the sacrifices that please God.
verses.textEnNasb: And do not neglect doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.
verses.textEn: And do not forget to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.

verses.textZh: 你们要听从那些领导你们的人，也要顺服他们；因为他们为你们的灵魂警醒，好象要交帐的人一样。你们要使他们交帐的时候快快乐乐，不至于叹息；如果他们叹息，对你们就没有好处了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要听从那些领导你们的人，也要顺服他们；因为他们为你们的灵魂警醒，好象要交帐的人一样。你们要使他们交帐的时候快快乐乐，不至于叹息；如果他们叹息，对你们就没有好处了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要依从那些引导你们的，且要顺服；因他们为你们的灵魂时刻警醒，好像那将来交帐的人。你们要使他们交的时候有快乐，不致忧愁；若忧愁就与你们无益了。
verses.textEnNiv: Have confidence in your leaders and submit to their authority, because they keep watch over you as those who must give an account. Do this so that their work will be a joy, not a burden, for that would be of no benefit to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they are keeping watch over your souls, as those who will have to give an account. Let them do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be of no advantage to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Obey those who rule over you, and be submissive, for they watch out for your souls, as those who must give account. Let them do so with joy and not with grief, for that would be unprofitable for you.
verses.textEnNlt: Obey your spiritual leaders, and do what they say. Their work is to watch over your souls, and they are accountable to God. Give them reason to do this with joy and not with sorrow. That would certainly not be for your benefit.
verses.textEnNasb: Obey your leaders and submit to them—for they keep watch over your souls as those who will give an account—so that they may do this with joy, not groaning; for this would be unhelpful for you.
verses.textEn: Have confidence in your leaders and submit to their authority, because they keep watch over you as those who must give an account. Do this so that their work will be a joy, not a burden, for that would be of no benefit to you.

verses.textZh: 请为我们祷告，因为我们深信自己良心无亏，愿意凡事遵行正道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请为我们祷告，因为我们深信自己良心无亏，愿意凡事遵行正道。
verses.textZhCuv: 请你们为我们祷告，因我们自觉良心无亏，愿意凡事按正道而行。
verses.textEnNiv: Pray for us. We are sure that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.
verses.textEnEsv: Pray for us, for we are sure that we have a clear conscience, desiring to act honorably in all things.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pray for us; for we are confident that we have a good conscience, in all things desiring to live honorably.
verses.textEnNlt: Pray for us, for our conscience is clear and we want to live honorably in everything we do.
verses.textEnNasb: Pray for us, for we are sure that we have a good conscience, desiring to conduct ourselves honorably in all things.
verses.textEn: Pray for us. We are sure that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.

verses.textZh: 我更加要求你们为我们祷告，好使我们能够快点回到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我更加要求你们为我们祷告，好使我们能够快点回到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我更求你们为我祷告，使我快些回到你们那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: I particularly urge you to pray so that I may be restored to you soon.
verses.textEnEsv: I urge you the more earnestly to do this in order that I may be restored to you the sooner.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I especially urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
verses.textEnNlt: And especially pray that I will be able to come back to you soon.
verses.textEnNasb: And I urge you all the more to do this, so that I may be restored to you more quickly.
verses.textEn: I particularly urge you to pray so that I may be restored to you soon.

verses.textZh: 愿赐平安的神，就是那凭着永约的血，把群羊的大牧人我们的主耶稣，从死人中领出来的那一位，
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿赐平安的神，就是那凭着永约的血，把群羊的大牧人我们的主耶稣，从死人中领出来的那一位，
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿赐平安的神，就是那凭永约之血、使群羊的大牧人－我主耶稣从死里复活的神，
verses.textEnNiv: Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,
verses.textEnEsv: Now may the God of peace who brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, the great shepherd of the sheep, by the blood of the eternal covenant,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now may the God of peace who brought up our Lord Jesus from the dead, that great Shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
verses.textEnNlt: Now may the God of peace— who brought up from the dead our Lord Jesus, the great Shepherd of the sheep, and ratified an eternal covenant with his blood—
verses.textEnNasb: Now may the God of peace, who brought up from the dead the great Shepherd of the sheep through the blood of the eternal covenant, that is, Jesus our Lord,
verses.textEn: Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,

verses.textZh: 在一切善事上成全你们，好使你们遵行他的旨意；又借着耶稣基督在我们里面，行他所喜悦的事。愿荣耀归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在一切善事上成全你们，好使你们遵行他的旨意；又借着耶稣基督在我们里面，行他所喜悦的事。愿荣耀归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 在各样善事上成全你们，叫你们遵行他的旨意；又藉着耶稣基督在你们心里行他所喜悦的事。愿荣耀归给他，直到永永远远。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: equip you with everything good for doing his will, and may he work in us what is pleasing to him, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: equip you with everything good that you may do his will, working in us that which is pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: make you complete in every good work to do His will, working in you what is well pleasing in His sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: may he equip you with all you need for doing his will. May he produce in you, through the power of Jesus Christ, every good thing that is pleasing to him. All glory to him forever and ever! Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: equip you in every good thing to do His will, working in us that which is pleasing in His sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEn: equip you with everything good for doing his will, and may he work in us what is pleasing to him, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我劝你们耐心接受我这劝勉的话，因为我只是简略地写给你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我劝你们耐心接受我这劝勉的话，因为我只是简略地写给你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我略略写信给你们，望你们听我劝勉的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, I urge you to bear with my word of exhortation, for in fact I have written to you quite briefly.
verses.textEnEsv: I appeal to you, brothers, bear with my word of exhortation, for I have written to you briefly.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I appeal to you, brethren, bear with the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.
verses.textEnNlt: I urge you, dear brothers and sisters, to pay attention to what I have written in this brief exhortation.
verses.textEnNasb: But I urge you, brothers and sisters, listen patiently to this word of exhortation, for I have written to you briefly.
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, I urge you to bear with my word of exhortation, for in fact I have written to you quite briefly.

verses.textZh: 你们要知道，我们的弟兄提摩太已经释放了；如果他来得早，我就跟他一起去看你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要知道，我们的弟兄提摩太已经释放了；如果他来得早，我就跟他一起去看你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们该知道，我们的兄弟提摩太已经释放了；他若快来，我必同他去见你们。
verses.textEnNiv: I want you to know that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.
verses.textEnEsv: You should know that our brother Timothy has been released, with whom I shall see you if he comes soon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Know that our brother Timothy has been set free, with whom I shall see you if he comes shortly.
verses.textEnNlt: I want you to know that our brother Timothy has been released from jail. If he comes here soon, I will bring him with me to see you.
verses.textEnNasb: Know that our brother Timothy has been released, with whom, if he comes soon, I will see you.
verses.textEn: I want you to know that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.

verses.textZh: 请问候所有领导你们的人和所有圣徒。从意大利来的人也问候你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请问候所有领导你们的人和所有圣徒。从意大利来的人也问候你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 请你们问引导你们的诸位和众圣徒安。从意大利来的人也问你们安。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet all your leaders and all the Lord’s people. Those from Italy send you their greetings.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those who come from Italy send you greetings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet all those who rule over you, and all the saints. Those from Italy greet you.
verses.textEnNlt: Greet all your leaders and all the believers there. The believers from Italy send you their greetings.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy greet you.
verses.textEn: Greet all your leaders and all the Lord’s people. Those from Italy send you their greetings.

verses.textZh: 愿恩惠与你们众人同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿恩惠与你们众人同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿恩惠常与你们众人同在。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: Grace be with you all.
verses.textEnEsv: Grace be with all of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: May God’s grace be with you all.
verses.textEnNasb: Grace be with you all.
verses.textEn: Grace be with you all.
